src/App.jsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, GripHorizontal, ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Maximize2, Code2, Layers } from 'lucide-react';
import Header from './components/Header';
import Sidebar from './components/Sidebar';
import QueryEditor from './components/QueryEditor';
import QueryResults from './components/QueryResults';
import APIBuilder from './components/APIBuilder';
import SchedulerBuilder from './components/SchedulerBuilder';
import AuditDashboard from './components/AuditDashboard';
import SchemaExplorer from './components/SchemaExplorer';
import QueryLibrary from './components/QueryLibrary';
import DashboardBuilder, { DashboardViewer } from './components/DashboardBuilder';
import DataLineage from './components/DataLineage';
import QueryAnalyzer from './components/QueryAnalyzer';
import QueryForms from './components/QueryForms';
import MigrationTool from './components/MigrationTool';
import AITrainingDashboard from './components/AITrainingDashboard';
import Documentation from './components/Documentation';
import ChatAPIBuilder from './components/ChatAPIBuilder';
import FloatingChatbot from './components/FloatingChatbot';
import ErrorBoundary from './components/ErrorBoundary';
import LoginPage from './components/LoginPage';
import VisualQueryBuilder from './components/VisualQueryBuilder';
import { useAuth } from './context/AuthContext';
import { useQueryStore } from './store/queryStore';
import './App.css';

function App() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, login, logout } = useAuth();

  // ── Check for shared dashboard view-only URL ──────────────────────
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const viewMode = params.get('view');
  const shareToken = params.get('token');
  if (viewMode === 'dashboard' && shareToken) {
    return (
      <ErrorBoundary>
        <div className="h-screen w-screen flex flex-col bg-gray-100">
          <DashboardViewer token={shareToken} />
        </div>
      </ErrorBoundary>
    );
  }

  // ── If not logged in, show the login page ─────────────────────────
  if (!isLoggedIn) {
    return <LoginPage onLogin={login} />;
  }

  return <MainApp user={user} onLogout={logout} />;
}

function MainApp({ user, onLogout }) {
  const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(true);
  const [selectedDatabase, setSelectedDatabase] = useState(null);
  const [selectedTable, setSelectedTable] = useState(null);
  const [editorQuery, setEditorQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState('editor'); // 'editor' | 'apibuilder' | 'scheduler' | 'audit'
  const [convertToApiData, setConvertToApiData] = useState(null);
  const [editorMode, setEditorMode] = useState('sql'); // 'sql' | 'visual'
  const { setSelectedDatabase: storeSetDatabase, setSelectedTable: storeSetTable, loadFavorites, loadHistory, pendingQuery, consumePendingQuery } = useQueryStore();

  // Load user-specific data from backend on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadFavorites();
    loadHistory();
  }, []);

  // Consume pending query from AI Copilot
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pendingQuery) {
      setEditorQuery(pendingQuery);
      consumePendingQuery();
      if (activeView !== 'editor') setActiveView('editor');
      if (editorMode !== 'sql') setEditorMode('sql');
    }
  }, [pendingQuery]);

  // ── Resizable split state ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const [editorPct, setEditorPct] = useState(50); // % of space for editor
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef(null);

  // ── Zoom state for results ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const [resultZoom, setResultZoom] = useState(100); // percentage

  const handleDatabaseSelect = (database) => {
    setSelectedDatabase(database);
    storeSetDatabase(database);
  };

  const handleTableSelect = (table) => {
    setSelectedTable(table);
    storeSetTable(table);
  };

  const handleQueryInsert = (query) => {
    setEditorQuery(query);
  };

  const handleConvertToAPI = (queryData) => {
    setConvertToApiData(queryData);
    setActiveView('apibuilder');
  };

  // ── Drag handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleDragStart = useCallback((e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(true);
  }, []);

  const handleDragMove = useCallback((e) => {
    if (!isDragging || !containerRef.current) return;
    const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = (e.clientY || (e.touches && e.touches[0]?.clientY) || 0) - rect.top;
    const pct = Math.min(Math.max((y / rect.height) * 100, 15), 85);
    setEditorPct(pct);
  }, [isDragging]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    setIsDragging(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDragging) {
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleDragMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleDragEnd);
      window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleDragMove);
      window.addEventListener('touchend', handleDragEnd);
      document.body.style.cursor = 'row-resize';
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
    }
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleDragMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleDragEnd);
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleDragMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleDragEnd);
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
    };
  }, [isDragging, handleDragMove, handleDragEnd]);

  // ── Zoom helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const zoomIn = () => setResultZoom((z) => Math.min(z + 10, 150));
  const zoomOut = () => setResultZoom((z) => Math.max(z - 10, 50));
  const resetZoom = () => setResultZoom(100);

  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <div className="h-screen w-screen flex flex-col bg-gray-100">
        {/* Header */}
        <Header activeView={activeView} onViewChange={setActiveView} user={user} onLogout={onLogout} />

        {/* Main Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden">
          {/* Sidebar */}
          <div
            className={`transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 ${
              sidebarOpen ? 'w-80' : 'w-0'
            } bg-gray-50 border-r border-gray-300`}
          >
            {sidebarOpen && (
              <Sidebar
                onQueryInsert={handleQueryInsert}
                onDatabaseSelect={handleDatabaseSelect}
                onTableSelect={handleTableSelect}
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Toggle Sidebar Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(!sidebarOpen)}
            className="px-2 py-4 bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 transition flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
            title={sidebarOpen ? 'Close sidebar' : 'Open sidebar'}
          >
            {sidebarOpen ? (
              <ChevronLeft size={20} className="text-gray-700" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight size={20} className="text-gray-700" />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Main Content Area */}
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
            {activeView === 'editor' ? (
              <div ref={containerRef} className="flex-1 flex flex-col p-4 overflow-hidden app-split-container">
                {/* Query Editor — top pane */}
                <div className="flex flex-col min-h-0" style={{ height: `${editorMode === 'visual' ? 100 : editorPct}%` }}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">Query Editor</h2>
                      {/* SQL / Visual toggle */}
                      <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-0.5 border border-gray-200">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setEditorMode('sql')}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                            editorMode === 'sql'
                              ? 'bg-white text-blue-700 shadow-sm border border-blue-200'
                              : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Code2 size={13} /> SQL Editor
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setEditorMode('visual')}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                            editorMode === 'visual'
                              ? 'bg-white text-purple-700 shadow-sm border border-purple-200'
                              : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Layers size={13} /> Visual Builder
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {selectedTable && editorMode === 'sql' && (
                      <span className="text-sm px-3 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-full">
                        {selectedTable}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-h-0">
                    {editorMode === 'sql' ? (
                      <QueryEditor database={selectedDatabase} initialQuery={editorQuery} />
                    ) : (
                      <VisualQueryBuilder
                        database={selectedDatabase}
                        onUseQuery={(sql) => { setEditorQuery(sql); setEditorMode('sql'); }}
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* ── Drag Handle ──────────────────────────────────── */}
                {editorMode === 'sql' && (
                  <div
                    className={`drag-handle ${isDragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
                    onMouseDown={handleDragStart}
                    onTouchStart={handleDragStart}
                    title="Drag to resize"
                  >
                    <GripHorizontal size={14} />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Results — bottom pane */}
                {editorMode === 'sql' && (
                <div className="flex flex-col min-h-0" style={{ height: `${100 - editorPct}%` }}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">Results</h2>
                    <div className="zoom-controls">
                      <button onClick={zoomOut} className="zoom-btn" title="Zoom out" disabled={resultZoom <= 50}>
                        <ZoomOut size={14} />
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={resetZoom} className="zoom-label" title="Reset zoom">
                        {resultZoom}%
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={zoomIn} className="zoom-btn" title="Zoom in" disabled={resultZoom >= 150}>
                        <ZoomIn size={14} />
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={() => setEditorPct(15)} className="zoom-btn" title="Maximize results">
                        <Maximize2 size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 results-zoom-wrapper" style={{ zoom: resultZoom / 100 }}>
                    <QueryResults onConvertToAPI={handleConvertToAPI} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : activeView === 'apibuilder' ? (
              <APIBuilder prefillApi={convertToApiData} onPrefillConsumed={() => setConvertToApiData(null)} />
            ) : activeView === 'chatapi' ? (
              <ChatAPIBuilder />
            ) : activeView === 'audit' ? (
              <AuditDashboard />
            ) : activeView === 'schema' ? (
              <SchemaExplorer />
            ) : activeView === 'library' ? (
              <QueryLibrary />
            ) : activeView === 'dashboard' ? (
              <DashboardBuilder />
            ) : activeView === 'lineage' ? (
              <DataLineage />
            ) : activeView === 'analyzer' ? (
              <QueryAnalyzer />
            ) : activeView === 'forms' ? (
              <QueryForms />
            ) : activeView === 'migrate' ? (
              <MigrationTool />
            ) : activeView === 'training' ? (
              <AITrainingDashboard />
            ) : activeView === 'docs' ? (
              <Documentation />
            ) : (
              <SchedulerBuilder />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Floating Chatbot */}
        <FloatingChatbot />
      </div>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

export default App;

src/utils/helpers.js

import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

export const downloadFile = (data, filename, mimeType = 'text/plain') => {
  const blob = new Blob([data], { type: mimeType });
  const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
};

export const copyToClipboard = async (text, message = 'Copied to clipboard!') => {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast.success(message);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    toast.error('Failed to copy to clipboard');
    return false;
  }
};

export const formatBytes = (bytes, decimals = 2) => {
  if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
  const k = 1024;
  const dm = decimals < 0 ? 0 : decimals;
  const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return Math.round((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)) * Math.pow(10, dm)) / Math.pow(10, dm) + ' ' + sizes[i];
};

export const getErrorMessage = (error) => {
  if (error?.response?.data?.detail) {
    return error.response.data.detail;
  }
  if (error?.message) {
    return error.message;
  }
  return 'An unexpected error occurred';
};

export const formatDate = (date) => {
  return new Date(date).toLocaleString();
};

export const truncateString = (str, length = 50) => {
  return str.length > length ? str.substring(0, length) + '...' : str;
};

export const sqlHighlight = (sql) => {
  // Simple SQL syntax highlighting
  const keywords = /\b(SELECT|FROM|WHERE|JOIN|LEFT|RIGHT|INNER|OUTER|ON|AND|OR|ORDER|BY|GROUP|LIMIT|OFFSET|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE|ALTER|DROP|TABLE|DATABASE)\b/gi;
  return sql.replace(keywords, (match) => `<span class="text-blue-600 font-semibold">${match}</span>`);
};







src/store/queryStore.js

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';

export const useQueryStore = create((set, get) => ({
  // UI State
  databaseType: 'cloudsql',
  selectedDatabase: null,
  selectedTable: null,
  queryHistory: [],
  favorites: [],
  resultFormat: 'table',
  databaseSearch: '',
  tableSearch: '',

  // Server Management State
  servers: [],
  selectedServer: null,  // server object { id, name, host, ... }
  loadingServers: false,
  serverDatabases: [],
  loadingServerDatabases: false,

  // Chatbot State
  chatbotOpen: false,
  chatMessages: [],
  chatLoading: false,

  // Data State
  databases: [],
  tables: [],
  tableSchema: null,
  tableSchemas: {},
  queryResult: null,

  // Inline-editing / CRUD state
  editMode: false,
  editedCells: {},
  selectedRows: new Set(),
  newRows: [],
  primaryKeys: [],
  savingData: false,
  lastQueryInfo: null,

  // Loading State
  loadingDatabases: false,
  loadingTables: false,
  loadingSchema: false,
  loadingQuery: false,

  // Error State
  error: null,

  // Actions
  setDatabaseType: (type) => set({ databaseType: type, selectedDatabase: null, selectedTable: null, tableSchemas: {} }),
  setSelectedDatabase: (database) => set({ selectedDatabase: database, selectedTable: null, tableSchemas: {} }),
  setSelectedTable: (table) => set({ selectedTable: table }),
  setDatabases: (databases) => set({ databases }),
  setTables: (tables) => set({ tables }),

  // Server Management Actions
  setServers: (servers) => set({ servers }),
  setSelectedServer: (server) => set({
    selectedServer: server,
    selectedDatabase: null,
    selectedTable: null,
    databases: [],
    tables: [],
    tableSchemas: {},
    serverDatabases: [],
  }),
  setLoadingServers: (loading) => set({ loadingServers: loading }),
  setServerDatabases: (databases) => set({ serverDatabases: databases }),
  setLoadingServerDatabases: (loading) => set({ loadingServerDatabases: loading }),
  updateServerInList: (serverId, updates) => set((state) => ({
    servers: state.servers.map(s => s.id === serverId ? { ...s, ...updates } : s),
    selectedServer: state.selectedServer?.id === serverId
      ? { ...state.selectedServer, ...updates }
      : state.selectedServer,
  })),
  removeServerFromList: (serverId) => set((state) => ({
    servers: state.servers.filter(s => s.id !== serverId),
    selectedServer: state.selectedServer?.id === serverId ? null : state.selectedServer,
  })),
  setTableSchema: (schema) => set({ tableSchema: schema }),
  setTableSchemaForTable: (tableName, columns) =>
    set((state) => ({
      tableSchemas: { ...state.tableSchemas, [tableName]: columns },
    })),
  setQueryResult: (result) => set({ queryResult: result }),
  setResultFormat: (format) => set({ resultFormat: format }),
  setError: (error) => set({ error }),
  clearError: () => set({ error: null }),
  setDatabaseSearch: (search) => set({ databaseSearch: search }),
  setTableSearch: (search) => set({ tableSearch: search }),

  setLoadingDatabases: (loading) => set({ loadingDatabases: loading }),
  setLoadingTables: (loading) => set({ loadingTables: loading }),
  setLoadingSchema: (loading) => set({ loadingSchema: loading }),
  setLoadingQuery: (loading) => set({ loadingQuery: loading }),

  // Inline-editing actions
  toggleEditMode: () => {
    const current = get().editMode;
    if (current) {
      set({ editMode: false, editedCells: {}, selectedRows: new Set(), newRows: [] });
    } else {
      set({ editMode: true });
    }
  },
  setEditMode: (val) => set({ editMode: val }),

  setCellEdited: (rowIdx, colName, value) =>
    set((state) => ({
      editedCells: { ...state.editedCells, [`${rowIdx}-${colName}`]: value },
    })),

  toggleRowSelection: (rowIdx) =>
    set((state) => {
      const next = new Set(state.selectedRows);
      if (next.has(rowIdx)) next.delete(rowIdx);
      else next.add(rowIdx);
      return { selectedRows: next };
    }),

  selectAllRows: (totalRows) =>
    set((state) => {
      if (state.selectedRows.size === totalRows) return { selectedRows: new Set() };
      const all = new Set();
      for (let i = 0; i < totalRows; i++) all.add(i);
      return { selectedRows: all };
    }),

  addNewRow: (columns) => {
    const emptyRow = {};
    columns.forEach((col) => (emptyRow[col] = ''));
    set((state) => ({ newRows: [...state.newRows, emptyRow] }));
  },

  updateNewRow: (rowIdx, colName, value) =>
    set((state) => {
      const updated = [...state.newRows];
      updated[rowIdx] = { ...updated[rowIdx], [colName]: value };
      return { newRows: updated };
    }),

  removeNewRow: (rowIdx) =>
    set((state) => ({
      newRows: state.newRows.filter((_, i) => i !== rowIdx),
    })),

  clearEdits: () => set({ editedCells: {}, selectedRows: new Set(), newRows: [] }),
  setPrimaryKeys: (keys) => set({ primaryKeys: keys }),
  setSavingData: (val) => set({ savingData: val }),
  setLastQueryInfo: (info) => set({ lastQueryInfo: info }),

  // Pending query (set by AI Copilot, consumed by App → QueryEditor)
  pendingQuery: null,
  setPendingQuery: (q) => set({ pendingQuery: q }),
  consumePendingQuery: () => { const q = get().pendingQuery; set({ pendingQuery: null }); return q; },

  // Copilot origin tracking — tracks the original question + SQL when user clicks "Use"
  // so we can detect edits and send the corrected version back as a "gold" training example
  copilotOrigin: null, // { question, originalSql, database }
  setCopilotOrigin: (origin) => set({ copilotOrigin: origin }),
  clearCopilotOrigin: () => set({ copilotOrigin: null }),

  // Chatbot Actions
  toggleChatbot: () => set((state) => ({ chatbotOpen: !state.chatbotOpen })),
  openChatbot: () => set({ chatbotOpen: true }),
  closeChatbot: () => set({ chatbotOpen: false }),
  setChatMessages: (messages) => set({ chatMessages: messages }),
  addChatMessage: (message) => set((state) => ({
    chatMessages: [...state.chatMessages, message],
  })),
  clearChatMessages: () => set({ chatMessages: [] }),
  setChatLoading: (loading) => set({ chatLoading: loading }),

  addToQueryHistory: (query) => set((state) => {
    const newHistory = [
      { id: Date.now(), query, timestamp: new Date() },
      ...state.queryHistory.slice(0, 49),
    ];
    return { queryHistory: newHistory };
  }),

  addFavorite: (query) => {
    const state = get();
    if (state.favorites.find((fav) => fav.query === query || fav.query_text === query)) return;
    // Optimistic local update
    set({
      favorites: [
        { id: Date.now(), query, query_text: query, timestamp: new Date() },
        ...state.favorites,
      ],
    });
    // Persist to backend (fire-and-forget)
    sqlEditorAPI.addUserFavorite(query).then(res => {
      if (res.data?.success) {
        // Reload from backend to get real IDs
        get().loadFavorites();
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
  },

  removeFavorite: (id) => {
    set((state) => ({
      favorites: state.favorites.filter((fav) => fav.id !== id),
    }));
    // Persist to backend
    sqlEditorAPI.removeUserFavorite(id).catch(() => {});
  },

  clearQueryHistory: () => {
    set({ queryHistory: [] });
    sqlEditorAPI.clearUserHistory().catch(() => {});
  },

  // Load from backend on app start
  loadFavorites: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getUserFavorites();
      if (res.data?.success) {
        const favs = (res.data.favorites || []).map(f => ({
          ...f,
          query: f.query_text,
        }));
        set({ favorites: favs });
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  },

  loadHistory: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getUserHistory(50);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        const hist = (res.data.history || []).map(h => ({
          id: h.id,
          query: h.query_text,
          timestamp: h.created_at,
          database: h.database_name,
        }));
        set({ queryHistory: hist });
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  },
  clearQueryResult: () => set({ queryResult: null }),
}));






src/services/chatbot.js

import api from './api';

/**
 * Chatbot service for AI-powered SQL/BigQuery support
 */

/**
 * Send a message to the chatbot
 * @param {string} message - User message
 * @param {string} selectedQuery - Current SQL query (optional)
 * @param {string} database - Current database context (optional)
 * @param {string} table - Current table context (optional)
 * @param {string} action - Action type: 'chat', 'fix', 'enhance', 'suggest', 'explain'
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Chatbot response
 */
export const sendChatMessage = async (
  message,
  selectedQuery = null,
  database = null,
  table = null,
  action = 'chat'
) => {
  try {
    const response = await api.post('/api/chat', {
      message,
      selected_query: selectedQuery,
      database,
      table,
      action,
    });

    return response.data;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error sending chat message:', error);
    throw error;
  }
};

/**
 * Fix SQL query
 * @param {string} query - SQL query to fix
 * @param {string} database - Database context
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Fixed query and explanation
 */
export const fixQuery = async (query, database = null) => {
  return sendChatMessage(
    'Please fix this SQL query',
    query,
    database,
    null,
    'fix'
  );
};

/**
 * Enhance/optimize SQL query
 * @param {string} query - SQL query to enhance
 * @param {string} database - Database context
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Enhanced query and explanation
 */
export const enhanceQuery = async (query, database = null) => {
  return sendChatMessage(
    'Please enhance and optimize this SQL query',
    query,
    database,
    null,
    'enhance'
  );
};

/**
 * Get suggestions for SQL query
 * @param {string} query - SQL query
 * @param {string} database - Database context
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Suggestions and best practices
 */
export const getSuggestions = async (query, database = null) => {
  return sendChatMessage(
    'Please provide suggestions for this SQL query',
    query,
    database,
    null,
    'suggest'
  );
};

/**
 * Explain SQL query
 * @param {string} query - SQL query to explain
 * @param {string} database - Database context
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} Explanation of the query
 */
export const explainQuery = async (query, database = null) => {
  return sendChatMessage(
    'Please explain this SQL query',
    query,
    database,
    null,
    'explain'
  );
};

export default {
  sendChatMessage,
  fixQuery,
  enhanceQuery,
  getSuggestions,
  explainQuery,
};





src/services/api.js

import axios from 'axios';

const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'https://sqleditorapi.verizon.com';

const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  timeout: 300000, // 5 minutes
});

// Request interceptor — attach X-User-Id from localStorage
apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('sql_editor_user');
      if (stored) {
        const user = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (user?.vzid) {
          config.headers['X-User-Id'] = user.vzid;
        }
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

// Response interceptor
apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

/** Build Basic Auth header if username/password provided */
function authHeaders(username, password) {
  if (!username || !password) return {};
  return { Authorization: 'Basic ' + btoa(username + ':' + password) };
}

src/hooks/useDataMutation.js

import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../utils/helpers';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export const useDataMutation = () => {
  const {
    queryResult,
    editedCells,
    selectedRows,
    newRows,
    primaryKeys,
    databaseType,
    selectedDatabase,
    selectedTable,
    setSavingData,
    clearEdits,
    setEditMode,
    setQueryResult,
    setPrimaryKeys,
    addToQueryHistory,
    lastQueryInfo,
  } = useQueryStore();

  /**
   * Fetch primary-key columns for the current table.
   * Called when edit-mode is turned ON.
   */
  const fetchPrimaryKeys = async () => {
    if (!selectedDatabase || !selectedTable) return [];
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getPrimaryKey(
        selectedDatabase,
        selectedTable,
        databaseType,
      );
      const keys = res.data.primary_keys || [];
      setPrimaryKeys(keys);
      return keys;
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Could not detect primary key: ' + getErrorMessage(err));
      return [];
    }
  };

  /**
   * Build a map of  rowIdx -> { col: newVal }  from editedCells.
   */
  const getEditedRowMap = () => {
    const map = {};
    Object.entries(editedCells).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      const [rowIdx, ...colParts] = key.split('-');
      const col = colParts.join('-'); // in case col name has hyphens
      const idx = parseInt(rowIdx, 10);
      if (!map[idx]) map[idx] = {};
      map[idx][col] = value;
    });
    return map;
  };

  /**
   * Persist all edits (updates) to the database.
   */
  const saveEdits = async () => {
    const data = queryResult?.data || [];
    const pks = primaryKeys;
    if (!pks.length) {
      toast.error('No primary key detected – cannot save edits');
      return false;
    }

    const editedMap = getEditedRowMap();
    const entries = Object.entries(editedMap);
    if (!entries.length) {
      toast('No cells were modified');
      return true;
    }

    setSavingData(true);
    let successCount = 0;
    try {
      for (const [idxStr, updates] of entries) {
        const idx = parseInt(idxStr, 10);
        const row = data[idx];
        if (!row) continue;

        const pkObj = {};
        pks.forEach((pk) => (pkObj[pk] = row[pk]));

        await sqlEditorAPI.updateRow(
          selectedDatabase,
          selectedTable,
          pkObj,
          updates,
          databaseType,
        );
        successCount++;
      }
      toast.success(`${successCount} row(s) updated successfully`);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Update failed: ' + getErrorMessage(err));
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSavingData(false);
    }
  };

  /**
   * Insert new rows into the database.
   */
  const saveNewRows = async () => {
    if (!newRows.length) return true;
    setSavingData(true);
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.insertRows(
        selectedDatabase,
        selectedTable,
        newRows,
        databaseType,
      );
      toast.success(`${newRows.length} row(s) inserted successfully`);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Insert failed: ' + getErrorMessage(err));
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSavingData(false);
    }
  };

  /**
   * Delete selected rows from the database.
   */
  const deleteSelectedRows = async () => {
    const data = queryResult?.data || [];
    const pks = primaryKeys;
    if (!pks.length) {
      toast.error('No primary key detected – cannot delete rows');
      return false;
    }
    if (!selectedRows.size) {
      toast('No rows selected for deletion');
      return false;
    }

    const pkCol = pks[0]; // use first PK column
    const pkValues = [...selectedRows].map((idx) => data[idx]?.[pkCol]).filter(Boolean);

    if (!pkValues.length) {
      toast.error('Could not resolve primary key values');
      return false;
    }

    setSavingData(true);
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteRows(
        selectedDatabase,
        selectedTable,
        pkCol,
        pkValues,
        databaseType,
      );
      toast.success(`${pkValues.length} row(s) deleted successfully`);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Delete failed: ' + getErrorMessage(err));
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSavingData(false);
    }
  };

  /**
   * Master "Save All" – updates + inserts, then re-runs the query to refresh.
   */
  const saveAll = async () => {
    const editOk = await saveEdits();
    const insertOk = await saveNewRows();

    if (editOk && insertOk) {
      clearEdits();
      // re-run the last query to refresh data
      await refreshData();
    }
  };

  /**
   * Delete then refresh.
   */
  const deleteAndRefresh = async () => {
    const ok = await deleteSelectedRows();
    if (ok) {
      clearEdits();
      await refreshData();
    }
  };

  /**
   * Re-execute the original query to refresh the result set.
   */
  const refreshData = async () => {
    if (!queryResult?.query || !selectedDatabase) return;
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeQuery(
        selectedDatabase,
        queryResult.query,
        databaseType,
      );
      if (res.data.success) {
        setQueryResult(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Refresh failed: ' + getErrorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  return {
    fetchPrimaryKeys,
    saveEdits,
    saveNewRows,
    saveAll,
    deleteSelectedRows,
    deleteAndRefresh,
    refreshData,
  };
};







src/hooks/useDatabase.js

import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../utils/helpers';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export const useDatabaseOperations = () => {
  const {
    setDatabases,
    setLoadingDatabases,
    setError,
    clearError,
    setSelectedDatabase,
    setTables,
    setLoadingTables,
    setTableSchema,
    setTableSchemaForTable,
    setLoadingSchema,
  } = useQueryStore();

  const fetchDatabases = async (type = 'cloudsql', search = '') => {
    setLoadingDatabases(true);
    clearError();
    try {
      const response = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases(type, search);
      setDatabases(response.data.databases);
      return response.data.databases;
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
      setError(errorMsg);
      toast.error(errorMsg);
      return [];
    } finally {
      setLoadingDatabases(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchTables = async (database, type = 'cloudsql', search = '') => {
    setLoadingTables(true);
    clearError();
    try {
      const response = await sqlEditorAPI.listTables(database, type, search);
      setTables(response.data.tables);
      setSelectedDatabase(database);
      return response.data.tables;
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
      setError(errorMsg);
      toast.error(errorMsg);
      return [];
    } finally {
      setLoadingTables(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchTableSchema = async (database, tableName, type = 'cloudsql') => {
    setLoadingSchema(true);
    clearError();
    try {
      const response = await sqlEditorAPI.getTableSchema(database, tableName, type);
      const columns = response.data.columns;
      setTableSchema(columns);
      setTableSchemaForTable(tableName, columns);
      return columns;
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
      setError(errorMsg);
      toast.error(errorMsg);
      return [];
    } finally {
      setLoadingSchema(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    fetchDatabases,
    fetchTables,
    fetchTableSchema,
  };
};

export const useQueryOperations = () => {
  const { databaseType, selectedServer, setQueryResult, setLoadingQuery, setError, clearError, addToQueryHistory } = useQueryStore();

  const executeQuery = async (database, query, limit = null) => {
    setLoadingQuery(true);
    clearError();
    try {
      let response;

      // If a custom (non-default) server is selected, route through the server endpoint
      if (selectedServer && !selectedServer.is_default) {
        response = await sqlEditorAPI.executeServerQuery(
          selectedServer.id,
          database || selectedServer.database,
          query,
          limit
        );
      } else {
        response = await sqlEditorAPI.executeQuery(database, query, databaseType, limit);
      }

      if (response.data.success) {
        setQueryResult(response.data);
        addToQueryHistory(query);
        const serverLabel = (selectedServer && !selectedServer.is_default)
          ? ` on ${selectedServer.name}`
          : '';
        toast.success(`Query executed successfully - ${response.data.row_count} rows returned${serverLabel}`);
        return response.data;
      } else {
        const errorMsg = response.data.message || 'Query execution failed';
        setError(errorMsg);
        toast.error(errorMsg);
        return null;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
      setError(errorMsg);
      toast.error(errorMsg);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLoadingQuery(false);
    }
  };

  return { executeQuery };
};






src/context/AuthContext.jsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(() => {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('sql_editor_user');
    if (stored) {
      try { return JSON.parse(stored); } catch { return null; }
    }
    return null;
  });

  const login = useCallback((vzid) => {
    const u = { vzid: vzid.trim().toLowerCase(), loginAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    localStorage.setItem('sql_editor_user', JSON.stringify(u));
    setUser(u);
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    localStorage.removeItem('sql_editor_user');
    setUser(null);
  }, []);

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, logout, isLoggedIn: !!user }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAuth() {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used within AuthProvider');
  return ctx;
}

export default AuthContext;



src/components/VisualQueryBuilder.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import {

import { useQueryStore } from '../store/queryStore';

// ── Operator options for WHERE conditions ────────────────────────────
const OPERATORS = [

  { value: 'NOT IN', label: 'NOT IN' },
  { value: 'IS NULL', label: 'IS NULL' },
  { value: 'IS NOT NULL', label: 'IS NOT NULL' },
  { value: 'BETWEEN', label: 'BETWEEN' },
  { value: 'IN_SUBQUERY', label: 'IN (Subquery)' },
  { value: 'NOT_IN_SUBQUERY', label: 'NOT IN (Subquery)' },

];

const JOIN_TYPES = ['INNER', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT', 'FULL', 'CROSS'];
const AGG_FUNCTIONS = ['', 'COUNT', 'SUM', 'AVG', 'MIN', 'MAX', 'STRING_AGG', 'ARRAY_AGG'];
const SORT_DIRS = ['ASC', 'DESC'];

// ── VisualQueryBuilder Component ─────────────────────────────────────
export default function VisualQueryBuilder({ database, onUseQuery, onClose }) {
  const { selectedDatabase, databaseType, selectedServer, servers } = useQueryStore();
  const db = database || selectedDatabase;

  // ── Data state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [tables, setTables] = useState([]);
  const [tableColumns, setTableColumns] = useState({}); // { 'schema.table': [...columns] }
  const [loadingTables, setLoadingTables] = useState(false);
  const [loadingColumns, setLoadingColumns] = useState(new Set());

  // ── Builder state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [baseTable, setBaseTable] = useState('');
  const [baseSchema, setBaseSchema] = useState('public');
  const [baseAlias, setBaseAlias] = useState('');
  const [selectedColumns, setSelectedColumns] = useState([]); // [{ table, schema, column, alias, agg, checked }]
  const [joins, setJoins] = useState([]); // [{ id, type, table, schema, alias, sourceCol, targetCol }]
  const [conditions, setConditions] = useState([]); // [{ id, column, operator, value, connector }]
  const [groupByColumns, setGroupByColumns] = useState([]); // [{ table, column }]
  const [havingConditions, setHavingConditions] = useState([]); // [{ id, agg, column, operator, value, connector }]
  const [orderByColumns, setOrderByColumns] = useState([]); // [{ column, direction }]
  const [limitValue, setLimitValue] = useState(100);
  const [offsetValue, setOffsetValue] = useState(0);
  const [distinct, setDistinct] = useState(false);
  const [unionBlocks, setUnionBlocks] = useState([]); // [{ id, operator, table, schema, columns, where_col, where_op, where_val }]

  // ── Query execution state ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const [queryResults, setQueryResults] = useState(null); // { data, columns, row_count, execution_time_ms }
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const [queryError, setQueryError] = useState('');
  const [resultsPage, setResultsPage] = useState(0);
  const RESULTS_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

  // ── UI state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState({
    dataSources: true, tables: true, columns: true, joins: false, where: false, groupBy: false, having: false, orderBy: false, limit: true, setOps: false,
  });
  const [tableSearch, setTableSearch] = useState('');
  const [columnSearch, setColumnSearch] = useState('');
  const [previewMode, setPreviewMode] = useState(true);

  // ── Multi-Database Sources ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const [dataSources, setDataSources] = useState([]); // [{ id, database, dbType, label }]
  const [showAddSource, setShowAddSource] = useState(false);
  const [addSourceType, setAddSourceType] = useState('cloudsql');
  const [addSourceDbs, setAddSourceDbs] = useState([]);
  const [addSourceSearch, setAddSourceSearch] = useState('');
  const [loadingAddDbs, setLoadingAddDbs] = useState(false);
  const [baseDatabase, setBaseDatabase] = useState('');
  const [baseDbType, setBaseDbType] = useState('');

  // Auto-add the current global database as default source
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!db) return;
    const globalDbType = selectedServer ? `server:${selectedServer.id}` : databaseType || 'cloudsql';
    setDataSources(prev => {
      const exists = prev.some(s => s.database === db && s.dbType === globalDbType);
      if (exists) return prev;
      // Replace or add default source
      const defaultSource = { id: 'default', database: db, dbType: globalDbType, label: db };
      const others = prev.filter(s => s.id !== 'default');
      return [defaultSource, ...others];
    });
  }, [db, databaseType, selectedServer]);

  // Load databases for the add-source modal
  const loadAddSourceDbs = useCallback(async (type) => {
    setLoadingAddDbs(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases(type);
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setAddSourceDbs(body.databases || []);
    } catch { setAddSourceDbs([]); }
    setLoadingAddDbs(false);
  }, []);

  const addDataSource = (dbName) => {
    const sourceId = `${addSourceType}-${dbName}-${Date.now()}`;
    const newSource = { id: sourceId, database: dbName, dbType: addSourceType, label: dbName };
    setDataSources(prev => {
      if (prev.some(s => s.database === dbName && s.dbType === addSourceType)) return prev;
      return [...prev, newSource];
    });
    setShowAddSource(false);
    setAddSourceSearch('');
  };

  const removeDataSource = (sourceId) => {
    setDataSources(prev => prev.filter(s => s.id !== sourceId));
    // If removed DB's tables were selected, clear them
  };

  const filteredAddDbs = useMemo(() => {
    if (!addSourceSearch) return addSourceDbs;
    const q = addSourceSearch.toLowerCase();
    return addSourceDbs.filter(d => {
      const name = typeof d === 'string' ? d : (d.database_name || d.name || d.dataset_id || '');
      return name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    });
  }, [addSourceDbs, addSourceSearch]);

  const getDbNameFromObj = (d) => typeof d === 'string' ? d : (d.database_name || d.name || d.dataset_id || '');

  // ── Fetch tables from all data sources ─────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dataSources.length === 0) return;
    (async () => {
      setLoadingTables(true);
      try {
        const allTables = [];
        for (const source of dataSources) {
          try {
            let result = [];
            if (source.dbType.startsWith('server:')) {
              const serverId = source.dbType.replace('server:', '');
              const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServerTables(serverId, source.database);
              result = (res.data.tables || []).map(t => ({
                name: t.table_name || t.name,
                schema: t.schema_name || t.schema || 'public',
                database: source.database,
                dbType: source.dbType,
              }));
            } else {
              const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listTables(source.database, source.dbType);
              result = (res.data.tables || []).map(t => ({
                name: t.table_name || t.name,
                schema: t.schema_name || t.schema || 'public',
                database: source.database,
                dbType: source.dbType,
              }));
            }
            allTables.push(...result);
          } catch { /* skip failed source */ }
        }
        setTables(allTables);
      } catch { setTables([]); }
      setLoadingTables(false);
    })();
  }, [dataSources]);

  // ── Fetch columns for a table ──────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchColumns = useCallback(async (tableName, schemaName = 'public', colDb = null, colDbType = null) => {
    const effectiveDb = colDb || baseDatabase || db;
    const effectiveDbType = colDbType || baseDbType || (selectedServer ? `server:${selectedServer.id}` : databaseType || 'cloudsql');
    const key = `${schemaName}.${tableName}`;
    if (tableColumns[key] || loadingColumns.has(key)) return;
    setLoadingColumns(prev => new Set([...prev, key]));
    try {
      let columns = [];
      if (effectiveDbType.startsWith('server:')) {
        const serverId = effectiveDbType.replace('server:', '');
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getServerTableSchema(serverId, effectiveDb, tableName, schemaName);
        columns = res.data.columns || [];
      } else {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getTableSchema(effectiveDb, tableName, effectiveDbType, schemaName);
        columns = res.data.columns || [];
      }
      setTableColumns(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: columns }));
    } catch { /* silent */ }
    setLoadingColumns(prev => { const n = new Set(prev); n.delete(key); return n; });
  }, [db, baseDatabase, baseDbType, databaseType, selectedServer, tableColumns, loadingColumns]);

  // ── Auto-fetch columns when base table changes ─────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (baseTable) fetchColumns(baseTable, baseSchema, baseDatabase, baseDbType);
  }, [baseTable, baseSchema, baseDatabase, baseDbType]);

  // ── Auto-fetch columns for join tables ─────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    joins.forEach(j => { if (j.table) fetchColumns(j.table, j.schema || 'public', j.database, j.dbType); });
  }, [joins]);

  // ── Get all available columns (base table + joins) ─────────────────
  const allAvailableColumns = useMemo(() => {
    const cols = [];
    if (baseTable) {
      const key = `${baseSchema}.${baseTable}`;
      (tableColumns[key] || []).forEach(c => {
        cols.push({
          table: baseTable,
          schema: baseSchema,
          alias: baseAlias,
          column: c.column_name || c.name,
          dataType: c.data_type || c.type || '',
          isNullable: c.is_nullable === 'YES',
          source: 'base',
        });
      });
    }
    joins.forEach(j => {
      if (!j.table) return;
      const key = `${j.schema || 'public'}.${j.table}`;
      (tableColumns[key] || []).forEach(c => {
        cols.push({
          table: j.table,
          schema: j.schema || 'public',
          alias: j.alias || '',
          column: c.column_name || c.name,
          dataType: c.data_type || c.type || '',
          isNullable: c.is_nullable === 'YES',
          source: 'join',
          joinId: j.id,
        });
      });
    });
    return cols;
  }, [baseTable, baseSchema, baseAlias, joins, tableColumns]);

  // ── Filtered tables for search ─────────────────────────────────────
  const filteredTables = useMemo(() => {
    if (!tableSearch) return tables;
    const q = tableSearch.toLowerCase();
    return tables.filter(t => t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (t.schema || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (t.database || '').toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [tables, tableSearch]);

  // Whether multiple databases are in use
  const isMultiDb = useMemo(() => {
    const dbs = new Set(dataSources.map(s => `${s.dbType}::${s.database}`));
    return dbs.size > 1;
  }, [dataSources]);

  // ── Section toggle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const toggleSection = (sec) => setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, [sec]: !prev[sec] }));

  // ── Handle base table selection ────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSelectBaseTable = (t) => {
    setBaseTable(t.name);
    setBaseSchema(t.schema || 'public');
    setBaseDatabase(t.database || db);
    setBaseDbType(t.dbType || (selectedServer ? `server:${selectedServer.id}` : databaseType || 'cloudsql'));
    setBaseAlias('');
    setSelectedColumns([]);
    setJoins([]);
    setConditions([]);
    setGroupByColumns([]);
    setOrderByColumns([]);
  };

  // ── Column selection ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const toggleColumn = (col) => {
    setSelectedColumns(prev => {
      const exists = prev.find(c => c.table === col.table && c.column === col.column && c.schema === col.schema);
      if (exists) return prev.filter(c => !(c.table === col.table && c.column === col.column && c.schema === col.schema));
      return [...prev, { table: col.table, schema: col.schema, column: col.column, alias: '', agg: '', checked: true }];
    });
  };

  const isColumnSelected = (col) => {
    return selectedColumns.some(c => c.table === col.table && c.column === col.column && c.schema === col.schema);
  };

  const selectAllColumns = () => {
    if (selectedColumns.length === allAvailableColumns.length) {
      setSelectedColumns([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedColumns(allAvailableColumns.map(c => ({
        table: c.table, schema: c.schema, column: c.column, alias: '', agg: '', checked: true,
      })));
    }
  };

  const updateColumnConfig = (index, field, value) => {
    setSelectedColumns(prev => prev.map((c, i) => i === index ? { ...c, [field]: value } : c));
  };

  // ── Join management ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const addJoin = () => {
    setJoins(prev => [...prev, {
      id: Date.now().toString(36),
      type: 'INNER',
      table: '',
      schema: 'public',
      database: '',
      dbType: '',
      alias: '',
      sourceCol: '',
      targetCol: '',
    }]);
    setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, joins: true }));
  };

  const updateJoin = (index, field, value) => {
    setJoins(prev => prev.map((j, i) => i === index ? { ...j, [field]: value } : j));
  };

  const removeJoin = (index) => {
    const removed = joins[index];
    setJoins(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    // Remove columns from the removed join table
    if (removed?.table) {
      setSelectedColumns(prev => prev.filter(c => c.table !== removed.table));
    }
  };

  // ── Condition management ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const addCondition = () => {
    setConditions(prev => [...prev, {
      id: Date.now().toString(36),
      column: '',
      operator: '=',
      value: '',
      connector: prev.length > 0 ? 'AND' : '',
      subquery: { table: '', schema: 'public', column: '', where_col: '', where_op: '=', where_val: '' },
    }]);
    setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, where: true }));
  };

  const updateCondition = (index, field, value) => {
    setConditions(prev => prev.map((c, i) => i === index ? { ...c, [field]: value } : c));
  };

  const updateConditionSubquery = (index, field, value) => {
    setConditions(prev => prev.map((c, i) =>
      i === index ? { ...c, subquery: { ...c.subquery, [field]: value } } : c
    ));
  };

  const removeCondition = (index) => {
    setConditions(prev => {
      const next = prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
      if (next.length > 0) next[0] = { ...next[0], connector: '' };
      return next;
    });
  };

  // ── Group By management ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const toggleGroupBy = (col) => {
    setGroupByColumns(prev => {
      const exists = prev.find(g => g.column === col.column && g.table === col.table);
      if (exists) return prev.filter(g => !(g.column === col.column && g.table === col.table));
      return [...prev, { table: col.table, column: col.column }];
    });
  };

  const isGroupBySelected = (col) =>
    groupByColumns.some(g => g.column === col.column && g.table === col.table);

  // ── Having management ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const addHavingCondition = () => {
    setHavingConditions(prev => [...prev, {
      id: Date.now(), agg: 'COUNT', column: '*', operator: '>', value: '', connector: prev.length > 0 ? 'AND' : '',
    }]);
    setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, having: true }));
  };

  const updateHavingCondition = (id, field, value) => {
    setHavingConditions(prev => prev.map(h => h.id === id ? { ...h, [field]: value } : h));
  };

  const removeHavingCondition = (id) => {
    setHavingConditions(prev => {
      const next = prev.filter(h => h.id !== id);
      if (next.length > 0) next[0] = { ...next[0], connector: '' };
      return next;
    });
  };

  // ── Order By management ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const addOrderBy = () => {
    setOrderByColumns(prev => [...prev, { column: '', direction: 'ASC' }]);
    setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, orderBy: true }));
  };

  const updateOrderBy = (index, field, value) => {
    setOrderByColumns(prev => prev.map((o, i) => i === index ? { ...o, [field]: value } : o));
  };

  const removeOrderBy = (index) => {
    setOrderByColumns(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  // ── Set operation (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT) management ──────────────
  const addUnionBlock = () => {
    setUnionBlocks(prev => [...prev, {
      id: Date.now(), operator: 'UNION', table: '', schema: 'public',
      database: '', dbType: '',
      columns: '', where_col: '', where_op: '=', where_val: '',
    }]);
    setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, setOps: true }));
  };

  const updateUnionBlock = (id, field, value) => {
    setUnionBlocks(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === id ? { ...b, [field]: value } : b));
  };

  const removeUnionBlock = (id) => {
    setUnionBlocks(prev => prev.filter(b => b.id !== id));
  };

  // ── Column reference builder ───────────────────────────────────────
  const colRef = useCallback((table, column, useAlias = true) => {
    // If only base table, no need for qualifier
    if (joins.length === 0) return column;
    // Use alias if set, otherwise table name
    const tableEntry = table === baseTable
      ? { alias: baseAlias, name: baseTable }
      : joins.find(j => j.table === table) || { alias: '', name: table };
    const prefix = useAlias && tableEntry.alias ? tableEntry.alias : tableEntry.name || table;
    return `${prefix}.${column}`;
  }, [baseTable, baseAlias, joins]);

  // ── Generate SQL ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const generatedSQL = useMemo(() => {
    if (!baseTable) return '-- Select a table to begin building your query';

    // Helper: fully-qualify a table name when multi-db is active
    // Helper: resolve actual db engine type from a dbType value (may be 'server:id')
    const resolveEngineType = (dbTypeVal) => {
      if (dbTypeVal?.startsWith('server:')) {
        const srvId = dbTypeVal.replace('server:', '');
        const srv = (servers || []).find(s => s.id === srvId);
        return srv?.db_type || (selectedServer?.db_type) || 'cloudsql';
      }
      return dbTypeVal || 'cloudsql';
    };

    const qualifyTable = (tableName, schemaName, database, dbTypeVal) => {
      if (isMultiDb && database) {
        // For BigQuery: database.schema.table or database.table
        const effectiveType = resolveEngineType(dbTypeVal);
        if (effectiveType === 'bigquery') {
          return `\`${database}.${schemaName || 'public'}.${tableName}\``;
        }
        // For CloudSQL with different databases, prefix with database
        if (database !== baseDatabase) {
          return schemaName && schemaName !== 'public'
            ? `${database}.${schemaName}.${tableName}`
            : `${database}.${tableName}`;
        }
      }
      // Same database or single-db mode — just schema.table
      return schemaName && schemaName !== 'public' ? `${schemaName}.${tableName}` : tableName;
    };

    const parts = [];

    // SELECT
    let selectPart = 'SELECT';
    if (distinct) selectPart += ' DISTINCT';

    if (selectedColumns.length === 0) {
      selectPart += ' *';
    } else {
      const colParts = selectedColumns.map(c => {
        let expr = colRef(c.table, c.column);
        if (c.agg) expr = `${c.agg}(${expr})`;
        if (c.alias) expr += ` AS ${c.alias}`;
        return expr;
      });
      selectPart += '\n  ' + colParts.join(',\n  ');
    }
    parts.push(selectPart);

    // FROM
    let fromPart = `FROM ${qualifyTable(baseTable, baseSchema, baseDatabase, baseDbType)}`;
    if (baseAlias) fromPart += ` ${baseAlias}`;
    parts.push(fromPart);

    // JOINs
    joins.forEach(j => {
      if (!j.table) return;
      const qualifiedJoinTable = qualifyTable(j.table, j.schema, j.database, j.dbType);
      let joinStr = `${j.type} JOIN ${qualifiedJoinTable}`;
      if (j.alias) joinStr += ` ${j.alias}`;
      if (j.sourceCol && j.targetCol && j.type !== 'CROSS') {
        const srcRef = baseAlias || baseTable;
        const tgtRef = j.alias || j.table;
        joinStr += ` ON ${srcRef}.${j.sourceCol} = ${tgtRef}.${j.targetCol}`;
      }
      parts.push(joinStr);
    });

    // WHERE
    if (conditions.length > 0) {
      const condParts = conditions.filter(c => c.column || c.operator === 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY').map((c, i) => {
        let expr = c.column;
        const op = c.operator;
        if (op === 'IS NULL' || op === 'IS NOT NULL') {
          expr += ` ${op}`;
        } else if (op === 'IN' || op === 'NOT IN') {
          const vals = c.value.split(',').map(v => `'${v.trim()}'`).join(', ');
          expr += ` ${op} (${vals})`;
        } else if (op === 'BETWEEN') {
          const vals = c.value.split(',').map(v => v.trim());
          expr += ` BETWEEN ${vals[0] || '?'} AND ${vals[1] || '?'}`;
        } else if (op === 'IN_SUBQUERY' || op === 'NOT_IN_SUBQUERY') {
          const sq = c.subquery || {};
          const sqOp = op === 'IN_SUBQUERY' ? 'IN' : 'NOT IN';
          const subSchema = sq.schema && sq.schema !== 'public' ? sq.schema + '.' : '';
          let subSql = `SELECT ${sq.column || '*'} FROM ${subSchema}${sq.table || '?'}`;
          if (sq.where_col && sq.where_val) {
            const needsQ = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(sq.where_val);
            subSql += ` WHERE ${sq.where_col} ${sq.where_op || '='} ${needsQ ? `'${sq.where_val}'` : sq.where_val}`;
          }
          expr += ` ${sqOp} (${subSql})`;
        } else if (op === 'EXISTS_SUBQUERY') {
          const sq = c.subquery || {};
          const subSchema = sq.schema && sq.schema !== 'public' ? sq.schema + '.' : '';
          let subSql = `SELECT 1 FROM ${subSchema}${sq.table || '?'}`;
          if (sq.where_col && sq.where_val) {
            const needsQ = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(sq.where_val);
            subSql += ` WHERE ${sq.where_col} ${sq.where_op || '='} ${needsQ ? `'${sq.where_val}'` : sq.where_val}`;
          }
          expr = `EXISTS (${subSql})`;
        } else {
          const needsQuotes = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(c.value) && c.value.toLowerCase() !== 'true' && c.value.toLowerCase() !== 'false';
          expr += ` ${op} ${needsQuotes ? `'${c.value}'` : c.value}`;
        }
        return i > 0 ? `${c.connector || 'AND'} ${expr}` : expr;
      });
      if (condParts.length > 0) {
        parts.push('WHERE ' + condParts.join('\n  '));
      }
    }

    // GROUP BY
    if (groupByColumns.length > 0) {
      const groupParts = groupByColumns.map(g => colRef(g.table, g.column));
      parts.push('GROUP BY ' + groupParts.join(', '));
    }

    // HAVING
    if (havingConditions.length > 0 && groupByColumns.length > 0) {
      const havParts = havingConditions.filter(h => h.column).map((h, i) => {
        let expr = h.agg ? `${h.agg}(${h.column})` : h.column;
        const op = h.operator;
        if (op === 'IS NULL' || op === 'IS NOT NULL') {
          expr += ` ${op}`;
        } else {
          const needsQuotes = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(h.value) && h.value.toLowerCase() !== 'true' && h.value.toLowerCase() !== 'false';
          expr += ` ${op} ${needsQuotes ? `'${h.value}'` : h.value}`;
        }
        return i > 0 ? `${h.connector || 'AND'} ${expr}` : expr;
      });
      if (havParts.length > 0) {
        parts.push('HAVING ' + havParts.join('\n  '));
      }
    }

    // ORDER BY
    if (orderByColumns.length > 0) {
      const orderParts = orderByColumns.filter(o => o.column).map(o => `${o.column} ${o.direction}`);
      if (orderParts.length > 0) parts.push('ORDER BY ' + orderParts.join(', '));
    }

    // LIMIT / OFFSET — use TOP for MSSQL
    const engineType = resolveEngineType(baseDbType);
    if (limitValue > 0) {
      if (engineType === 'mssql') {
        // For MSSQL, inject TOP N after SELECT in the first part
        if (parts.length > 0 && parts[0].startsWith('SELECT')) {
          parts[0] = parts[0].replace(/^SELECT/i, `SELECT TOP ${limitValue}`);
        }
      } else {
        parts.push(`LIMIT ${limitValue}`);
      }
    }
    if (offsetValue > 0) {
      if (engineType === 'mssql') {
        // MSSQL uses OFFSET/FETCH (requires ORDER BY)
        if (orderByColumns.length > 0) {
          parts.push(`OFFSET ${offsetValue} ROWS`);
        }
      } else {
        parts.push(`OFFSET ${offsetValue}`);
      }
    }

    // UNION / INTERSECT / EXCEPT
    unionBlocks.forEach(block => {
      if (!block.table) return;
      const qualifiedUnionTable = qualifyTable(block.table, block.schema, block.database, block.dbType);
      let blockSql = `\n${block.operator}\n\nSELECT ${block.columns || '*'}\nFROM ${qualifiedUnionTable}`;
      if (block.where_col && block.where_val) {
        const needsQ = !/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(block.where_val);
        blockSql += `\nWHERE ${block.where_col} ${block.where_op || '='} ${needsQ ? `'${block.where_val}'` : block.where_val}`;
      }
      parts.push(blockSql);
    });

    return parts.join('\n');
  }, [baseTable, baseSchema, baseDatabase, baseDbType, baseAlias, selectedColumns, joins, conditions, groupByColumns, havingConditions, orderByColumns, limitValue, offsetValue, distinct, colRef, unionBlocks, isMultiDb]);

  // ── Actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleUseQuery = () => {
    if (onUseQuery) onUseQuery(generatedSQL);
    toast.success('Query applied to editor!');
  };

  const handleCopySQL = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatedSQL);
    toast.success('SQL copied to clipboard!');
  };

  // ── Run query directly ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleRunQuery = async () => {
    if (!baseTable || (!baseDatabase && !db)) return;
    setIsRunning(true);
    setQueryError('');
    setQueryResults(null);
    setResultsPage(0);
    try {
      const execDb = baseDatabase || db;
      const execDbType = baseDbType || databaseType || 'cloudsql';
      const actualType = execDbType.startsWith('server:') ? execDbType : execDbType;
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeQuery(execDb, generatedSQL, actualType);
      const result = res.data;
      if (result.success) {
        setQueryResults(result);
        toast.success(`Query returned ${result.row_count} row${result.row_count !== 1 ? 's' : ''} in ${result.execution_time_ms}ms`);
      } else {
        setQueryError(result.message || 'Query failed');
        toast.error(result.message || 'Query failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Execution failed';
      setQueryError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    }
    setIsRunning(false);
  };

  const handleDownloadCSV = () => {
    if (!queryResults?.data?.length) return;
    const cols = queryResults.columns;
    const rows = queryResults.data;
    const csvLines = [cols.join(',')];
    rows.forEach(row => {
      csvLines.push(cols.map(c => {
        const val = row[c];
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
        const s = String(val);
        return s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n') ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
      }).join(','));
    });
    const blob = new Blob([csvLines.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `vqb_results_${Date.now()}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast.success('CSV downloaded!');
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setBaseTable('');
    setBaseSchema('public');
    setBaseDatabase('');
    setBaseDbType('');
    setBaseAlias('');
    setSelectedColumns([]);
    setJoins([]);
    setConditions([]);
    setGroupByColumns([]);
    setHavingConditions([]);
    setOrderByColumns([]);
    setLimitValue(100);
    setOffsetValue(0);
    setDistinct(false);
    setUnionBlocks([]);
  };

  // ── Import SQL → VQB (Reverse Parse) ──────────────────────────────
  const [showImportModal, setShowImportModal] = useState(false);
  const [importSQL, setImportSQL] = useState('');
  const [importLoading, setImportLoading] = useState(false);

  // ── Drag-and-drop column reordering ────────────────────────────────
  const [dragColIdx, setDragColIdx] = useState(null);

  const handleColDragStart = (idx) => (e) => {
    setDragColIdx(idx);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', idx.toString());
  };

  const handleColDragOver = (idx) => (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
  };

  const handleColDrop = (dropIdx) => (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (dragColIdx === null || dragColIdx === dropIdx) { setDragColIdx(null); return; }
    setSelectedColumns(prev => {
      const next = [...prev];
      const [moved] = next.splice(dragColIdx, 1);
      next.splice(dropIdx, 0, moved);
      return next;
    });
    setDragColIdx(null);
  };

  const handleColDragEnd = () => setDragColIdx(null);

  const handleImportSQL = async () => {
    if (!importSQL.trim()) { toast.error('Enter a SQL query to import'); return; }
    setImportLoading(true);
    try {
      const dbType = selectedServer ? `server:${selectedServer.id}` : databaseType || 'cloudsql';
      const effectiveType = dbType.startsWith('server:') ? (selectedServer?.db_type || 'cloudsql') : dbType;
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.parseQuery(db, importSQL.trim(), effectiveType);
      const parsed = res.data;
      if (!parsed.success || !parsed.table_name) {
        toast.error(parsed.error || 'Could not parse SQL — no table found');
        setImportLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Reset first
      handleReset();

      // Set base table
      setBaseTable(parsed.table_name);
      setBaseSchema(parsed.schema_name || 'public');
      if (parsed.base_table_alias) setBaseAlias(parsed.base_table_alias);

      // Fetch columns for the base table
      await fetchColumns(parsed.table_name, parsed.schema_name || 'public');

      // Populate joins
      if (parsed.joins && parsed.joins.length > 0) {
        const mappedJoins = parsed.joins.map((j, i) => {
          // Fetch columns for joined tables too
          fetchColumns(j.target_table, parsed.schema_name || 'public');
          return {
            id: Date.now() + i,
            type: (j.join_type || 'INNER').replace(' JOIN', '').replace(' OUTER', '').trim(),
            table: j.target_table,
            schema: parsed.schema_name || 'public',
            alias: j.alias || '',
            sourceCol: j.source_column || '',
            targetCol: j.target_column || '',
          };
        });
        setJoins(mappedJoins);
        setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, joins: true }));
      }

      // Populate selected columns
      if (parsed.columns_used && parsed.columns_used.length > 0) {
        const cols = parsed.columns_used.map(col => {
          const aliasEntry = (parsed.select_column_aliases || []).find(a => a.expr === col);
          return {
            table: col.includes('.') ? col.split('.')[0] : parsed.table_name,
            schema: parsed.schema_name || 'public',
            column: col.includes('.') ? col.split('.').slice(1).join('.') : col,
            alias: aliasEntry ? aliasEntry.output_alias : '',
            agg: '',
            checked: true,
          };
        });
        setSelectedColumns(cols);
      }

      // Populate WHERE conditions
      if (parsed.where_conditions && parsed.where_conditions.length > 0) {
        const conds = parsed.where_conditions.map((wc, i) => ({
          id: Date.now().toString(36) + i,
          column: wc.column,
          operator: wc.operator === 'RAW' ? '=' : wc.operator,
          value: wc.value || '',
          connector: i > 0 ? 'AND' : '',
          subquery: { table: '', schema: 'public', column: '', where_col: '', where_op: '=', where_val: '' },
        }));
        setConditions(conds);
        setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, where: true }));
      }

      setShowImportModal(false);
      setImportSQL('');
      toast.success(`Imported: ${parsed.table_name}${parsed.joins?.length ? ` + ${parsed.joins.length} join(s)` : ''}${parsed.where_conditions?.length ? ` + ${parsed.where_conditions.length} condition(s)` : ''}`, { duration: 4000 });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Parse failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'));
    }
    setImportLoading(false);
  };

  // ── Column list for dropdowns (fully qualified) ────────────────────
  const columnDropdownOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return allAvailableColumns.map(c => ({
      value: colRef(c.table, c.column),
      label: joins.length > 0 ? `${c.alias || c.table}.${c.column}` : c.column,
      dataType: c.dataType,
    }));
  }, [allAvailableColumns, colRef, joins]);

  // ── Get columns for a specific table ───────────────────────────────
  const getTableColumns = useCallback((tableName, schemaName = 'public') => {
    const key = `${schemaName}.${tableName}`;
    return tableColumns[key] || [];
  }, [tableColumns]);

  // ── Section header component ───────────────────────────────────────
  const SectionHeader = ({ section, icon: Icon, label, count, action, actionIcon: ActionIcon, actionLabel }) => (
    <div className="vqb-section-header" onClick={() => toggleSection(section)}>
      <div className="vqb-section-title">
        {expandedSections[section] ? <ChevronDown size={14} /> : <ChevronRight size={14} />}
        <Icon size={15} />
        <span>{label}</span>
        {count > 0 && <span className="vqb-badge">{count}</span>}
      </div>
      {action && (
        <button className="vqb-section-action" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); action(); }} title={actionLabel}>
          <ActionIcon size={13} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="vqb-container">
      {/* ── Left Panel: Builder Controls ─────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="vqb-panel vqb-controls">
        <div className="vqb-controls-header">
          <div className="vqb-controls-title">
            <Layers size={16} />
            <span>Visual Query Builder</span>
          </div>
          <div className="vqb-controls-actions">
            <button className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowImportModal(true)} title="Import SQL → VQB">
              <Download size={13} /> Import
            </button>
            <button className="vqb-btn-sm vqb-btn-ghost" onClick={handleReset} title="Reset all">
              <RefreshCw size={13} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="vqb-controls-body">
          {/* ── 0. Data Sources ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader section="dataSources" icon={Database} label="Data Sources" count={dataSources.length} action={() => { setShowAddSource(true); loadAddSourceDbs(addSourceType); }} actionIcon={Plus} actionLabel="Add Database" />
          {expandedSections.dataSources && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {dataSources.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  <Database size={16} />
                  <span>No databases added</span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="vqb-source-list">
                  {dataSources.map(s => (
                    <div key={s.id} className="vqb-source-item">
                      <Database size={12} />
                      <span className="vqb-source-name">{s.database}</span>
                      <span className="vqb-source-type" style={{
                        background: s.dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'rgba(66,133,244,0.12)' : 'rgba(52,168,83,0.12)',
                        color: s.dbType === 'bigquery' ? '#4285f4' : '#34a853',
                      }}>
                        {s.dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'BQ' : s.dbType.startsWith('server:') ? 'Server' : 'CloudSQL'}
                      </span>
                      {s.id !== 'default' && (
                        <button className="vqb-btn-icon-sm danger" onClick={() => removeDataSource(s.id)} title="Remove source">
                          <X size={11} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 1. Table Selection ──────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader section="tables" icon={Table2} label="Base Table" count={baseTable ? 1 : 0} />
          {expandedSections.tables && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {dataSources.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">
                  <Database size={16} />
                  <span>Add a data source first</span>
                </div>
              ) : loadingTables ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty"><RefreshCw size={14} className="vqb-spin" /> Loading tables...</div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="vqb-search">
                    <Search size={13} />
                    <input placeholder="Search tables..." value={tableSearch} onChange={e => setTableSearch(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="vqb-table-list">
                    {filteredTables.map(t => (
                      <button
                        key={`${t.database}.${t.schema}.${t.name}`}
                        className={`vqb-table-item ${baseTable === t.name && baseSchema === (t.schema || 'public') && baseDatabase === t.database ? 'active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => handleSelectBaseTable(t)}
                      >
                        <Table2 size={13} />
                        <span className="vqb-table-name">{t.name}</span>
                        {t.schema && t.schema !== 'public' && <span className="vqb-table-schema">{t.schema}</span>}
                        {isMultiDb && t.database && (
                          <span className="vqb-table-db" style={{
                            fontSize: '0.6rem', padding: '1px 5px', borderRadius: 4, marginLeft: 'auto',
                            background: t.dbType === 'bigquery' ? 'rgba(66,133,244,0.1)' : 'rgba(52,168,83,0.1)',
                            color: t.dbType === 'bigquery' ? '#4285f4' : '#34a853',
                          }}>{t.database}</span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                    {filteredTables.length === 0 && <div className="vqb-empty">No tables found</div>}
                  </div>
                  {baseTable && (
                    <div className="vqb-alias-row">
                      <label>Alias:</label>
                      <input
                        placeholder="e.g. t1"
                        value={baseAlias}
                        onChange={e => setBaseAlias(e.target.value)}
                        className="vqb-input-sm"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── 2. Column Selection ────────────────────────────────── */}
          <SectionHeader
            section="columns"
            icon={Columns}
            label="Columns"
            count={selectedColumns.length}
          />
          {expandedSections.columns && (
            <div className="vqb-section-body">
              {!baseTable ? (
                <div className="vqb-empty">Select a base table first</div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="vqb-column-actions-bar">
                    <button className="vqb-btn-xs" onClick={selectAllColumns}>
                      {selectedColumns.length === allAvailableColumns.length ? <EyeOff size={12} /> : <Eye size={12} />}
                      {selectedColumns.length === allAvailableColumns.length ? 'Deselect All' : 'Select All'}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className={`vqb-btn-xs ${distinct ? 'active' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => setDistinct(!distinct)}
                      title="Toggle DISTINCT"
                    >
                      <ToggleRight size={12} /> DISTINCT
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="vqb-search">
                    <Search size={13} />
                    <input placeholder="Search columns..." value={columnSearch} onChange={e => setColumnSearch(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="vqb-column-list">
                    {allAvailableColumns
                      .filter(c => !columnSearch || c.column.toLowerCase().includes(columnSearch.toLowerCase()))
                      .map((col, i) => {
                        const selected = isColumnSelected(col);
                        const selIdx = selectedColumns.findIndex(s => s.table === col.table && s.column === col.column && s.schema === col.schema);
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={`${col.table}.${col.column}.${i}`}
                            className={`vqb-column-item ${selected ? 'selected' : ''} ${dragColIdx === selIdx && selected ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
                            draggable={selected}
                            onDragStart={selected ? handleColDragStart(selIdx) : undefined}
                            onDragOver={selected ? handleColDragOver(selIdx) : undefined}
                            onDrop={selected ? handleColDrop(selIdx) : undefined}
                            onDragEnd={selected ? handleColDragEnd : undefined}
                          >
                            <div className="vqb-column-main" onClick={() => toggleColumn(col)}>
                              {selected && (
                                <span style={{ cursor: 'grab', opacity: 0.4, marginRight: 2, display: 'flex' }} title="Drag to reorder">
                                  <GripVertical size={12} />
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <input type="checkbox" checked={selected} readOnly />
                              <span className="vqb-col-name">{col.column}</span>
                              <span className="vqb-col-type">{col.dataType}</span>
                              {joins.length > 0 && <span className="vqb-col-table">{col.alias || col.table}</span>}
                            </div>
                            {selected && (
                              <div className="vqb-column-config">
                                <select
                                  value={selectedColumns[selIdx]?.agg || ''}
                                  onChange={e => updateColumnConfig(selIdx, 'agg', e.target.value)}
