  const [loading, setLoading]         = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving]           = useState(false);
  const [running, setRunning]         = useState(false);
  const [expandedStep, setExpandedStep] = useState(null);
  const [showAddMenu, setShowAddMenu] = useState(false);
  const [servers, setServers]         = useState([]);
  const [buckets, setBuckets]         = useState([]);
  const [expandedRun, setExpandedRun] = useState(null);
  const [allHistory, setAllHistory]   = useState([]);
  const [loadingDashboard, setLoadingDashboard] = useState(false);
  const [topTab, setTopTab]           = useState('jobs'); // 'jobs' | 'pipelines' | 'cloudJobs'
  const [cloudJobs, setCloudJobs]     = useState([]);
  const [loadingCloudJobs, setLoadingCloudJobs] = useState(false);
  const [expandedCloudJob, setExpandedCloudJob] = useState(null);
  const [cloudJobExecs, setCloudJobExecs]       = useState({});
  const [editingCloudJob, setEditingCloudJob]   = useState(null);
  const [cloudJobEdits, setCloudJobEdits]       = useState({});
  const [cloudJobLogsFor, setCloudJobLogsFor]   = useState(null);
  const [cloudJobLogs, setCloudJobLogs]         = useState({});
  const [loadingLogs, setLoadingLogs]           = useState(false);
  const addMenuRef = useRef(null);

  /* ── effects ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  useEffect(() => { loadJobs(); loadExtras(); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = (e) => { if (addMenuRef.current && !addMenuRef.current.contains(e.target)) setShowAddMenu(false); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
  }, []);

  /* ── loaders ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const loadJobs = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listSchedulerJobs();
      setJobs(res.data.jobs || []);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load jobs'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const loadExtras = async () => {
    try {
      const [s, b] = await Promise.all([
        sqlEditorAPI.getSchedulerServers().catch(() => ({ data: { servers: [] } })),
        sqlEditorAPI.listGCSBuckets().catch(() => ({ data: { buckets: [] } })),
      ]);
      setServers(s.data.servers || []);
      setBuckets(b.data.buckets || []);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const loadCloudJobs = async () => {
    setLoadingCloudJobs(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listCloudJobs();
      setCloudJobs(res.data.jobs || []);
    } catch { setCloudJobs([]); }
    finally { setLoadingCloudJobs(false); }
  };

  /* ═══════════ Job CRUD ═══════════ */
  // Job Templates
  const JOB_TEMPLATES = [
    {
      name: 'API → DB Upsert (Daily)',
      description: 'Call an API with dynamic date payload and upsert response into a DB table',
      icon: '⚡',
      steps: [
        makeStep('api_call_upsert', 0),
      ],
      schedule_type: 'cron',
      schedule_config: { hour: 2, minute: 0, days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] },
    },
    {
      name: 'API → Database ETL',
      description: 'Fetch data from an API and load it into a database table',
      icon: '🔄',
      steps: [
        makeStep('api_call', 0),
        makeStep('db_mapping', 1),
      ],
      schedule_type: 'cron',
      schedule_config: { hour: 2, minute: 0, days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] },
    },
    {
      name: 'Database Sync',
      description: 'Transfer data between two databases (source → target)',
      icon: '🔁',
      steps: [
        makeStep('truncate_table', 0),
        makeStep('db_transfer', 1),
      ],
      schedule_type: 'cron',
      schedule_config: { hour: 1, minute: 0, days_of_week: [1,2,3,4,5] },
    },
    {
      name: 'Daily Report Email',
      description: 'Query data and send results via email',
      icon: '📧',
      steps: [
        makeStep('api_call', 0),
        makeStep('email_trigger', 1),
      ],
      schedule_type: 'cron',
      schedule_config: { hour: 8, minute: 0, days_of_week: [1,2,3,4,5] },
    },
    {
      name: 'GCS Backup Pipeline',
      description: 'Export data to GCS bucket for archival',
      icon: '☁️',
      steps: [
        makeStep('api_call', 0),
        makeStep('gcs_operation', 1),
      ],
      schedule_type: 'cron',
      schedule_config: { hour: 3, minute: 0, days_of_week: [0] },
    },
    {
      name: 'Conditional ETL',
      description: 'Check condition first, then ETL if condition is met',
      icon: '🔀',
      steps: [
        makeStep('api_call', 0),
        makeStep('conditional', 1),
        makeStep('db_mapping', 2),
      ],
      schedule_type: 'cron',
      schedule_config: { hour: 6, minute: 0, days_of_week: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] },
    },
    {
      name: 'Blank Job',
      description: 'Start from scratch with no pre-configured steps',
      icon: '📝',
      steps: [],
      schedule_type: 'manual',
      schedule_config: {},
    },
  ];

  const [showTemplates, setShowTemplates] = useState(false);

  const openNewJob = () => {
    setShowTemplates(true);
    setView('list');
  };

  const applyTemplate = (template) => {
    setForm({
      ...freshJob(),
      name: template.name === 'Blank Job' ? '' : template.name,
      description: template.description,
      schedule_type: template.schedule_type,
      schedule_config: template.schedule_config,
      steps: template.steps.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, id: uid(), order: i })),
    });
    setIsNew(true);
    setSelectedJobId(null);
    setExpandedStep(null);
    setShowTemplates(false);
    setView('edit');
    toast.success(`Template "${template.name}" applied`);
  };

  const openEditJob = async (job) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getSchedulerJob(job.id);
      const j = res.data.job || res.data;
      setForm({
        name: j.name || '',
        description: j.description || '',
        enabled: j.enabled ?? true,
        schedule_type: j.schedule_type || 'manual',
        schedule_config: j.schedule_config || {},
        dependencies: j.dependencies || [],
        execution_mode: j.execution_mode || 'in_app',
        cloud_job_config: j.cloud_job_config || {},
        steps: (j.steps || []).map(s => ({
          ...s,
          config: {
            ...(s.type === 'api_call'      ? { url:'', method:'GET', headers:[], payload:'', auth_type:'none', auth_config:{}, timeout:30 } : {}),
            ...(s.type === 'api_call_upsert' ? { url:'', method:'POST', headers:[], payload:'', auth_type:'none', auth_config:{}, timeout:30, response_data_path:'', db_type:'cloudsql', database:'', table:'', schema_name:'public', operation:'upsert', pk_column:'', truncate_first:false, mapping:[], transformations:[] } : {}),
            ...(s.type === 'db_transfer'   ? { source_db_type:'cloudsql', source_database:'', source_table:'', source_schema:'public', source_query:'', source_limit:0, pagination_column:'', pagination_size:50000, target_db_type:'cloudsql', target_database:'', target_table:'', target_schema:'public', target_operation:'insert', target_pk:'', on_error:'skip', only_matching_columns: true, mapping:[], transformations:[] } : {}),
            ...(s.type === 'db_mapping'    ? { source_path:'', db_type:'cloudsql', server_id:'', database:'', table:'', operation:'insert', mapping:[], update_key:'' } : {}),
            ...(s.type === 'email_trigger' ? { to:'', subject:'', body:'' } : {}),
            ...(s.type === 'gcs_operation' ? { bucket:'', operation:'list', prefix:'', destination:'', source_data_path:'', content_type:'application/json' } : {}),
            ...(s.type === 'file_import'   ? { file_source:'gcs', file_type:'csv', gcs_bucket:'', gcs_path:'', file_url:'', file_content:'', delimiter:',', has_header:true, db_type:'cloudsql', database:'', table:'', schema_name:'public', operation:'insert', pk_column:'', mapping:[] } : {}),
            ...s.config,
            headers: s.config?.headers || [],
            mapping: s.config?.mapping || [],
          },
          conditions: s.conditions || [],
        })),
      });
      setIsNew(false);
      setSelectedJobId(j.id);
      setExpandedStep(null);
      setView('edit');
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load job'); }
  };

  const saveJob = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { toast.error('Job name is required'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        steps: form.steps.map((s, i) => ({
          ...s,
          order: i,
          config: {
            ...s.config,
            headers: (s.config.headers || []).filter(h => h.key),
            mapping: (s.config.mapping || []).filter(m => m.source_field && m.target_column),
            ...(s.type === 'sql_script' ? {
              statements: (s.config.statements || []).filter(st => st.sql?.trim()),
            } : {}),
          },
        })),
      };
      if (isNew) {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.createSchedulerJob(payload);
        setSelectedJobId(res.data.job?.id || res.data.id);
        setIsNew(false);
        toast.success('Job created');
      } else {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateSchedulerJob(selectedJobId, payload);
        toast.success('Job updated');
      }
      loadJobs();
    } catch (e) { toast.error('Save failed: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message)); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const deleteJob = async (jobId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this job and all its run history?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteSchedulerJob(jobId);
      toast.success('Job deleted');
      if (selectedJobId === jobId) { setView('list'); setSelectedJobId(null); }
      loadJobs();
    } catch { toast.error('Delete failed'); }
  };

  const toggleJob = async (jobId) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.toggleSchedulerJob(jobId);
      toast.success(res.data.enabled ? 'Job enabled' : 'Job disabled');
      loadJobs();
      if (selectedJobId === jobId) setForm(f => ({ ...f, enabled: res.data.enabled }));
    } catch { toast.error('Toggle failed'); }
  };

  const runJob = async (jobId) => {
    setRunning(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.runSchedulerJob(jobId);
      const run = res.data.run || res.data;
      if (run.status === 'running') {
        toast.success('Job started in background — check History for results');
        // Auto-poll history until done (every 5s, max 120 times = 10 min)
        let polls = 0;
        const poll = setInterval(async () => {
          polls++;
          try {
            const hRes = await sqlEditorAPI.getSchedulerJobHistory(jobId, 1);
            const latest = (hRes.data.runs || [])[0];
            if (latest && latest.status !== 'running') {
              clearInterval(poll);
              if (latest.status === 'success') toast.success(`Job finished — ${latest.rows_affected ?? latest.steps_log?.length ?? 0} steps done (${Math.round((latest.duration_ms||0)/1000)}s)`);
              else toast.error('Job failed: ' + (latest.steps_log?.find(s => s.error)?.error || 'Check history'));
              loadJobs();
              setRunning(false);
            }
          } catch { /* ignore poll errors */ }
          if (polls >= 120) { clearInterval(poll); setRunning(false); toast.info('Job still running — check History for status'); }
        }, 5000);
      } else if (run.status === 'success') { toast.success('Job completed successfully'); loadJobs(); setRunning(false); }
      else { toast.error('Job failed: ' + (run.error || 'Unknown')); loadJobs(); setRunning(false); }
    } catch (e) { toast.error('Run failed: ' + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message)); setRunning(false); }
  };

  const viewHistory = async (jobId) => {
    setSelectedJobId(jobId);
    setView('history');
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getSchedulerJobHistory(jobId, 50);
      setHistory(res.data.runs || []);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load history'); setHistory([]); }
  };

  const loadDashboard = async () => {
    setView('dashboard');
    setLoadingDashboard(true);
    try {
      const historyPromises = jobs.map(j =>
        sqlEditorAPI.getSchedulerJobHistory(j.id, 100)
          .then(res => (res.data.runs || []).map(r => ({ ...r, job_name: j.name, job_id: j.id })))
          .catch(() => [])
      );
      const results = await Promise.all(historyPromises);
      setAllHistory(results.flat().sort((a, b) => new Date(b.started_at) - new Date(a.started_at)));
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load dashboard'); }
    setLoadingDashboard(false);
  };

  /* ═══════════ Step helpers ═══════════ */
  const addStep = (type) => {
    const idx = form.steps.length;
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: [...f.steps, makeStep(type, idx)] }));
    setShowAddMenu(false);
    setExpandedStep(idx);
  };

  const removeStep  = (idx) => { setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) })); setExpandedStep(null); };
  const updateField = (idx, k, v) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.map((s, i) => i === idx ? { ...s, [k]: v } : s) }));
  const updateCfg   = (idx, k, v) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.map((s, i) => i === idx ? { ...s, config: { ...s.config, [k]: v } } : s) }));

  const moveStep = (idx, dir) => {
    const n = idx + dir;
    if (n < 0 || n >= form.steps.length) return;
    setForm(f => { const a = [...f.steps]; [a[idx], a[n]] = [a[n], a[idx]]; return { ...f, steps: a }; });
    setExpandedStep(n);
  };

  /* Headers */
  const addHeader    = (si) => updateCfg(si, 'headers', [...(form.steps[si].config.headers || []), { key: '', value: '' }]);
  const updHeader    = (si, hi, k, v) => { const h = [...(form.steps[si].config.headers||[])]; h[hi] = { ...h[hi], [k]: v }; updateCfg(si, 'headers', h); };
  const rmHeader     = (si, hi) => updateCfg(si, 'headers', form.steps[si].config.headers.filter((_, i) => i !== hi));

  /* Mappings */
  const addMapping   = (si) => updateCfg(si, 'mapping', [...(form.steps[si].config.mapping || []), { source_field: '', target_column: '' }]);
  const updMapping   = (si, mi, k, v) => { const m = [...(form.steps[si].config.mapping||[])]; m[mi] = { ...m[mi], [k]: v }; updateCfg(si, 'mapping', m); };
  const rmMapping    = (si, mi) => updateCfg(si, 'mapping', form.steps[si].config.mapping.filter((_, i) => i !== mi));

  /* Conditions */
  const addCond = (si) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.map((s, i) => i === si ? { ...s, conditions: [...s.conditions, { field:'', operator:'eq', value:'' }] } : s) }));
  const updCond = (si, ci, k, v) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.map((s, i) => { if (i !== si) return s; const c = [...s.conditions]; c[ci] = { ...c[ci], [k]: v }; return { ...s, conditions: c }; }) }));
  const rmCond  = (si, ci) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.map((s, i) => i === si ? { ...s, conditions: s.conditions.filter((_, j) => j !== ci) } : s) }));

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     RENDER HELPERS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  /* ── API Call config ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderApiCallConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      <div className="scheduler-form-row">
        <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
          <label>Method</label>
          <select value={step.config.method || 'GET'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'method', e.target.value)}>
            {HTTP_METHODS.map(m => <option key={m}>{m}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>URL</label>
          <input value={step.config.url || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'url', e.target.value)} placeholder="https://api.example.com/data" />
          <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Supports {'{{steps.prev_step.data.value}}'} and {'{{$now:YYYY-MM-DD}}'} templates</div>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 90 }}>
          <label>Timeout</label>
          <input type="number" min={1} value={step.config.timeout || 30} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'timeout', parseInt(e.target.value) || 30)} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Auth */}
      <div className="scheduler-form-row">
        <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 150 }}>
          <label>Auth</label>
          <select value={step.config.auth_type || 'none'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_type', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="none">None</option>
            <option value="basic">Basic Auth</option>
            <option value="bearer">Bearer Token</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        {step.config.auth_type === 'basic' && (
          <>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Username</label>
              <input value={step.config.auth_config?.username || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_config', { ...step.config.auth_config, username: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Password</label>
              <input type="password" value={step.config.auth_config?.password || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_config', { ...step.config.auth_config, password: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {step.config.auth_type === 'bearer' && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Token</label>
            <input value={step.config.auth_config?.token || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_config', { ...step.config.auth_config, token: e.target.value })} placeholder="Bearer token" />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Headers */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>Headers</label>
          <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => addHeader(idx)}><Plus size={12} /> Add</button>
        </div>
        {(step.config.headers || []).map((h, hi) => (
          <div className="scheduler-kv-row" key={hi}>
            <input placeholder="Key" value={h.key} onChange={e => updHeader(idx, hi, 'key', e.target.value)} />
            <input placeholder="Value" value={h.value} onChange={e => updHeader(idx, hi, 'value', e.target.value)} />
            <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" onClick={() => rmHeader(idx, hi)}><X size={12} /></button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Payload */}
      {['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(step.config.method) && (
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>Payload (JSON)</label>
          <textarea rows={5} value={step.config.payload || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'payload', e.target.value)} placeholder={'{\n  "fromDate": "{{$now-1d:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}",\n  "toDate": "{{$now:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}"\n}'} />
          <div className="scheduler-template-hint">
            Dynamic variables: {'{{$now}}'} {'{{$today}}'} {'{{$yesterday}}'} {'{{$tomorrow}}'} {'{{$week_start}}'} {'{{$month_start}}'}
            <br />Offsets: {'{{$now-1d}}'} {'{{$now+2h}}'} {'{{$today-30m}}'} {'{{$now-1w}}'} {'{{$now-3M}}'} {'{{$now+1y}}'}
            <br />Formats: {'{{$now:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}'} {'{{$now-1d:YYYY-MM-DD}}'} {'{{$now:epoch}}'} {'{{$now:iso}}'}
            <br />Context: {'{{steps.prev_step.data.value}}'} for data from previous steps
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );

  /* ── API Call → DB Upsert config ────────────────────────── */
  const DYNAMIC_VAR_HINT = (
    <div className="scheduler-template-hint" style={{ marginTop: 6, padding: '8px 10px', background: '#f0f9ff', border: '1px solid #bae6fd', borderRadius: 6 }}>
      <strong style={{ color: '#0369a1' }}>Dynamic variables for payload:</strong>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '2px 16px', marginTop: 4, fontSize: 10.5, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
        <span>{'{{$now}}'} — current datetime</span>
        <span>{'{{$today}}'} — today 00:00</span>
        <span>{'{{$yesterday}}'} — yesterday 00:00</span>
        <span>{'{{$tomorrow}}'} — tomorrow 00:00</span>
        <span>{'{{$week_start}}'} — Monday 00:00</span>
        <span>{'{{$month_start}}'} — 1st of month</span>
        <span>{'{{$now-1d:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}'}</span>
        <span>{'{{$now+2h:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}'}</span>
        <span>{'{{$today-1w:YYYY-MM-DD}}'}</span>
        <span>{'{{$now:epoch}}'} — unix timestamp</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: 10.5, color: '#475569' }}>
        Offsets: <code>d</code>=days <code>h</code>=hours <code>m</code>=minutes <code>w</code>=weeks <code>M</code>=months <code>y</code>=years
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const renderApiCallUpsertConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      {/* ── API Section ── */}
      <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#f0f9ff', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #bae6fd', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e40af', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 8, display: 'block' }}>
          <Globe size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> API Call
        </label>
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
            <label>Method</label>
            <select value={step.config.method || 'POST'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'method', e.target.value)}>
              {HTTP_METHODS.map(m => <option key={m}>{m}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>URL</label>
            <input value={step.config.url || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'url', e.target.value)} placeholder="https://api.example.com/data" />
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 90 }}>
            <label>Timeout</label>
            <input type="number" min={1} value={step.config.timeout || 30} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'timeout', parseInt(e.target.value) || 30)} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Auth */}
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 150 }}>
            <label>Auth</label>
            <select value={step.config.auth_type || 'none'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_type', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="none">None</option>
              <option value="basic">Basic Auth</option>
              <option value="bearer">Bearer Token</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          {step.config.auth_type === 'basic' && (
            <>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                <label>Username</label>
                <input value={step.config.auth_config?.username || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_config', { ...step.config.auth_config, username: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                <label>Password</label>
                <input type="password" value={step.config.auth_config?.password || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_config', { ...step.config.auth_config, password: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          {step.config.auth_type === 'bearer' && (
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Token</label>
              <input value={step.config.auth_config?.token || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'auth_config', { ...step.config.auth_config, token: e.target.value })} placeholder="Bearer token" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Headers */}
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>Headers</label>
            <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => addHeader(idx)}><Plus size={12} /> Add</button>
          </div>
          {(step.config.headers || []).map((h, hi) => (
            <div className="scheduler-kv-row" key={hi}>
              <input placeholder="Key" value={h.key} onChange={e => updHeader(idx, hi, 'key', e.target.value)} />
              <input placeholder="Value" value={h.value} onChange={e => updHeader(idx, hi, 'value', e.target.value)} />
              <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" onClick={() => rmHeader(idx, hi)}><X size={12} /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Payload */}
        {['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(step.config.method) && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Payload (JSON) — supports dynamic date variables</label>
            <textarea rows={6} value={step.config.payload || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'payload', e.target.value)}
              placeholder={'{\n  "fromDate": "{{$now-1d:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}",\n  "toDate": "{{$now:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm}}"\n}'} />
          </div>
        )}
        {DYNAMIC_VAR_HINT}
      </div>

      {/* Arrow */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', margin: '4px 0 12px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
        <ArrowDown size={20} style={{ margin: '0 auto' }} />
      </div>

      {/* ── DB Upsert Section ── */}
      <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#f0fdf4', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #bbf7d0', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#166534', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 8, display: 'block' }}>
          <Database size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> DB Target
        </label>

        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Response Data Path</label>
            <input value={step.config.response_data_path || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'response_data_path', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. data  (leave empty for top-level array)" />
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Dot path to the rows array in the API response. Leave blank if the response is a top‑level array <code>[...]</code></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label>DB Type</label>
            <select value={step.config.db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'db_type', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL (PostgreSQL)</option>
              <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
              {servers.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Database</label>
            <input value={step.config.database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Table</label>
            <input value={step.config.table || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'table', e.target.value)} placeholder="table_name" />
          </div>
          {step.config.db_type !== 'bigquery' && (
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
              <label>Schema</label>
              <input value={step.config.schema_name || 'public'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'schema_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="public" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label>Operation</label>
            <select value={step.config.operation || 'upsert'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'operation', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="upsert">UPSERT (update or insert by PK)</option>
              <option value="insert">INSERT (all rows, including duplicates)</option>
              <option value="truncate_insert">TRUNCATE + INSERT (clear table first)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          {(step.config.operation || 'upsert') === 'upsert' && (
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 240 }}>
              <label>Primary Key Column</label>
              <input value={step.config.pk_column || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'pk_column', e.target.value)} placeholder="eid" />
              <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Rows matching this PK will be updated; new PKs will be inserted</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {(step.config.operation || 'upsert') !== 'truncate_insert' && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12 }}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={step.config.truncate_first || false} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'truncate_first', e.target.checked)} />
              <span style={{ color: '#dc2626', fontWeight: 500 }}>Truncate table before loading</span>
            </label>
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Enable to clear all existing data before inserting — useful when API always returns a full dataset</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {(step.config.operation === 'insert' || step.config.operation === 'truncate_insert') && (
          <div style={{ padding: 8, background: '#fefce8', borderRadius: 4, border: '1px solid #fde68a', marginBottom: 8, fontSize: 11, color: '#92400e' }}>
            <strong>INSERT mode:</strong> All rows from the API response will be inserted, including rows with duplicate key values.
            {step.config.operation === 'truncate_insert' && ' The table will be truncated (cleared) before inserting.'}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Column Mappings */}
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
              Column Mapping <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, textTransform: 'none' }}>(optional — if empty, auto-maps response keys to column names)</span>
            </label>
            <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => addMapping(idx)}><Plus size={12} /> Add</button>
          </div>
          {(step.config.mapping || []).map((m, mi) => (
            <div className="scheduler-kv-row" key={mi}>
              <input placeholder="API response field" value={m.source_field} onChange={e => updMapping(idx, mi, 'source_field', e.target.value)} />
              <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', flexShrink: 0 }}>→</span>
              <input placeholder="DB column" value={m.target_column} onChange={e => updMapping(idx, mi, 'target_column', e.target.value)} />
              <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" onClick={() => rmMapping(idx, mi)}><X size={12} /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
          {(!step.config.mapping || step.config.mapping.length === 0) && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No mapping — API response keys will be used as column names directly</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {renderTransformations(step, idx)}
    </>
  );

  /* ── DB Mapping config ───────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderDbMappingConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      <div className="scheduler-form-row">
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>Source Data Path</label>
          <input value={step.config.source_path || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_path', e.target.value)} placeholder="steps.api_call_step.data" />
          <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Dot path to data from a previous step&apos;s result</div>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
          <label>Operation</label>
          <select value={step.config.operation || 'insert'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'operation', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="insert">INSERT</option>
            <option value="update">UPDATE</option>
            <option value="upsert">UPSERT (insert or update by PK)</option>
            <option value="delete">DELETE</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="scheduler-form-row">
        <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
          <label>DB Type</label>
          <select value={step.config.db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'db_type', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL (PostgreSQL)</option>
            <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
            {servers.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>Database</label>
          <input value={step.config.database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>Table</label>
          <input value={step.config.table || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'table', e.target.value)} placeholder="schema.table_name" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {(step.config.operation === 'update' || step.config.operation === 'upsert') && (
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 240 }}>
            <label>{step.config.operation === 'upsert' ? 'Primary Key Column' : 'Update Key Column'}</label>
            <input value={step.config.update_key || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'update_key', e.target.value)} placeholder="primary_key_column" />
            {step.config.operation === 'upsert' && (
              <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Rows matching this PK will be updated; new PKs will be inserted</div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Column Mappings */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>Column Mappings</label>
          <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => addMapping(idx)}><Plus size={12} /> Add</button>
        </div>
        {(step.config.mapping || []).map((m, mi) => (
          <div className="scheduler-kv-row" key={mi}>
            <input placeholder="source_field" value={m.source_field} onChange={e => updMapping(idx, mi, 'source_field', e.target.value)} />
            <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', flexShrink: 0 }}>→</span>
            <input placeholder="target_column" value={m.target_column} onChange={e => updMapping(idx, mi, 'target_column', e.target.value)} />
            <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" onClick={() => rmMapping(idx, mi)}><X size={12} /></button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </>
  );

  /* ── DB Transfer config (Table → Table) ──────────────────── */
  const renderDbTransferConfig = (step, idx) => {
    const dbTypeOptions = (prefix) => (
      <>
        <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL (Default)</option>
        <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
        {servers.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>)}
      </>
    );
    return (
      <>
        {/* Source Section */}
        <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#eff6ff', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #bfdbfe', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e40af', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 8, display: 'block' }}>
            <Database size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Source
          </label>
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
              <label>DB Type / Server</label>
              <select value={step.config.source_db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => {
                updateCfg(idx, 'source_db_type', e.target.value);
                if (e.target.value.startsWith('server:') && (step.config.source_schema === 'public' || !step.config.source_schema)) {
                  updateCfg(idx, 'source_schema', 'dbo');
                } else if (!e.target.value.startsWith('server:') && step.config.source_schema === 'dbo') {
                  updateCfg(idx, 'source_schema', 'public');
                }
              }}>
                {dbTypeOptions('src')}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Database</label>
              <input value={step.config.source_database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Table</label>
              <input value={step.config.source_table || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_table', e.target.value)} placeholder="table_name" />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
              <label>Schema</label>
              <input value={step.config.source_schema || ((step.config.source_db_type || '').startsWith('server:') ? 'dbo' : 'public')} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_schema', e.target.value)} placeholder={(step.config.source_db_type || '').startsWith('server:') ? 'dbo' : 'public'} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
              <label>Limit (0=all)</label>
              <input type="number" min={0} value={step.config.source_limit || 0} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_limit', parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)} />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Custom Query (optional, overrides table)</label>
              <input value={step.config.source_query || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_query', e.target.value)} placeholder='SELECT * FROM "public"."tbl_user" WHERE is_active = true' />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 180 }}>
              <label>Pagination Column</label>
              <input value={step.config.pagination_column || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'pagination_column', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. RowID" />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 160 }}>
              <label>Page Size</label>
              <input type="number" min={1000} step={10000} value={step.config.pagination_size || 50000} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'pagination_size', parseInt(e.target.value) || 50000)} />
            </div>
            {step.config.pagination_column && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#3b82f6', background: '#eff6ff', padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 4, border: '1px solid #bfdbfe', alignSelf: 'center', flex: 1 }}>
                Auto-pagination ON — will split into <b>WHERE {step.config.pagination_column} BETWEEN 1..{step.config.pagination_size || 50000}</b>, then next page, etc. Ideal for large tables (lakhs of rows).
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Arrow */}
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', margin: '4px 0 12px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
          <ArrowDown size={20} style={{ margin: '0 auto' }} />
        </div>

        {/* Target Section */}
        <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#f0fdf4', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #bbf7d0', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#166534', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px', marginBottom: 8, display: 'block' }}>
            <Database size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Target
          </label>
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
              <label>DB Type / Server</label>
              <select value={step.config.target_db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'target_db_type', e.target.value)}>
                {dbTypeOptions('tgt')}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Database</label>
              <input value={step.config.target_database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'target_database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>Table</label>
              <input value={step.config.target_table || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'target_table', e.target.value)} placeholder="target_table_name" />
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
              <label>Schema</label>
              <input value={step.config.target_schema || 'public'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'target_schema', e.target.value)} placeholder="public" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 180 }}>
              <label>Operation</label>
              <select value={step.config.target_operation || 'insert'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'target_operation', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="insert">INSERT (append)</option>
                <option value="upsert">UPSERT (insert or update)</option>
                <option value="replace">REPLACE (truncate + insert)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            {(step.config.target_operation === 'upsert') && (
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
                <label>Primary Key Column</label>
                <input value={step.config.target_pk || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'target_pk', e.target.value)} placeholder="id" />
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
              <label>On Row Error</label>
              <select value={step.config.on_error || 'skip'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'on_error', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="skip">Skip bad rows &amp; continue</option>
                <option value="fail">Fail entire transfer</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column Mappings (optional) */}
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
              Column Mapping <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, textTransform: 'none' }}>(optional — if empty, uses same column names)</span>
            </label>
            <button className="scheduler-btn scheduler-btn-sm scheduler-btn-outline" onClick={() => addMapping(idx)}><Plus size={12} /> Add</button>
          </div>

          {/* Only Matching Columns toggle */}
          {(!step.config.mapping || step.config.mapping.length === 0) && (
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={step.config.only_matching_columns ?? true}
                onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'only_matching_columns', e.target.checked)}
                style={{ accentColor: '#3b82f6' }} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#334155' }}>Only transfer columns that exist in both source &amp; target</span>
            </label>
          )}
          {(!step.config.mapping || step.config.mapping.length === 0) && (step.config.only_matching_columns ?? true) && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#3b82f6', background: '#eff6ff', padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 4, marginBottom: 6, border: '1px solid #bfdbfe' }}>
              Auto-match is ON — only columns with matching names in source and target will be transferred. Source-only columns (like PR_No, etc.) are skipped automatically.
            </div>
          )}
          {(step.config.mapping || []).map((m, mi) => (
            <div className="scheduler-kv-row" key={mi}>
              <input placeholder="source_column" value={m.source_field} onChange={e => updMapping(idx, mi, 'source_field', e.target.value)} />
              <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', flexShrink: 0 }}>→</span>
              <input placeholder="target_column" value={m.target_column} onChange={e => updMapping(idx, mi, 'target_column', e.target.value)} />
              <button className="scheduler-btn-icon danger" onClick={() => rmMapping(idx, mi)}><X size={12} /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
          {(!step.config.mapping || step.config.mapping.length === 0) && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No mapping — all source columns will be inserted with same names into target</div>
          )}
        </div>
        {renderTransformations(step, idx)}
      </>
    );
  };

  /* ── Transformation helpers ─────────────────────────────── */
  const addTransformation = (stepIdx, type) => {
    const steps = [...form.steps];
    const transforms = [...(steps[stepIdx].config.transformations || [])];
    transforms.push({ type, enabled: true, config: {} });
    steps[stepIdx] = { ...steps[stepIdx], config: { ...steps[stepIdx].config, transformations: transforms } };
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps }));
  };
  const updateTransformation = (stepIdx, tIdx, field, value) => {
    const steps = [...form.steps];
    const transforms = [...(steps[stepIdx].config.transformations || [])];
    if (field.startsWith('config.')) {
      const key = field.replace('config.', '');
      transforms[tIdx] = { ...transforms[tIdx], config: { ...transforms[tIdx].config, [key]: value } };
    } else {
      transforms[tIdx] = { ...transforms[tIdx], [field]: value };
    }
    steps[stepIdx] = { ...steps[stepIdx], config: { ...steps[stepIdx].config, transformations: transforms } };
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps }));
  };
  const removeTransformation = (stepIdx, tIdx) => {
    const steps = [...form.steps];
    const transforms = [...(steps[stepIdx].config.transformations || [])];
    transforms.splice(tIdx, 1);
    steps[stepIdx] = { ...steps[stepIdx], config: { ...steps[stepIdx].config, transformations: transforms } };
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps }));
  };
  const moveTransformation = (stepIdx, tIdx, dir) => {
    const steps = [...form.steps];
    const transforms = [...(steps[stepIdx].config.transformations || [])];
    const newIdx = tIdx + dir;
    if (newIdx < 0 || newIdx >= transforms.length) return;
    [transforms[tIdx], transforms[newIdx]] = [transforms[newIdx], transforms[tIdx]];
    steps[stepIdx] = { ...steps[stepIdx], config: { ...steps[stepIdx].config, transformations: transforms } };
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, steps }));
  };

  const [showTransformMenu, setShowTransformMenu] = useState(null);

  const renderTransformations = (step, idx) => {
    const transforms = step.config.transformations || [];
    return (
      <div style={{ background: '#fef3c7', border: '1px solid #fde68a', borderRadius: 6, padding: 10, marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, color: '#92400e' }}>
            <Filter size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
            Transformations ({transforms.length})
          </span>
          <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <button onClick={() => setShowTransformMenu(showTransformMenu === idx ? null : idx)}
              style={{ fontSize: 11, background: '#f59e0b', color: '#fff', border: 'none', borderRadius: 4, padding: '3px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              + Add
            </button>
            {showTransformMenu === idx && (
              <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 0, top: '100%', background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e5e7eb', borderRadius: 6, boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)', zIndex: 50, minWidth: 200, padding: 4, marginTop: 2 }}>
                {TRANSFORMATION_TYPES.map(t => (
                  <button key={t.type} onClick={() => { addTransformation(idx, t.type); setShowTransformMenu(null); }}
                    style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, width: '100%', padding: '6px 10px', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 4, textAlign: 'left' }}
                    onMouseEnter={e => e.target.style.background = '#f3f4f6'} onMouseLeave={e => e.target.style.background = 'none'}>
                    <t.icon size={12} /> <span>{t.label}</span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#94a3b8', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>{t.desc}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {transforms.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#92400e', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No transformations — data will be transferred as-is after column mapping</div>
        )}
        {transforms.map((t, tIdx) => {
          const tDef = TRANSFORMATION_TYPES.find(d => d.type === t.type) || {};
          const TIcon = tDef.icon || Filter;
          return (
            <div key={tIdx} style={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #fde68a', borderRadius: 4, padding: 8, marginBottom: 6 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <TIcon size={12} style={{ color: '#f59e0b' }} />
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600 }}>{tDef.label || t.type}</span>
                <div style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', gap: 2 }}>
                  <button onClick={() => moveTransformation(idx, tIdx, -1)} disabled={tIdx === 0}
                    style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 2, opacity: tIdx === 0 ? 0.3 : 1 }}><ArrowUp size={11} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => moveTransformation(idx, tIdx, 1)} disabled={tIdx === transforms.length - 1}
                    style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 2, opacity: tIdx === transforms.length - 1 ? 0.3 : 1 }}><ArrowDown size={11} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => removeTransformation(idx, tIdx)}
                    style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 2, color: '#ef4444' }}><Trash2 size={11} /></button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {t.type === 'filter_rows' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  <input placeholder="Column" value={t.config.column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.column', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <select value={t.config.operator || 'eq'} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.operator', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: 100, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    {OPERATORS.map(o => <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>)}
                    <option value="in">in</option><option value="not_in">not in</option><option value="regex">regex</option>
                  </select>
                  <input placeholder="Value" value={t.config.value || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.value', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                </div>
              )}
              {t.type === 'add_column' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                    <input placeholder="New column name" value={t.config.target_column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.target_column', e.target.value)}
                      style={{ flex: 1, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                    <select value={t.config.expression_type || 'static'} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.expression_type', e.target.value)}
                      style={{ width: 120, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>
                      <option value="static">Static Value</option>
                      <option value="column_ref">Copy Column</option>
                      <option value="concat">Concatenate</option>
                      <option value="math">Math/Expression</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <input placeholder={t.config.expression_type === 'concat' ? '{first_name} {last_name}' : t.config.expression_type === 'math' ? 'price * quantity' : t.config.expression_type === 'column_ref' ? 'source_column_name' : 'Static value'}
                    value={t.config.expression || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.expression', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                </div>
              )}
              {t.type === 'validate' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  <input placeholder="Column" value={t.config.column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.column', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <select value={t.config.rule || 'not_null'} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.rule', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: 110, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    <option value="not_null">Not Null</option>
                    <option value="regex">Regex</option>
                    <option value="range">Range</option>
                    <option value="type_check">Type Check</option>
                    <option value="unique">Unique</option>
                  </select>
                  {t.config.rule === 'regex' && (
                    <input placeholder="Pattern" value={t.config.rule_config?.pattern || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.rule_config', { ...t.config.rule_config, pattern: e.target.value })}
                      style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  )}
                  {t.config.rule === 'range' && (<>
                    <input placeholder="Min" type="number" value={t.config.rule_config?.min || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.rule_config', { ...t.config.rule_config, min: e.target.value })}
                      style={{ width: 70, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                    <input placeholder="Max" type="number" value={t.config.rule_config?.max || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.rule_config', { ...t.config.rule_config, max: e.target.value })}
                      style={{ width: 70, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  </>)}
                  <select value={t.config.on_fail || 'skip'} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.on_fail', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: 80, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    <option value="skip">Skip</option>
                    <option value="fail">Fail</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
              {t.type === 'rename_column' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                  <input placeholder="From column" value={t.config.from_column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.from_column', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <span style={{ alignSelf: 'center', fontSize: 11, color: '#94a3b8' }}>→</span>
                  <input placeholder="To column" value={t.config.to_column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.to_column', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                </div>
              )}
              {t.type === 'type_cast' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                  <input placeholder="Column" value={t.config.column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.column', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <select value={t.config.target_type || 'string'} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.target_type', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: 100, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    <option value="string">String</option><option value="int">Integer</option><option value="float">Float</option>
                    <option value="date">Date</option><option value="bool">Boolean</option>
                  </select>
                  {t.config.target_type === 'date' && (
                    <input placeholder="Format e.g. %Y-%m-%d" value={t.config.format || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.format', e.target.value)}
                      style={{ flex: 1, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
              {t.type === 'deduplicate' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
                  <input placeholder="Columns (comma-separated)" value={t.config.columns || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.columns', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ flex: 1, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <select value={t.config.keep || 'first'} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.keep', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ width: 80, padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    <option value="first">First</option><option value="last">Last</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
              {t.type === 'custom_expression' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                  <input placeholder="Target column" value={t.config.target_column || ''} onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.target_column', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11 }} />
                  <textarea placeholder='e.g. upper(first_name) + " " + upper(last_name)' rows={2} value={t.config.expression || ''}
                    onChange={e => updateTransformation(idx, tIdx, 'config.expression', e.target.value)}
                    style={{ padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px solid #d1d5db', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11, fontFamily: 'monospace', resize: 'vertical' }} />
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#92400e' }}>
                    Functions: upper(), lower(), trim(), replace(), coalesce(), concat(), left(), right(), len(), abs(), round(), int(), float(), str(), now(), today()
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  };

  /* ── Email Trigger config ────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderEmailTriggerConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <label>To (comma separated)</label>
        <input value={step.config.to || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'to', e.target.value)} placeholder="user@example.com, admin@example.com" />
      </div>
      <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <label>Subject</label>
        <input value={step.config.subject || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'subject', e.target.value)} placeholder="Alert: {{steps.api_step.data.status}}" />
        <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Supports {'{{path.to.value}}'} template variables</div>
      </div>
      <div className="scheduler-form-group">
        <label>Body (HTML supported)</label>
        <textarea rows={6} value={step.config.body || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'body', e.target.value)}
          placeholder={'<h2>Report</h2>\n<p>Total records: {{steps.api_step.data.count}}</p>'} />
        <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Use {'{{steps.step_name.field}}'} to insert dynamic data</div>
      </div>
    </>
  );

  /* ── GCS Operation config ────────────────────────────────── */
  const renderGcsOperationConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      <div className="scheduler-form-row">
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>Bucket</label>
          {buckets.length > 0 ? (
            <select value={step.config.bucket || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'bucket', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Select bucket…</option>
              {buckets.map(b => { const name = typeof b === 'string' ? b : b.name; return <option key={name} value={name}>{name}</option>; })}
            </select>
          ) : (
            <input value={step.config.bucket || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'bucket', e.target.value)} placeholder="my-bucket-name" />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 160 }}>
          <label>Operation</label>
          <select value={step.config.operation || 'list'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'operation', e.target.value)}>
            <option value="list">List Objects</option>
            <option value="delete">Delete Object</option>
            <option value="upload">Upload Data</option>
            <option value="move">Move / Rename</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="scheduler-form-row">
        <div className="scheduler-form-group">
          <label>{step.config.operation === 'list' ? 'Prefix (optional)' : 'Object Path'}</label>
          <input value={step.config.prefix || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'prefix', e.target.value)} placeholder="folder/path/file.json" />
        </div>
        {step.config.operation === 'move' && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Destination Path</label>
            <input value={step.config.destination || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'destination', e.target.value)} placeholder="archive/file.json" />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {step.config.operation === 'upload' && (
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Source Data Path (from context)</label>
            <input value={step.config.source_data_path || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'source_data_path', e.target.value)} placeholder="steps.api_call.data" />
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Dot path to data from a previous step</div>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label>Content Type</label>
            <input value={step.config.content_type || 'application/json'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'content_type', e.target.value)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );

  /* ── Truncate Table config ──────────────────────────────── */
  const renderTruncateTableConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      <div style={{ padding: 10, background: '#fef2f2', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #fecaca', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <AlertCircle size={14} style={{ color: '#dc2626' }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>This step will delete ALL rows from the target table</span>
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label>DB Type</label>
            <select value={step.config.db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'db_type', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL (PostgreSQL)</option>
              <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
              {servers.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Database</label>
            <input value={step.config.database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Table</label>
            <input value={step.config.table || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'table', e.target.value)} placeholder="table_name" />
          </div>
          {step.config.db_type !== 'bigquery' && (
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
              <label>Schema</label>
              <input value={step.config.schema_name || 'public'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'schema_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="public" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="scheduler-form-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={step.config.confirm || false} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'confirm', e.target.checked)} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#dc2626', fontWeight: 600 }}>I confirm — truncate this table when the job runs</span>
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );

  /* ── File Import Step config ─────────────────────────────── */
  const renderFileImportConfig = (step, idx) => (
    <>
      {/* ── File Source ──────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#ecfdf5', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #a7f3d0', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <FileUp size={14} style={{ color: '#059669' }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#065f46' }}>File Source</span>
        </div>

        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 160 }}>
            <label>Source</label>
            <select value={step.config.file_source || 'gcs'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'file_source', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="gcs">GCS Bucket</option>
              <option value="url">URL (HTTP)</option>
              <option value="inline">Inline Content</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
            <label>File Type</label>
            <select value={step.config.file_type || 'csv'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'file_type', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="csv">CSV</option>
              <option value="sql">SQL</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {step.config.file_source === 'gcs' && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-row">
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 240 }}>
              <label>GCS Bucket</label>
              <select value={step.config.gcs_bucket || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'gcs_bucket', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">Select Bucket</option>
                {buckets.map(b => { const name = typeof b === 'string' ? b : b.name; return <option key={name} value={name}>{name}</option>; })}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group">
              <label>File Path</label>
              <input value={step.config.gcs_path || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'gcs_path', e.target.value)} placeholder="path/to/data.csv" />
              <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Supports dynamic vars: {'{{$today:YYYY-MM-DD}}'}/data.csv</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step.config.file_source === 'url' && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>File URL</label>
            <input value={step.config.file_url || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'file_url', e.target.value)} placeholder="https://example.com/data.csv" />
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint">Supports dynamic vars: https://api.example.com/report/{'{{$today:YYYY-MM-DD}}'}.csv</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step.config.file_source === 'inline' && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>File Content</label>
            <textarea
              rows={6}
              value={step.config.file_content || ''}
              onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'file_content', e.target.value)}
              placeholder={step.config.file_type === 'sql'
                ? 'INSERT INTO table (col1, col2) VALUES (1, \'val\');\nINSERT INTO table (col1, col2) VALUES (2, \'val2\');'
                : 'name,age,email\nJohn,30,john@example.com\nJane,25,jane@example.com'}
              style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: 12 }}
            />
            <div className="scheduler-template-hint">You can also reference a previous step: {'{{steps.prev_step.data}}'}</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step.config.file_type === 'csv' && (
          <div className="scheduler-form-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 100 }}>
              <label>Delimiter</label>
              <select value={step.config.delimiter || ','} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'delimiter', e.target.value)}>
                <option value=",">Comma (,)</option>
                <option value="\t">Tab</option>
                <option value=";">Semicolon (;)</option>
                <option value="|">Pipe (|)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={step.config.has_header ?? true} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'has_header', e.target.checked)} />
                <span>Has Header Row</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── Arrow ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', margin: '4px 0' }}>
        <ArrowDown size={20} style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }} />
      </div>

      {/* ── Target Database ──────────────────────────────── */}
      <div style={{ padding: 12, background: '#eff6ff', borderRadius: 6, border: '1px solid #bfdbfe', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <Database size={14} style={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e40af' }}>Target Database</span>
        </div>

        <div className="scheduler-form-row">
          <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>
            <label>DB Type</label>
            <select value={step.config.db_type || 'cloudsql'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'db_type', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL (PostgreSQL)</option>
              <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
              {servers.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={`server:${s.id}`}>{s.name} ({s.host})</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="scheduler-form-group">
            <label>Database</label>
            <input value={step.config.database || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'database', e.target.value)} placeholder="database_name" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {step.config.file_type === 'csv' && (
          <>
            <div className="scheduler-form-row">
              <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                <label>Table</label>
                <input value={step.config.table || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'table', e.target.value)} placeholder="target_table" />
              </div>
              {step.config.db_type !== 'bigquery' && (
                <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 120 }}>
                  <label>Schema</label>
                  <input value={step.config.schema_name || 'public'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'schema_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="public" />
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 130 }}>
                <label>Operation</label>
                <select value={step.config.operation || 'insert'} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'operation', e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="insert">INSERT</option>
                  <option value="upsert">UPSERT</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {step.config.operation === 'upsert' && (
              <div className="scheduler-form-group" style={{ maxWidth: 200, marginTop: 4 }}>
                <label>Primary Key Column</label>
                <input value={step.config.pk_column || ''} onChange={e => updateCfg(idx, 'pk_column', e.target.value)} placeholder="id" />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* ── Column Mapping ─────────────────────────── */}
            <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <label style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 }}>Column Mapping <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: '#6b7280' }}>(optional — leave empty to use CSV headers as column names)</span></label>
                <button className="scheduler-btn-sm" onClick={() => {
                  const m = [...(step.config.mapping || []), { source_field: '', target_column: '' }];
                  updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', m);
                }}>+ Add</button>
              </div>
              {(step.config.mapping || []).map((m, mi) => (
                <div key={mi} className="scheduler-form-row" style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
                  <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                    <input value={m.source_field || ''} onChange={e => {
                      const arr = [...step.config.mapping]; arr[mi] = { ...arr[mi], source_field: e.target.value }; updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', arr);
                    }} placeholder="CSV column name" />
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ margin: '0 6px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>→</span>
                  <div className="scheduler-form-group">
                    <input value={m.target_column || ''} onChange={e => {
                      const arr = [...step.config.mapping]; arr[mi] = { ...arr[mi], target_column: e.target.value }; updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', arr);
                    }} placeholder="DB column name" />
                  </div>
                  <button className="scheduler-btn-icon" style={{ color: '#ef4444' }} onClick={() => {
                    const arr = step.config.mapping.filter((_, i) => i !== mi); updateCfg(idx, 'mapping', arr);
                  }}><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {step.config.file_type === 'sql' && (
          <div className="scheduler-template-hint" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            SQL file mode: Each statement (separated by <code>;</code>) will be executed against this database. No table/schema needed.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );

  /* ── SQL Script Step config ──────────────────────────────── */
  const renderSqlScriptConfig = (step, idx) => {
    const stmts = step.config.statements || [];
    const vars = step.config.variables || {};
    const varEntries = Object.entries(vars);

    const addStatement = () => {
      const s = [...stmts, { id: uid(), name: '', sql: '', enabled: true, capture_result: false,
        validation: { enabled: false, type: 'row_count', operator: 'gte', value: 0, fail_action: 'abort' } }];
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const removeStatement = (si) => updateCfg(idx, 'statements', stmts.filter((_, i) => i !== si));
    const updateStmt = (si, key, val) => {
      const s = [...stmts];
      s[si] = { ...s[si], [key]: val };
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const updateStmtValidation = (si, key, val) => {
      const s = [...stmts];
      s[si] = { ...s[si], validation: { ...s[si].validation, [key]: val } };
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const moveStmt = (si, dir) => {
      const ni = si + dir;
      if (ni < 0 || ni >= stmts.length) return;
      const s = [...stmts];
      [s[si], s[ni]] = [s[ni], s[si]];
      updateCfg(idx, 'statements', s);
    };
    const setVar = (key, val) => updateCfg(idx, 'variables', { ...vars, [key]: val });
    const removeVar = (key) => {
      const v = { ...vars };
      delete v[key];
      updateCfg(idx, 'variables', v);
    };
    const addVar = () => {
      const key = `var_${Object.keys(vars).length + 1}`;
      setVar(key, '');
    };
    const renameVar = (oldKey, newKey) => {
      if (oldKey === newKey || !newKey.trim()) return;
      const v = {};
      for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(vars)) {
