  'SMALLINT', 'CHAR', 'BLOB', 'SERIAL', 'AUTO_INCREMENT', 'GRANT',
  'REVOKE', 'COMMIT', 'ROLLBACK', 'TRANSACTION', 'BEGIN', 'SAVEPOINT',
  'EXPLAIN', 'ANALYZE', 'TEMP', 'TEMPORARY', 'REPLACE', 'RETURNING',
  'COALESCE', 'NULLIF', 'GREATEST', 'LEAST', 'CAST', 'CONVERT',
  'EXTRACT', 'INTERVAL', 'WINDOW', 'RANGE', 'UNBOUNDED', 'PRECEDING',
  'FOLLOWING', 'CURRENT', 'ROW', 'GROUPING', 'CUBE', 'ROLLUP', 'TOP',
  'PIVOT', 'UNPIVOT', 'MERGE', 'MATCHED', 'LATERAL', 'UNNEST',
  'TABLESAMPLE', 'NATURAL', 'USING',
];

const SQL_FUNCTIONS = [
  'COUNT', 'SUM', 'AVG', 'MIN', 'MAX', 'ROUND', 'CEIL', 'FLOOR', 'ABS',
  'UPPER', 'LOWER', 'TRIM', 'LTRIM', 'RTRIM', 'LENGTH', 'SUBSTRING',
  'SUBSTR', 'REPLACE', 'CONCAT', 'CONCAT_WS', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT',
  'POSITION', 'CHARINDEX', 'REVERSE', 'REPEAT', 'LPAD', 'RPAD',
  'NOW', 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP', 'CURRENT_DATE', 'CURRENT_TIME',
  'DATE_ADD', 'DATE_SUB', 'DATEDIFF', 'DATEADD', 'DATEPART',
  'YEAR', 'MONTH', 'DAY', 'HOUR', 'MINUTE', 'SECOND',
  'TO_DATE', 'TO_CHAR', 'TO_NUMBER', 'FORMAT',
  'IFNULL', 'NVL', 'IIF', 'ISNULL',
  'ROW_NUMBER', 'RANK', 'DENSE_RANK', 'NTILE', 'LAG', 'LEAD',
  'FIRST_VALUE', 'LAST_VALUE', 'NTH_VALUE',
  'STRING_AGG', 'ARRAY_AGG', 'GROUP_CONCAT', 'LISTAGG',
  'REGEXP_REPLACE', 'REGEXP_EXTRACT', 'REGEXP_MATCH',
  'JSON_EXTRACT', 'JSON_VALUE', 'JSON_QUERY', 'PARSE_JSON',
  'STRUCT', 'ARRAY', 'GENERATE_ARRAY', 'GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY',
  'SAFE_DIVIDE', 'SAFE_CAST', 'APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT',
  'STDDEV', 'VARIANCE', 'CORR', 'COVAR_POP', 'COVAR_SAMP',
  'PERCENTILE_CONT', 'PERCENTILE_DISC', 'MEDIAN',
];

const SQL_SNIPPETS = [
  { label: 'SELECT ... FROM', insertText: 'SELECT ${1:*} FROM ${2:table_name}', detail: 'Basic SELECT query' },
  { label: 'SELECT ... WHERE', insertText: 'SELECT ${1:*} FROM ${2:table_name} WHERE ${3:condition}', detail: 'SELECT with WHERE clause' },
  { label: 'SELECT ... JOIN', insertText: 'SELECT ${1:*}\nFROM ${2:table1}\nJOIN ${3:table2} ON ${4:table1.id} = ${5:table2.id}', detail: 'SELECT with JOIN' },
  { label: 'SELECT ... GROUP BY', insertText: 'SELECT ${1:column}, COUNT(*)\nFROM ${2:table_name}\nGROUP BY ${3:column}', detail: 'SELECT with GROUP BY' },
  { label: 'INSERT INTO', insertText: 'INSERT INTO ${1:table_name} (${2:columns})\nVALUES (${3:values})', detail: 'INSERT statement' },
  { label: 'UPDATE ... SET', insertText: 'UPDATE ${1:table_name}\nSET ${2:column} = ${3:value}\nWHERE ${4:condition}', detail: 'UPDATE statement' },
  { label: 'DELETE FROM', insertText: 'DELETE FROM ${1:table_name}\nWHERE ${2:condition}', detail: 'DELETE statement' },
  { label: 'CREATE TABLE', insertText: 'CREATE TABLE ${1:table_name} (\n  ${2:id} SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n  ${3:column_name} ${4:data_type}\n)', detail: 'CREATE TABLE statement' },
  { label: 'CTE (WITH)', insertText: 'WITH ${1:cte_name} AS (\n  SELECT ${2:*}\n  FROM ${3:table_name}\n)\nSELECT * FROM ${1:cte_name}', detail: 'Common Table Expression' },
  { label: 'CASE WHEN', insertText: 'CASE\n  WHEN ${1:condition} THEN ${2:result}\n  ELSE ${3:default}\nEND', detail: 'CASE expression' },
  { label: 'Window Function', insertText: 'ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ${1:column} ORDER BY ${2:column})', detail: 'Window function template' },
];

// Build a set for fast lookup (uppercase)
const SQL_ALL_WORDS = new Set(
  [...SQL_KEYWORDS, ...SQL_FUNCTIONS].map(w => w.toUpperCase())
);

// ── Levenshtein distance for typo detection ─────────────────────────────
function levenshtein(a, b) {
  const m = a.length, n = b.length;
  const dp = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => Array(n + 1).fill(0));
  for (let i = 0; i <= m; i++) dp[i][0] = i;
  for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) dp[0][j] = j;
  for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      dp[i][j] = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1]
        ? dp[i - 1][j - 1]
        : 1 + Math.min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j - 1]);
    }
  }
  return dp[m][n];
}

function findClosestKeyword(word) {
  const upper = word.toUpperCase();
  if (SQL_ALL_WORDS.has(upper)) return null; // exact match
  let best = null, bestDist = Infinity;
  for (const kw of SQL_ALL_WORDS) {
    if (Math.abs(kw.length - upper.length) > 2) continue;
    const d = levenshtein(upper, kw);
    if (d <= 2 && d < bestDist) {
      bestDist = d;
      best = kw;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

// ── Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function QueryEditor({ database, initialQuery }) {
  const {
    selectedDatabase,
    loadingQuery,
    addFavorite,
    setLastQueryInfo,
    copilotOrigin,
    clearCopilotOrigin,
    openChatbot,
  } = useQueryStore();

  const { executeQuery } = useQueryOperations();

  // Local state for query text and limit
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(100);
  const [copilotBannerDismissed, setCopilotBannerDismissed] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem('copilot_banner_dismissed') === 'true'
  );

  const editorRef = useRef(null);
  const monacoRef = useRef(null);
  const markersTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // ── Table & Column autocomplete caches (refs so completion provider sees latest) ──
  const tablesCacheRef = useRef([]);           // [{ name, schema }]
  const columnsCacheRef = useRef({});           // { 'schema.table': [{ column_name, data_type }] }
  const dbTypeRef = useRef('cloudsql');
  const currentDbRef = useRef(null);
  const columnFetchingRef = useRef(new Set());  // prevent duplicate fetches

  // ── Fetch tables when database prop changes ──────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const db = database || selectedDatabase;
    if (!db || db === currentDbRef.current) return;
    currentDbRef.current = db;
    // Detect db type from store
    const store = useQueryStore.getState();
    const dbType = store.selectedServer ? `server:${store.selectedServer.id}` : store.databaseType || 'cloudsql';
    dbTypeRef.current = dbType;
    // Fetch tables
    (async () => {
      try {
        let tables = [];
        if (dbType.startsWith('server:')) {
          const serverId = dbType.replace('server:', '');
          const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServerTables(serverId, db);
          tables = (res.data.tables || []).map(t => ({ name: t.table_name || t.name, schema: t.schema_name || t.schema || 'public' }));
        } else {
          const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listTables(db, dbType);
          tables = (res.data.tables || []).map(t => ({ name: t.table_name || t.name, schema: t.schema_name || t.schema || 'public' }));
        }
        tablesCacheRef.current = tables;
        columnsCacheRef.current = {};
        columnFetchingRef.current = new Set();
      } catch { tablesCacheRef.current = []; }
    })();
  }, [database, selectedDatabase]);

  // ── Fetch columns for a specific table (lazy) ─────────────────────
  const fetchColumnsForTable = useCallback(async (tableName, schemaName = 'public') => {
    const cacheKey = `${schemaName}.${tableName}`;
    if (columnsCacheRef.current[cacheKey] || columnFetchingRef.current.has(cacheKey)) return;
    columnFetchingRef.current.add(cacheKey);
    const db = database || selectedDatabase;
    if (!db) return;
    try {
      const dbType = dbTypeRef.current;
      let columns = [];
      if (dbType.startsWith('server:')) {
        const serverId = dbType.replace('server:', '');
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getServerTableSchema(serverId, db, tableName, schemaName);
        columns = res.data.columns || [];
      } else {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getTableSchema(db, tableName, dbType, schemaName);
        columns = res.data.columns || [];
      }
      columnsCacheRef.current = { ...columnsCacheRef.current, [cacheKey]: columns };
    } catch { /* silent */ }
  }, [database, selectedDatabase]);

  // ── Dangerous-query confirmation modal state ──────────────────────
  const [dangerConfirm, setDangerConfirm] = useState(null); // { type, query, db }

  // ── AI Context Menu state ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [aiAction, setAiAction] = useState(null);   // 'fix' | 'enhance' | 'explain' | 'suggest'
  const [aiResult, setAiResult] = useState(null);    // { message, suggested_query }
  const [aiSelection, setAiSelection] = useState(null); // saved selection range

  // Sync initialQuery prop into local state
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialQuery && initialQuery !== query) {
      setQuery(initialQuery);
      if (editorRef.current) {
        editorRef.current.setValue(initialQuery);
      }
    }
  }, [initialQuery]);

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    const db = database || selectedDatabase;
    if (!db) {
      toast.error('Please select a database first');
      return;
    }
    
    // Check if there's selected text in the editor
    let queryToExecute = query;
    if (editorRef.current) {
      const selection = editorRef.current.getSelection();
      const selectedText = editorRef.current.getModel()?.getValueInRange(selection);
      if (selectedText && selectedText.trim()) {
        queryToExecute = selectedText;
      }
    }
    
    // Trim whitespace and newlines
    queryToExecute = queryToExecute.trim();
    
    if (!queryToExecute) {
      toast.error('Please enter a query');
      return;
    }

    // ── Detect dangerous DDL/DML commands and show confirmation ──────
    const upperQuery = queryToExecute.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    const dangerPatterns = [
      { regex: /^DELETE\b/, type: 'DELETE', icon: '🗑️', color: '#ef4444',
        warn: 'This will permanently DELETE rows from the table.' },
      { regex: /^DROP\b/, type: 'DROP', icon: '💥', color: '#dc2626',
        warn: 'This will permanently DROP the object (table, view, index, etc.). This action is irreversible!' },
      { regex: /^TRUNCATE\b/, type: 'TRUNCATE', icon: '⚠️', color: '#f59e0b',
        warn: 'This will remove ALL rows from the table. The table structure will remain but all data will be lost.' },
    ];
    for (const dp of dangerPatterns) {
      if (dp.regex.test(upperQuery)) {
        setDangerConfirm({ type: dp.type, icon: dp.icon, color: dp.color, warn: dp.warn,
                           query: queryToExecute, db });
        return; // stop — wait for user confirmation
      }
    }

    setLastQueryInfo({ database: db, query: queryToExecute, table: null });
    await executeQuery(db, queryToExecute, limit);

    // Track edited SQL from AI Copilot — sends corrected version as "gold" training example
    if (copilotOrigin && copilotOrigin.originalSql) {
      const originalNorm = copilotOrigin.originalSql.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      const executedNorm = queryToExecute.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      const wasEdited = originalNorm !== executedNorm;
      try {
        await sqlEditorAPI.submitAIFeedback({
          question: copilotOrigin.question,
          database: copilotOrigin.database || db,
          was_executed: true,
          edited_sql: wasEdited ? queryToExecute : '',
          feedback: wasEdited ? 'edited' : 'good',
        });
      } catch { /* silent */ }
      clearCopilotOrigin();
    }
  };

  // ── AI Action handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleAiAction = useCallback(async (action) => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor) return;

    const selection = editor.getSelection();
    const model = editor.getModel();
    let selectedText = model?.getValueInRange(selection);

    // If nothing selected, use the full query
    if (!selectedText || !selectedText.trim()) {
      selectedText = model?.getValue() || '';
    }

    if (!selectedText.trim()) {
      toast.error('No SQL query to process');
      return;
    }

    setAiAction(action);
    setAiLoading(true);
    setAiResult(null);
    setAiSelection(selection);

    try {
      const db = database || selectedDatabase;
      let response;
      switch (action) {
        case 'fix':
          response = await chatbotService.fixQuery(selectedText, db);
          break;
        case 'enhance':
          response = await chatbotService.enhanceQuery(selectedText, db);
          break;
        case 'explain':
          response = await chatbotService.explainQuery(selectedText, db);
          break;
        case 'suggest':
          response = await chatbotService.getSuggestions(selectedText, db);
          break;
        default:
          response = await chatbotService.fixQuery(selectedText, db);
      }

      if (response.success) {
        setAiResult({
          message: response.message,
          suggested_query: response.suggested_query,
        });
        if (response.suggested_query && (action === 'fix' || action === 'enhance')) {
          toast.success(`AI ${action === 'fix' ? 'fixed' : 'enhanced'} your query! Review the suggestion below.`);
        }
      } else {
        toast.error(response.message || 'AI request failed');
        setAiResult(null);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('AI request failed: ' + (err?.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
      setAiResult(null);
    } finally {
      setAiLoading(false);
    }
  }, [database, selectedDatabase]);

  // ── Apply suggested query to editor ───────────────────────────────
  const handleApplySuggestion = useCallback(() => {
    const editor = editorRef.current;
    if (!editor || !aiResult?.suggested_query) return;

    const model = editor.getModel();
    const sel = aiSelection;

    // If there was a selection, replace it; otherwise replace all
    if (sel && !sel.isEmpty()) {
      editor.executeEdits('ai-action', [{
        range: sel,
        text: aiResult.suggested_query,
      }]);
    } else {
      const fullRange = model.getFullModelRange();
      editor.executeEdits('ai-action', [{
        range: fullRange,
        text: aiResult.suggested_query,
      }]);
    }

    setQuery(editor.getValue());
    setAiResult(null);
    setAiAction(null);
    toast.success('Suggestion applied!');
  }, [aiResult, aiSelection]);

  const dismissAiResult = useCallback(() => {
    setAiResult(null);
    setAiAction(null);
  }, []);

    const handleEditorMount = useCallback((editor, monaco) => {
    editorRef.current = editor;
    monacoRef.current = monaco;

    // Initial marker check
    updateMarkers(editor, monaco);

    // ── Register AI context menu actions ──────────────────────────
    editor.addAction({
      id: 'ai-fix-sql',
      label: '\u2728 AI: Fix SQL',
      keybindings: [monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyMod.Shift | monaco.KeyCode.KeyF],
      contextMenuGroupId: 'ai_actions',
      contextMenuOrder: 1,
      run: () => handleAiAction('fix'),
    });
    editor.addAction({
      id: 'ai-enhance-sql',
      label: '\ud83d\ude80 AI: Enhance & Optimize SQL',
      keybindings: [monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyMod.Shift | monaco.KeyCode.KeyE],
      contextMenuGroupId: 'ai_actions',
      contextMenuOrder: 2,
      run: () => handleAiAction('enhance'),
    });
    editor.addAction({
      id: 'ai-explain-sql',
      label: '\ud83d\udcd6 AI: Explain SQL',
      contextMenuGroupId: 'ai_actions',
      contextMenuOrder: 3,
      run: () => handleAiAction('explain'),
    });
    editor.addAction({
      id: 'ai-suggest-sql',
      label: '\ud83d\udca1 AI: Get Suggestions',
      contextMenuGroupId: 'ai_actions',
      contextMenuOrder: 4,
      run: () => handleAiAction('suggest'),
    });

    // Re-check markers when content changes (debounced)
    editor.onDidChangeModelContent(() => {
      clearTimeout(markersTimerRef.current);
      markersTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        updateMarkers(editor, monaco);
        // Pro-actively fetch columns for tables referenced in FROM/JOIN
        const text = editor.getModel()?.getValue() || '';
        const tableRefRegex = /(?:FROM|JOIN)\s+(?:"?(\w+)"?\.)?"?(\w+)"?/gi;
        let m;
        while ((m = tableRefRegex.exec(text)) !== null) {
          const schema = m[1] || 'public';
          const tbl = m[2];
          if (tbl && tablesCacheRef.current.some(t => t.name.toLowerCase() === tbl.toLowerCase())) {
            fetchColumnsForTable(tbl, schema);
          }
        }
      }, 400);
    });

    // Ctrl+Enter to execute
    editor.addCommand(monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.Enter, () => {
      handleExecute();
    });
  }, [query, database, selectedDatabase, limit, handleAiAction]);

  // ── Register SQL autocomplete + hover BEFORE editor loads ─────────
  const handleEditorWillMount = useCallback((monaco) => {
    // Helper: get text of current line up to cursor position
    const getTextBeforeCursor = (model, position) => {
      return model.getValueInRange({
        startLineNumber: position.lineNumber,
        startColumn: 1,
        endLineNumber: position.lineNumber,
        endColumn: position.column,
      });
    };

    // Helper: detect if cursor is after a dot (table.column context)
    const getDotPrefix = (model, position) => {
      const textBefore = getTextBeforeCursor(model, position);
      const dotMatch = textBefore.match(/(\w+)\.\s*(\w*)$/);
      return dotMatch ? { table: dotMatch[1], partial: dotMatch[2] || '' } : null;
    };

    // Helper: detect if cursor is in a table-name context (after FROM/JOIN/INTO/UPDATE/TABLE)
    const isTableContext = (model, position) => {
      const fullText = model.getValue().substring(0, model.getOffsetAt(position)).toUpperCase();
      // Check if the last significant keyword before cursor is FROM/JOIN/INTO/UPDATE/TABLE
      const stripped = fullText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      return /(?:FROM|JOIN|INTO|UPDATE|TABLE|TRUNCATE)\s+\w*$/i.test(stripped);
    };

    // ── Completion Provider ──
    monaco.languages.registerCompletionItemProvider('sql', {
      triggerCharacters: [' ', '.', '(', ',', '\n'],
      provideCompletionItems: (model, position) => {
        const word = model.getWordUntilPosition(position);
        const range = {
          startLineNumber: position.lineNumber,
          endLineNumber: position.lineNumber,
          startColumn: word.startColumn,
          endColumn: word.endColumn,
        };

        const suggestions = [];
        const dotCtx = getDotPrefix(model, position);

        // ── If after a dot: suggest columns for that table/alias ──────
        if (dotCtx) {
          const tblName = dotCtx.table.toLowerCase();
          const tables = tablesCacheRef.current;
          // Find matching table(s) by name
          const matched = tables.filter(t =>
            t.name.toLowerCase() === tblName ||
            `${t.schema}.${t.name}`.toLowerCase() === tblName
          );
          // Also check aliases used in the query: e.g. "FROM users u" → alias 'u' maps to 'users'
          const fullText = model.getValue();
          const aliasMap = {};
          const aliasRegex = /(?:FROM|JOIN)\s+(?:"?(\w+)"?\.)?"?(\w+)"?\s+(?:AS\s+)?(\w+)/gi;
          let m;
          while ((m = aliasRegex.exec(fullText)) !== null) {
            aliasMap[m[3].toLowerCase()] = { schema: m[1] || 'public', name: m[2] };
          }
          const aliasMatch = aliasMap[tblName];

          // Gather all tables to lookup columns for
          const tablesToLookup = [];
          if (matched.length > 0) {
            matched.forEach(t => tablesToLookup.push({ name: t.name, schema: t.schema || 'public' }));
          }
          if (aliasMatch) {
            tablesToLookup.push({ name: aliasMatch.name, schema: aliasMatch.schema || 'public' });
          }

          // Trigger column fetch for each table and add cached columns
          const addedColumns = new Set();
          tablesToLookup.forEach(tbl => {
            const cacheKey = `${tbl.schema}.${tbl.name}`;
            // Trigger fetch (async, will be available on next trigger)
            fetchColumnsForTable(tbl.name, tbl.schema);
            const cols = columnsCacheRef.current[cacheKey] || [];
            cols.forEach(col => {
              const colName = col.column_name || col.name;
              if (!colName || addedColumns.has(colName.toLowerCase())) return;
              addedColumns.add(colName.toLowerCase());
              const dataType = col.data_type || col.type || '';
              suggestions.push({
                label: colName,
                kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Field,
                insertText: colName,
                detail: `Column (${dataType})`,
                documentation: `Table: ${tbl.schema}.${tbl.name}\nType: ${dataType}${col.is_nullable === 'YES' ? '\nNullable' : ''}`,
                range,
                sortText: '0_' + colName,
              });
            });
          });

          // If we found column suggestions, return them immediately (skip keywords)
          if (suggestions.length > 0) {
            return { suggestions };
          }
        }

        // ── Table name suggestions (after FROM, JOIN, INTO, UPDATE, TABLE) ──
        const inTableCtx = isTableContext(model, position);
        if (inTableCtx && tablesCacheRef.current.length > 0) {
          const addedTables = new Set();
          tablesCacheRef.current.forEach(t => {
            const tblName = t.name;
            if (addedTables.has(tblName.toLowerCase())) return;
            addedTables.add(tblName.toLowerCase());
            suggestions.push({
              label: tblName,
              kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Struct,
              insertText: tblName,
              detail: `Table (${t.schema || 'public'})`,
              range,
              sortText: '0_' + tblName,
            });
            // Also offer schema.table form
            if (t.schema && t.schema !== 'public') {
              const fullName = `${t.schema}.${tblName}`;
              suggestions.push({
                label: fullName,
                kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Struct,
                insertText: fullName,
                detail: 'Table (qualified)',
                range,
                sortText: '0_' + fullName,
              });
            }
          });
        }

        // ── Always include table names as lower-priority suggestions ───
        if (!dotCtx && tablesCacheRef.current.length > 0) {
          const addedTables = new Set(suggestions.map(s => s.label.toLowerCase()));
          tablesCacheRef.current.forEach(t => {
            if (addedTables.has(t.name.toLowerCase())) return;
            addedTables.add(t.name.toLowerCase());
            suggestions.push({
              label: t.name,
              kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Struct,
              insertText: t.name,
              detail: `Table (${t.schema || 'public'})`,
              range,
              sortText: inTableCtx ? '0_' + t.name : '4_' + t.name,
            });
          });
        }

        // SQL Keywords
        SQL_KEYWORDS.forEach((kw) => {
          suggestions.push({
            label: kw,
            kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Keyword,
            insertText: kw,
            detail: 'SQL Keyword',
            range,
            sortText: '5_' + kw,
          });
          // Also offer lowercase
          suggestions.push({
            label: kw.toLowerCase(),
            kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Keyword,
            insertText: kw.toLowerCase(),
            detail: 'SQL Keyword',
            range,
            sortText: '6_' + kw,
          });
        });

        // SQL Functions
        SQL_FUNCTIONS.forEach((fn) => {
          suggestions.push({
            label: fn,
            kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Function,
            insertText: fn + '(${1})',
            insertTextRules: monaco.languages.CompletionItemInsertTextRule.InsertAsSnippet,
            detail: 'SQL Function',
            range,
            sortText: '7_' + fn,
          });
        });

        // Snippets
        SQL_SNIPPETS.forEach((snippet) => {
          suggestions.push({
            label: snippet.label,
            kind: monaco.languages.CompletionItemKind.Snippet,
            insertText: snippet.insertText,
            insertTextRules: monaco.languages.CompletionItemInsertTextRule.InsertAsSnippet,
            detail: snippet.detail,
            documentation: snippet.detail,
            range,
            sortText: '8_' + snippet.label,
          });
        });

        return { suggestions };
      },
    });

    // ── Hover Provider (show typo suggestions on hover) ──
    monaco.languages.registerHoverProvider('sql', {
      provideHover: (model, position) => {
        const wordInfo = model.getWordAtPosition(position);
        if (!wordInfo) return null;
        const word = wordInfo.word;

        // Skip short words, numbers, and strings
        if (word.length < 3 || /^\d+$/.test(word)) return null;

        // Skip known table/column names
        const lower = word.toLowerCase();
        const isKnown = tablesCacheRef.current.some(t => t.name.toLowerCase() === lower) ||
          Object.values(columnsCacheRef.current).some(cols =>
            (cols || []).some(c => (c.column_name || c.name || '').toLowerCase() === lower)
          );
        if (isKnown) {
          // Show column info on hover instead
          for (const [key, cols] of Object.entries(columnsCacheRef.current)) {
            const col = (cols || []).find(c => (c.column_name || c.name || '').toLowerCase() === lower);
            if (col) {
              return {
                range: { startLineNumber: position.lineNumber, endLineNumber: position.lineNumber, startColumn: wordInfo.startColumn, endColumn: wordInfo.endColumn },
                contents: [
                  { value: `**Column:** \`${col.column_name || col.name}\`` },
                  { value: `**Table:** ${key}` },
                  { value: `**Type:** ${col.data_type || col.type || 'unknown'}${col.is_nullable === 'YES' ? ' (nullable)' : ''}` },
                ],
              };
            }
          }
          return null;
        }

        const closest = findClosestKeyword(word);
        if (!closest) return null;

        return {
          range: {
            startLineNumber: position.lineNumber,
            endLineNumber: position.lineNumber,
            startColumn: wordInfo.startColumn,
            endColumn: wordInfo.endColumn,
          },
          contents: [
            { value: `**Possible typo detected**` },
            { value: `Did you mean: **\`${closest}\`** ?` },
            { value: `_Press Ctrl+Space to see suggestions_` },
          ],
        };
      },
    });
  }, []);

  // ── Update red-underline markers for typos ────────────────────────
  const updateMarkers = useCallback((editor, monaco) => {
    const model = editor.getModel();
    if (!model) return;

    const text = model.getValue();
    const markers = [];

    // Build a set of known table + column names (no false-positive typo markers)
    const knownNames = new Set();
    tablesCacheRef.current.forEach(t => {
      knownNames.add(t.name.toLowerCase());
      if (t.schema) knownNames.add(t.schema.toLowerCase());
    });
    Object.values(columnsCacheRef.current).forEach(cols => {
      (cols || []).forEach(c => {
        const n = (c.column_name || c.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (n) knownNames.add(n);
      });
    });

    // Tokenize: split by non-word characters, track positions
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    lines.forEach((line, lineIdx) => {
      // Skip comment lines
      if (line.trim().startsWith('--')) return;

      const wordRegex = /\b([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\b/g;
      let match;
      while ((match = wordRegex.exec(line)) !== null) {
        const word = match[1];
        if (word.length < 3) continue;

        const upper = word.toUpperCase();
        const lower = word.toLowerCase();
        // If it's a valid SQL keyword/function, skip
        if (SQL_ALL_WORDS.has(upper)) continue;
        // If it's a known table or column name, skip
        if (knownNames.has(lower)) continue;

        // Check if it's close to a keyword (potential typo)
        const closest = findClosestKeyword(word);
        if (closest) {
          markers.push({
            severity: monaco.MarkerSeverity.Error,
            message: `Unknown keyword "${word}". Did you mean "${closest}"?`,
            startLineNumber: lineIdx + 1,
            endLineNumber: lineIdx + 1,
            startColumn: match.index + 1,
            endColumn: match.index + 1 + word.length,
            source: 'SQL Lint',
          });
        }
      }
    });

    monaco.editor.setModelMarkers(model, 'sql-lint', markers);
  }, []);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(query || '');
    toast.success('Query copied!');
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setQuery('');
    if (editorRef.current) {
      editorRef.current.setValue('');
    }
  };

  const handleFavorite = () => {
    if (query && query.trim()) {
      addFavorite(query);
      toast.success('Added to favorites!');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleExecute}
            disabled={loadingQuery || !(query || '').trim()}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all
              ${loadingQuery || !(query || '').trim()
                ? 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                : 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              }`}
            title="Execute query (Ctrl+Enter)"
          >
            <Play size={14} />
            {loadingQuery ? 'Running...' : 'Execute'}
          </button>

          <button onClick={handleCopy} className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg" title="Copy query">
            <Copy size={16} />
          </button>
          <button onClick={handleFavorite} className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-yellow-500 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg" title="Add to favorites">
            <Star size={16} />
          </button>
          <button onClick={handleClear} className="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg" title="Clear editor">
            <Trash2 size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <label className="text-xs text-gray-500">Limit:</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            value={limit}
            onChange={(e) => setLimit(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-20 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-400 outline-none"
            min={1}
            max={10000}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── AI Copilot Notification Banner ──────────────────────── */}
      {!copilotBannerDismissed && (
        <div className="copilot-notify-banner">
          <div className="copilot-notify-content">
            <div className="copilot-notify-icon-wrap">
              <Sparkles size={16} />
            </div>
            <div className="copilot-notify-text">
              <strong>AI SQL Copilot is here!</strong>
              <span>Write queries in plain English — just describe what you need and Copilot generates the SQL for you.</span>
            </div>
            <button
              className="copilot-notify-try-btn"
              onClick={() => { openChatbot(); setCopilotBannerDismissed(true); localStorage.setItem('copilot_banner_dismissed', 'true'); }}
            >
              Try it now <ArrowRight size={13} />
            </button>
            <button
              className="copilot-notify-dismiss"
              onClick={() => { setCopilotBannerDismissed(true); localStorage.setItem('copilot_banner_dismissed', 'true'); }}
              title="Dismiss"
            >
              <X size={14} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Dangerous Query Confirmation Modal ──────────────────── */}
      {dangerConfirm && (
        <div style={{ position:'fixed', inset:0, zIndex:9999, display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', background:'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)' }}>
          <div style={{ background:'#fff', borderRadius:16, width:480, maxWidth:'92vw', boxShadow:'0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)', overflow:'hidden' }}>
            {/* Header bar */}
            <div style={{ background: dangerConfirm.color, padding:'16px 24px', display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:10 }}>
              <ShieldAlert size={22} color="#fff" />
              <span style={{ color:'#fff', fontWeight:700, fontSize:16 }}>Dangerous Query — {dangerConfirm.type}</span>
            </div>
            {/* Body */}
            <div style={{ padding:'20px 24px' }}>
              <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'flex-start', gap:12, marginBottom:16 }}>
                <AlertTriangle size={28} color={dangerConfirm.color} style={{ flexShrink:0, marginTop:2 }} />
                <div>
                  <p style={{ margin:0, fontWeight:600, fontSize:14, color:'#1f2937' }}>{dangerConfirm.warn}</p>
                  <p style={{ margin:'8px 0 0', fontSize:13, color:'#6b7280' }}>{dangerConfirm.type} operations are disabled in the SQL Editor. Please contact admin for {dangerConfirm.type.toLowerCase()} operations on Production.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <pre style={{ background:'#fef2f2', border:'1px solid #fecaca', borderRadius:8, padding:12, fontSize:13, whiteSpace:'pre-wrap', wordBreak:'break-all', maxHeight:150, overflow:'auto', color:'#991b1b' }}>{dangerConfirm.query}</pre>
            </div>
            {/* Footer */}
            <div style={{ padding:'12px 24px 20px', display:'flex', justifyContent:'flex-end', gap:10 }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setDangerConfirm(null)}
                style={{ padding:'8px 20px', borderRadius:8, border:'1px solid #d1d5db', background:'#fff', color:'#374151', fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, cursor:'pointer' }}
              >Close</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── AI Action Result Overlay ────────────────────────────── */}
      {(aiLoading || aiResult) && (
        <div className="ai-result-panel">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="ai-result-header">
            <div className="ai-result-title">
              {aiAction === 'fix' && <><Wand2 size={14} /> Fix SQL</>}
              {aiAction === 'enhance' && <><Sparkles size={14} /> Enhance SQL</>}
              {aiAction === 'explain' && <><FileQuestion size={14} /> Explain SQL</>}
              {aiAction === 'suggest' && <><Lightbulb size={14} /> Suggestions</>}
            </div>
            <div className="ai-result-actions">
              {aiResult?.suggested_query && (
                <button className="ai-btn ai-btn-apply" onClick={handleApplySuggestion} title="Apply suggestion to editor">
                  <Check size={12} /> Apply
                </button>
              )}
              {!aiLoading && (
                <button className="ai-btn ai-btn-retry" onClick={() => handleAiAction(aiAction)} title="Retry">
                  <RefreshCw size={12} />
                </button>
              )}
              <button className="ai-btn ai-btn-close" onClick={dismissAiResult}>
                <X size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Body */}
          <div className="ai-result-body">
            {aiLoading ? (
              <div className="ai-loading">
                <Loader2 size={16} className="ai-spin" />
                <span>AI is {aiAction === 'fix' ? 'fixing' : aiAction === 'enhance' ? 'enhancing' : aiAction === 'explain' ? 'explaining' : 'analyzing'} your query...</span>
              </div>
            ) : aiResult ? (
              <>
                {aiResult.suggested_query && (
                  <div className="ai-suggested-query">
                    <div className="ai-sq-label">Suggested Query:</div>
                    <pre className="ai-sq-code">{aiResult.suggested_query}</pre>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="ai-explanation">
                  <div className="ai-sq-label">Explanation:</div>
                  <div className="ai-explanation-text">{aiResult.message?.replace(/```sql[\s\S]*?```/g, '').trim()}</div>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Monaco Editor */}
      <Editor
        height="220px"
        defaultLanguage="sql"
        value={query}
        onChange={(value) => setQuery(value || '')}
        beforeMount={handleEditorWillMount}
        onMount={handleEditorMount}
        options={{
          minimap: { enabled: false },
          fontSize: 14,
          lineHeight: 22,
          padding: { top: 12, bottom: 12 },
          scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
          wordWrap: 'on',
          formatOnPaste: true,
          formatOnType: true,
          automaticLayout: true,
          suggestOnTriggerCharacters: true,
          quickSuggestions: {
            other: true,
            comments: false,
            strings: false,
          },
          acceptSuggestionOnEnter: 'on',
          tabCompletion: 'on',
          wordBasedSuggestions: 'off',
          parameterHints: { enabled: true },
          suggest: {
            showKeywords: true,
            showSnippets: true,
            showFunctions: true,
            preview: true,
            filterGraceful: true,
            snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions: false,
          },
          renderWhitespace: 'none',
          glyphMargin: false,
          folding: false,
          lineDecorationsWidth: 5,
          lineNumbersMinChars: 3,
          overviewRulerBorder: false,
        }}
        theme="vs"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/QueryAnalyzer.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Gauge, Play, RefreshCw, Search, Clock, AlertTriangle, ChevronDown, ChevronUp,
  Database, Zap, TrendingUp, X, Info, ArrowRight, Copy, CheckCircle2, BarChart3,
  Table2, Filter, Download,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './QueryAnalyzer.css';

const SEVERITY = {
  high:   { bg: '#fef2f2', border: '#ef4444', text: '#b91c1c', icon: '🔴' },
  medium: { bg: '#fffbeb', border: '#f59e0b', text: '#b45309', icon: '🟡' },
  low:    { bg: '#f0fdf4', border: '#22c55e', text: '#15803d', icon: '🟢' },
};

const TYPE_LABELS = {
  index:        { label: 'Index',       color: '#6366f1' },
  memory:       { label: 'Memory',      color: '#f59e0b' },
  rewrite:      { label: 'Rewrite',     color: '#3b82f6' },
  statistics:   { label: 'Statistics',  color: '#10b981' },
  partitioning: { label: 'Partition',   color: '#ec4899' },
  info:         { label: 'Info',        color: '#94a3b8' },
};

const NODE_TYPE_COLORS = {
  'Seq Scan':       '#ef4444',
  'Index Scan':     '#22c55e',
  'Index Only Scan':'#10b981',
  'Bitmap Heap Scan':'#f59e0b',
  'Bitmap Index Scan':'#eab308',
  'Hash Join':      '#6366f1',
  'Merge Join':     '#8b5cf6',
  'Nested Loop':    '#ec4899',
  'Hash':           '#06b6d4',
  'Sort':           '#f97316',
  'Aggregate':      '#3b82f6',
  'Limit':          '#64748b',
  'Result':         '#94a3b8',
  'BigQuery Scan':  '#4285f4',
};

export default function QueryAnalyzer() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('explain');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [database, setDatabase] = useState('');
  const [dbType, setDbType] = useState('cloudsql');
  const [databases, setDatabases] = useState([]);

  // EXPLAIN state
  const [explainResult, setExplainResult] = useState(null);
  const [explainLoading, setExplainLoading] = useState(false);

  // Cost estimate state
  const [costResult, setCostResult] = useState(null);
  const [costLoading, setCostLoading] = useState(false);

  // Slow queries
  const [slowQueries, setSlowQueries] = useState([]);
  const [slowLoading, setSlowLoading] = useState(false);
  const [slowExpanded, setSlowExpanded] = useState(null);

  // Index suggestions
  const [indexTable, setIndexTable] = useState('');
  const [indexDb, setIndexDb] = useState('');
  const [indexResult, setIndexResult] = useState(null);
  const [indexLoading, setIndexLoading] = useState(false);

  // Plan view mode
  const [planView, setPlanView] = useState('visual'); // visual | text | json

  // Load databases
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases(dbType);
        const data = res?.data ?? res;
        setDatabases(data?.databases || []);
      } catch { /* silent */ }
    })();
  }, [dbType]);

  // Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE
  const handleExplain = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!query.trim()) return toast.error('Enter a SQL query');
    if (!database) return toast.error('Select a database');
    setExplainLoading(true);
    setExplainResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.analyzeExplain({ query: query.trim(), database, db_type: dbType });
      const data = res?.data ?? res;
      if (data?.success) {
        setExplainResult(data);
        toast.success(`Plan retrieved in ${data.duration_ms || 0}ms`);
      } else {
        toast.error(data?.detail || 'EXPLAIN failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || 'EXPLAIN failed');
    } finally {
      setExplainLoading(false);
    }
  }, [query, database, dbType]);

  // Quick cost estimate
  const handleEstimate = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!query.trim()) return toast.error('Enter a SQL query');
    if (!database) return toast.error('Select a database');
    setCostLoading(true);
    setCostResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.estimateQueryCost({ query: query.trim(), database, db_type: dbType });
      const data = res?.data ?? res;
      if (data?.success) {
        setCostResult(data);
      } else {
        toast.error(data?.detail || 'Estimate failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || 'Estimate failed');
    } finally {
      setCostLoading(false);
    }
  }, [query, database, dbType]);

  // Load slow queries
  const loadSlowQueries = useCallback(async () => {
    setSlowLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getSlowQueries(50);
      const data = res?.data ?? res;
      setSlowQueries(data?.queries || []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load slow queries');
    } finally {
      setSlowLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Load slow queries on tab change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'slow') loadSlowQueries();
  }, [activeTab, loadSlowQueries]);

  // Index suggestions
  const handleIndexScan = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!indexTable.trim() || !indexDb.trim()) return toast.error('Enter database and table name');
    setIndexLoading(true);
    setIndexResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getIndexSuggestions(indexDb.trim(), indexTable.trim());
      const data = res?.data ?? res;
      if (data?.success) {
        setIndexResult(data);
      } else {
        toast.error(data?.detail || 'Index scan failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || 'Index scan failed');
    } finally {
      setIndexLoading(false);
    }
  }, [indexTable, indexDb]);

  const copyToClipboard = text => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast.success('Copied!');
  };

  return (
    <div className="analyzer-container">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="analyzer-header">
        <div className="analyzer-title-row">
          <Gauge size={22} className="text-amber-600" />
          <h2>Query Performance Analyzer</h2>
        </div>
        <p className="analyzer-subtitle">
          EXPLAIN plans, slow query log, index suggestions, and cost estimation.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="analyzer-tabs">
        {[
          { id: 'explain', label: 'EXPLAIN Plan', icon: Play },
          { id: 'slow', label: 'Slow Queries', icon: Clock },
          { id: 'index', label: 'Index Advisor', icon: Zap },
        ].map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            className={`analyzer-tab ${activeTab === tab.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
          >
            <tab.icon size={14} />
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* ─── EXPLAIN Tab ─────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'explain' && (
        <div className="analyzer-content">
          {/* Query Input */}
          <div className="analyzer-query-panel">
            <div className="analyzer-query-controls">
              <select
                value={dbType}
                onChange={e => setDbType(e.target.value)}
                className="analyzer-select"
              >
                <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
              </select>
              <select
                value={database}
                onChange={e => setDatabase(e.target.value)}
                className="analyzer-select flex-1"
              >
                <option value="">Select database…</option>
                {databases.map(db => {
                  const name = typeof db === 'string' ? db : db.name || db.database_name || String(db);
                  return <option key={name} value={name}>{name}</option>;
                })}
              </select>
              <button className="analyzer-btn primary" onClick={handleExplain} disabled={explainLoading}>
                {explainLoading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Play size={14} />}
                EXPLAIN ANALYZE
              </button>
              <button className="analyzer-btn secondary" onClick={handleEstimate} disabled={costLoading}>
                {costLoading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <TrendingUp size={14} />}
                Quick Estimate
              </button>
            </div>
            <textarea
              className="analyzer-textarea"
              value={query}
              onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="SELECT * FROM users WHERE created_at > '2024-01-01' ORDER BY id LIMIT 100;"
              rows={5}
              spellCheck={false}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Cost Estimate Card */}
          {costResult && (
            <div className="analyzer-cost-card">
              <div className="cost-card-header">
                <TrendingUp size={16} className="text-indigo-600" />
                <span>Cost Estimate</span>
                <button onClick={() => setCostResult(null)}><X size={14} /></button>
              </div>
              <div className="cost-card-body">
                {costResult.db_type === 'bigquery' ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="cost-stat"><span>Bytes Scanned</span><strong>{(costResult.bytes_processed / (1024 ** 2)).toFixed(1)} MB</strong></div>
                    <div className="cost-stat"><span>Estimated Cost</span><strong>${costResult.estimated_cost_usd?.toFixed(6)}</strong></div>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <div className="cost-stat"><span>Total Cost</span><strong>{costResult.total_cost?.toFixed(1)}</strong></div>
                    <div className="cost-stat"><span>Estimated Rows</span><strong>{(costResult.estimated_rows || 0).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
                    <div className="cost-stat"><span>Row Width</span><strong>{costResult.estimated_width} bytes</strong></div>
                  </>
                )}
                <p className="cost-human">{costResult.human}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* EXPLAIN Result */}
          {explainResult && (
            <div className="analyzer-result">
              {/* Controls */}
              <div className="result-header">
                <div className="result-stats">
                  {explainResult.db_type !== 'bigquery' && (
                    <>
                      <span className="result-stat"><Clock size={12} /> {explainResult.actual_time_ms?.toFixed(1)} ms</span>
                      <span className="result-stat"><Table2 size={12} /> {(explainResult.rows_returned || 0).toLocaleString()} rows</span>
                      <span className="result-stat"><BarChart3 size={12} /> Cost: {explainResult.cost_estimate?.toFixed(1)}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {explainResult.db_type === 'bigquery' && (
                    <>
                      <span className="result-stat"><Database size={12} /> {((explainResult.bytes_processed || 0) / (1024 ** 2)).toFixed(1)} MB</span>
                      <span className="result-stat"><TrendingUp size={12} /> ${explainResult.cost_estimate?.toFixed(6)}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="result-view-toggle">
                  {['visual', 'text', 'json'].map(v => (
                    <button
                      key={v}
                      className={`toggle-btn ${planView === v ? 'active' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => setPlanView(v)}
                    >
                      {v.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + v.slice(1)}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Visual Plan */}
              {planView === 'visual' && explainResult.plan_tree && (
                <div className="plan-visual">
                  {explainResult.plan_tree.map((node, i) => {
                    const color = NODE_TYPE_COLORS[node.node_type] || '#94a3b8';
                    const barWidth = node.total_cost
                      ? Math.max(8, Math.min(100, (node.total_cost / (explainResult.cost_estimate || 1)) * 100))
                      : 8;

                    return (
                      <div key={i} className="plan-node" style={{ paddingLeft: node.depth * 28 + 12 }}>
                        <div className="plan-node-bar" style={{ width: `${barWidth}%`, background: color + '18', borderLeft: `3px solid ${color}` }}>
                          <div className="plan-node-header">
                            <span className="plan-node-type" style={{ color }}>{node.node_type}</span>
                            {node.relation && <span className="plan-node-rel">on <strong>{node.relation}</strong></span>}
                            {node.alias && node.alias !== node.relation && <span className="plan-node-alias">({node.alias})</span>}
                            {node.index_name && <span className="plan-node-idx">using {node.index_name}</span>}
                          </div>
                          <div className="plan-node-metrics">
                            <span title="Actual time">{node.actual_time?.toFixed(2)} ms</span>
                            <span title="Actual rows">{(node.actual_rows || 0).toLocaleString()} rows</span>
                            <span title="Estimated rows">(est: {(node.plan_rows || 0).toLocaleString()})</span>
                            <span title="Total cost">cost: {node.total_cost?.toFixed(1)}</span>
                            {node.loops > 1 && <span title="Loops">×{node.loops}</span>}
                            {node.shared_hit > 0 && <span title="Buffer hits">hit: {node.shared_hit}</span>}
                            {node.shared_read > 0 && <span title="Buffer reads" className="text-red-500">read: {node.shared_read}</span>}
                          </div>
                          {node.filter && <div className="plan-node-detail">Filter: {node.filter}</div>}
                          {node.index_cond && <div className="plan-node-detail">Index Cond: {node.index_cond}</div>}
                          {node.hash_cond && <div className="plan-node-detail">Hash Cond: {node.hash_cond}</div>}
                          {node.rows_removed_by_filter > 0 && (
                            <div className="plan-node-detail text-amber-600">
                              Rows removed by filter: {node.rows_removed_by_filter.toLocaleString()}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Text Plan */}
              {planView === 'text' && (
                <div className="plan-text-wrapper">
                  <button className="copy-btn" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(explainResult.plan_text)}>
                    <Copy size={12} /> Copy
                  </button>
                  <pre className="plan-text">{explainResult.plan_text}</pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* JSON Plan */}
              {planView === 'json' && (
                <div className="plan-text-wrapper">
                  <button className="copy-btn" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(JSON.stringify(explainResult.plan_json, null, 2))}>
                    <Copy size={12} /> Copy
                  </button>
                  <pre className="plan-text">{JSON.stringify(explainResult.plan_json, null, 2)}</pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Suggestions */}
              {explainResult.suggestions && explainResult.suggestions.length > 0 && (
                <div className="suggestions-section">
                  <h4><Zap size={14} /> Optimization Suggestions</h4>
                  {explainResult.suggestions.map((s, i) => {
                    const sev = SEVERITY[s.severity] || SEVERITY.low;
                    const typ = TYPE_LABELS[s.type] || TYPE_LABELS.info;
                    return (
                      <div key={i} className="suggestion-card" style={{ borderLeftColor: sev.border }}>
                        <div className="suggestion-header">
                          <span className="suggestion-sev" style={{ background: sev.bg, color: sev.text }}>
                            {sev.icon} {s.severity?.toUpperCase()}
                          </span>
                          <span className="suggestion-type" style={{ color: typ.color }}>{typ.label}</span>
                          <span className="suggestion-title">{s.title}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="suggestion-detail">{s.detail}</p>
                        {s.recommendation && (
                          <div className="suggestion-rec">
                            <code>{s.recommendation}</code>
                            <button onClick={() => copyToClipboard(s.recommendation)} title="Copy">
                              <Copy size={12} />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Slow Queries Tab ────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'slow' && (
        <div className="analyzer-content">
          <div className="slow-header">
            <h3><Clock size={16} /> Slow Query Log</h3>
            <button className="analyzer-btn secondary" onClick={loadSlowQueries} disabled={slowLoading}>
              {slowLoading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw size={14} />}
              Refresh
            </button>
          </div>

          {slowQueries.length === 0 && !slowLoading && (
            <div className="analyzer-empty">
              <CheckCircle2 size={36} className="text-green-400" />
              <p>No slow queries recorded yet. Queries taking over 500ms will appear here.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {slowLoading && (
            <div className="analyzer-empty">
              <RefreshCw size={24} className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
              <p>Loading slow query log…</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {slowQueries.length > 0 && (
            <div className="slow-list">
              {slowQueries.map((sq, i) => (
                <div key={sq.id || i} className="slow-card">
                  <div className="slow-card-header" onClick={() => setSlowExpanded(slowExpanded === i ? null : i)}>
                    <span className={`slow-dur ${sq.duration_ms > 5000 ? 'critical' : sq.duration_ms > 2000 ? 'warning' : 'normal'}`}>
                      {sq.duration_ms.toLocaleString()} ms
                    </span>
                    <span className="slow-db">{sq.database_name} ({sq.db_type})</span>
                    <span className="slow-rows">{(sq.row_count || 0).toLocaleString()} rows</span>
                    <span className="slow-time">{new Date(sq.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    <span className="slow-user">{sq.user_id}</span>
                    {slowExpanded === i ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
                  </div>
                  <div className="slow-sql">{sq.query_text?.slice(0, 120)}{sq.query_text?.length > 120 ? '…' : ''}</div>
                  {slowExpanded === i && (
                    <div className="slow-expanded">
                      <pre className="slow-full-sql">{sq.query_text}</pre>
                      {sq.suggestions && sq.suggestions.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="slow-suggestions">
                          <strong>Suggestions:</strong>
                          {sq.suggestions.map((s, j) => (
                            <div key={j} className="slow-suggestion-item">
                              <span className="suggestion-sev" style={{ background: SEVERITY[s.severity]?.bg, color: SEVERITY[s.severity]?.text }}>
                                {s.severity}
                              </span>
                              {s.title} — {s.detail}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Index Advisor Tab ───────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'index' && (
        <div className="analyzer-content">
          <div className="index-search">
            <div className="lineage-search-group">
              <label>Database *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. mydb"
                value={indexDb}
                onChange={e => setIndexDb(e.target.value)}
                className="lineage-input"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="lineage-search-group">
              <label>Table *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. users"
                value={indexTable}
                onChange={e => setIndexTable(e.target.value)}
                className="lineage-input"
              />
            </div>
            <button className="analyzer-btn primary" onClick={handleIndexScan} disabled={indexLoading}>
              {indexLoading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Zap size={14} />}
              Analyze Indexes
            </button>
          </div>

          {!indexResult && !indexLoading && (
            <div className="analyzer-empty">
              <Zap size={36} className="text-gray-300" />
              <p>Enter a database and table name to analyze its indexes and get recommendations.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {indexLoading && (
            <div className="analyzer-empty">
              <RefreshCw size={24} className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" />
              <p>Scanning table indexes and statistics…</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {indexResult && (
            <div className="index-report">
              {/* Table Stats */}
              <div className="index-stats-grid">
                <div className="index-stat-card">
                  <span className="stat-label">Estimated Rows</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{(indexResult.table_stats?.row_estimate || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="index-stat-card">
                  <span className="stat-label">Table Size</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{indexResult.table_stats?.total_size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="index-stat-card">
                  <span className="stat-label">Seq Scans</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{(indexResult.usage_stats?.seq_scan || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="index-stat-card">
                  <span className="stat-label">Index Scans</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{(indexResult.usage_stats?.idx_scan || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="index-stat-card">
                  <span className="stat-label">Dead Tuples</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{(indexResult.usage_stats?.n_dead_tup || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="index-stat-card">
                  <span className="stat-label">Live Tuples</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{(indexResult.usage_stats?.n_live_tup || 0).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Existing Indexes */}
              <div className="index-section">
                <h4><Database size={14} /> Existing Indexes ({indexResult.existing_indexes?.length || 0})</h4>
                {(indexResult.existing_indexes || []).length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 p-3">No indexes found on this table.</p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="index-list">
                    {indexResult.existing_indexes.map((idx, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="index-item">
                        <span className="index-name">{idx.indexname}</span>
                        <code className="index-def">{idx.indexdef}</code>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Suggestions */}
              <div className="index-section">
                <h4><Zap size={14} /> Suggestions ({indexResult.suggestions?.length || 0})</h4>
                {(indexResult.suggestions || []).length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="analyzer-empty" style={{ padding: '24px' }}>
                    <CheckCircle2 size={24} className="text-green-500" />
                    <p>No index issues detected. Table looks healthy!</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  indexResult.suggestions.map((s, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="suggestion-card" style={{ borderLeftColor: s.priority === 'high' ? '#ef4444' : s.priority === 'medium' ? '#f59e0b' : '#22c55e' }}>
                      <div className="suggestion-header">
                        <span className="suggestion-sev" style={{ background: SEVERITY[s.priority]?.bg || '#f1f5f9', color: SEVERITY[s.priority]?.text || '#475569' }}>
                          {s.priority?.toUpperCase()}
                        </span>
                        <span className="suggestion-title">{s.column && s.column !== '*' ? `Column: ${s.column}` : 'Table-level'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="suggestion-detail">{s.reason}</p>
                      {s.sql && (
                        <div className="suggestion-rec">
                          <code>{s.sql}</code>
                          <button onClick={() => copyToClipboard(s.sql)} title="Copy"><Copy size={12} /></button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Column Stats */}
              {indexResult.column_stats && indexResult.column_stats.length > 0 && (
                <div className="index-section">
                  <h4><Table2 size={14} /> Column Statistics</h4>
                  <div className="col-stats-table">
                    <table>
                      <thead>
                        <tr>
                          <th>Column</th>
                          <th>n_distinct</th>
                          <th>null_frac</th>
                          <th>avg_width</th>
                          <th>correlation</th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody>
                        {indexResult.column_stats.map((cs, i) => (
                          <tr key={i}>
                            <td className="font-semibold">{cs.attname}</td>
                            <td>{cs.n_distinct?.toFixed(2)}</td>
                            <td>{(cs.null_frac * 100).toFixed(1)}%</td>
                            <td>{cs.avg_width}</td>
                            <td>{cs.correlation?.toFixed(3)}</td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  align-items: center;

}

  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #475569;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

.analyzer-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

.analyzer-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: none;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  resize: vertical;
  outline: none;
  color: #1e293b;
  background: #fafbfc;
}

.analyzer-textarea:focus { background: white; }

/* Cost Card */

src/components/PivotTable.jsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Grid3X3, X, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import './PivotTable.css';

const AGG_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'sum', label: 'Sum' },
  { value: 'count', label: 'Count' },
  { value: 'avg', label: 'Average' },
  { value: 'min', label: 'Min' },
  { value: 'max', label: 'Max' },
];

export default function PivotTable({ data, columns, onClose }) {
  const [rowField, setRowField] = useState('');
  const [colField, setColField] = useState('');
  const [valueField, setValueField] = useState('');
  const [aggFunc, setAggFunc] = useState('sum');

  // Auto-detect numeric columns
  const numericCols = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return [];
    return columns.filter(col => {
      const sample = data.slice(0, 20).map(r => r[col]).filter(v => v !== null && v !== undefined);
      return sample.length > 0 && sample.every(v => !isNaN(Number(v)));
    });
  }, [data, columns]);

  // Auto-select on mount
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (columns?.length >= 2) {
      if (!rowField) setRowField(columns[0]);
      if (!colField && columns.length > 1) setColField(columns[1]);
      if (!valueField && numericCols.length > 0) setValueField(numericCols[0]);
    }
  }, [columns, numericCols]);

  // Build pivot data
  const pivotResult = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rowField || !colField || !valueField || !data?.length) return null;

    const rowValues = new Set();
    const colValues = new Set();
    const cells = {};

    data.forEach(row => {
      const rv = String(row[rowField] ?? 'null');
      const cv = String(row[colField] ?? 'null');
      const val = Number(row[valueField]) || 0;

      rowValues.add(rv);
      colValues.add(cv);

      const key = `${rv}|||${cv}`;
      if (!cells[key]) cells[key] = [];
      cells[key].push(val);
    });

    const sortedRows = [...rowValues].sort();
    const sortedCols = [...colValues].sort();

    const aggregate = (values) => {
      if (!values || values.length === 0) return null;
      switch (aggFunc) {
        case 'sum': return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        case 'count': return values.length;
        case 'avg': return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
        case 'min': return Math.min(...values);
        case 'max': return Math.max(...values);
        default: return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      }
    };

    const pivotData = sortedRows.map(rv => {
      const row = { _rowLabel: rv };
      let rowTotal = 0;
      sortedCols.forEach(cv => {
        const val = aggregate(cells[`${rv}|||${cv}`]);
        row[cv] = val;
        if (val !== null) rowTotal += val;
      });
      row._total = rowTotal;
      return row;
    });

    // Column totals
    const colTotals = { _rowLabel: 'Total' };
    let grandTotal = 0;
    sortedCols.forEach(cv => {
      let total = 0;
      sortedRows.forEach(rv => {
        const val = aggregate(cells[`${rv}|||${cv}`]);
        if (val !== null) total += val;
      });
      colTotals[cv] = total;
      grandTotal += total;
    });
    colTotals._total = grandTotal;

    return { pivotData, sortedCols, colTotals };
  }, [data, rowField, colField, valueField, aggFunc]);

  const formatVal = (v) => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return '-';
    if (aggFunc === 'count') return v.toLocaleString();
    if (Number.isInteger(v)) return v.toLocaleString();
    return v.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="pivot-empty">
        <Grid3X3 size={32} />
        <p>No data for pivot table</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="pivot-container">
      <div className="pivot-toolbar">
        <div className="pivot-fields">
          <div className="pivot-field">
            <label>Row</label>
            <select value={rowField} onChange={e => setRowField(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Select...</option>
              {columns.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="pivot-field">
            <label>Column</label>
            <select value={colField} onChange={e => setColField(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Select...</option>
              {columns.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="pivot-field">
            <label>Value</label>
            <select value={valueField} onChange={e => setValueField(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Select...</option>
              {columns.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="pivot-field">
            <label>Aggregate</label>
            <select value={aggFunc} onChange={e => setAggFunc(e.target.value)}>
              {AGG_OPTIONS.map(a => <option key={a.value} value={a.value}>{a.label}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="pivot-actions">
          <button className="pivot-btn" onClick={() => { setRowField(''); setColField(''); setValueField(''); }} title="Reset">
            <RotateCcw size={13} />
          </button>
          {onClose && (
            <button className="pivot-btn" onClick={onClose} title="Close">
              <X size={13} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {pivotResult ? (
        <div className="pivot-table-wrap">
          <table className="pivot-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th className="pivot-corner">{rowField} \ {colField}</th>
                {pivotResult.sortedCols.map(c => <th key={c}>{c}</th>)}
                <th className="pivot-total-header">Total</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {pivotResult.pivotData.map((row, i) => (
                <tr key={i}>
                  <th className="pivot-row-header">{row._rowLabel}</th>
                  {pivotResult.sortedCols.map(c => (
                    <td key={c} className={row[c] !== null ? '' : 'pivot-null'}>
                      {formatVal(row[c])}
                    </td>
                  ))}
                  <td className="pivot-total-cell">{formatVal(row._total)}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              <tr className="pivot-totals-row">
                <th className="pivot-row-header">Total</th>
                {pivotResult.sortedCols.map(c => (
                  <td key={c} className="pivot-total-cell">{formatVal(pivotResult.colTotals[c])}</td>
                ))}
                <td className="pivot-grand-total">{formatVal(pivotResult.colTotals._total)}</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="pivot-no-data">
          <Grid3X3 size={24} />
          <p>Select Row, Column, and Value fields to build pivot table</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
