src/components/PgVectorModal.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  X, Database, Zap, Clock, CheckCircle, AlertCircle,
  Loader2, RefreshCw, RotateCcw, Search, ChevronDown, ChevronUp,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

const EMBEDDING_MODEL = 'text-embedding-005';

const SYNC_MODES = [
  {
    value: 'incremental',
    label: 'Incremental',
    icon: RefreshCw,
    color: 'indigo',
    desc: 'Embeds only new/changed rows. Deletes rows removed from source. Best for scheduled runs.',
  },
  {
    value: 'full_refresh',
    label: 'Full Refresh',
    icon: RotateCcw,
    color: 'amber',
    desc: 'Truncates vector table and re-embeds all rows. Table structure and indexes are preserved.',
  },
  {
    value: 'recreate',
    label: 'Recreate',
    icon: Database,
    color: 'red',
    desc: 'Drops and recreates the vector table. Use when you change which columns are embedded.',
  },
];

const mc = {
  indigo: { on: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600', off: 'border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:border-indigo-400 bg-white' },
  amber:  { on: 'bg-amber-500  text-white border-amber-500',  off: 'border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:border-amber-400  bg-white' },
  red:    { on: 'bg-red-600    text-white border-red-600',    off: 'border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:border-red-400    bg-white' },
};

const statusBg = {
  running:   'border-blue-200 bg-blue-50',
  completed: 'border-green-200 bg-green-50',
  failed:    'border-red-200 bg-red-50',
  scheduled: 'border-purple-200 bg-purple-50',
};

function StatusIcon({ status }) {
  if (status === 'running')   return <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin text-blue-600" />;
  if (status === 'completed') return <CheckCircle size={16} className="text-green-600" />;
  if (status === 'failed')    return <AlertCircle size={16} className="text-red-600" />;
  if (status === 'scheduled') return <Clock size={16} className="text-purple-600" />;
  return <RefreshCw size={16} className="text-gray-400" />;
}

export default function PgVectorModal({ isOpen, onClose, context }) {
  const { database = '', columns = [], sourceTable = '' } = context || {};

  // Conversion config
  const [textColumns, setTextColumns]       = useState([]);
  const [metadataColumns, setMetadataColumns] = useState([]);
  const [targetTable, setTargetTable]       = useState('');
  const [vectorColumn, setVectorColumn]     = useState('embedding');
  const [syncMode, setSyncMode]             = useState('incremental');
  const [chunkStrategy, setChunkStrategy]   = useState('full_row');
  const [chunkSize, setChunkSize]           = useState(500);
  const [chunkOverlap, setChunkOverlap]     = useState(50);
  const [batchSize, setBatchSize]           = useState(50);
  const [runMode, setRunMode]               = useState('now');
  const [scheduleCron, setScheduleCron]     = useState('0 2 * * *');
  const [ragOpen, setRagOpen]               = useState(false);

  // Job tracking
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [jobId, setJobId]           = useState(null);
  const [jobStatus, setJobStatus]   = useState(null);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  // Test search
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery]     = useState('');
  const [searchTopK, setSearchTopK]       = useState(3);
  const [searching, setSearching]         = useState(false);
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState(null);

  // Reset on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTextColumns([]); setMetadataColumns([]);
      setTargetTable(sourceTable ? `${sourceTable}_vectors` : '');
      setVectorColumn('embedding'); setSyncMode('incremental');
      setChunkStrategy('full_row'); setChunkSize(500); setChunkOverlap(50);
      setBatchSize(50); setRunMode('now'); setScheduleCron('0 2 * * *');
      setRagOpen(false); setJobId(null); setJobStatus(null);
      setSearchQuery(''); setSearchResults(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, sourceTable]);

  // Poll job status
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId) return;
    const poll = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await sqlEditorAPI.pgvectorGetJob(jobId);
        if (res.data?.job) {
          setJobStatus(res.data.job);
          if (['completed', 'failed', 'scheduled'].includes(res.data.job.status))
            clearInterval(pollRef.current);
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    };
    poll();
    pollRef.current = setInterval(poll, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
  }, [jobId]);

  const toggle = (col, list, setList) =>
    setList(prev => prev.includes(col) ? prev.filter(c => c !== col) : [...prev, col]);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!textColumns.length) { toast.error('Select at least one text column to embed'); return; }
    if (!targetTable.trim())  { toast.error('Target table name is required'); return; }
    if (chunkStrategy === 'fixed' && chunkOverlap >= chunkSize) {
      toast.error('Chunk overlap must be less than chunk size'); return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.pgvectorConvert({
        source_database: database,
        source_schema: 'public',
        source_table: sourceTable,
        target_table: targetTable.trim(),
        text_columns: textColumns,
        metadata_columns: metadataColumns,
        vector_column: vectorColumn,
        sync_mode: syncMode,
        chunk_strategy: chunkStrategy,
        chunk_size: chunkSize,
        chunk_overlap: chunkOverlap,
        batch_size: batchSize,
        run_mode: runMode,
        schedule_cron: scheduleCron,
      });
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setJobId(res.data.job_id);
        toast.success(res.data.message || 'Job started');
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to start job');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Error starting job');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) { toast.error('Enter a search query'); return; }
    setSearching(true); setSearchResults(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.pgvectorSearch({
        database,
        schema: 'public',
        table: targetTable.trim() || (sourceTable ? `${sourceTable}_vectors` : ''),
        question: searchQuery,
        top_k: searchTopK,
        vector_column: vectorColumn,
      });
      if (res.data?.success) setSearchResults(res.data);
      else toast.error('Search failed');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Search error');
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const syncDef = SYNC_MODES.find(m => m.value === syncMode);
  const jobDone = jobStatus?.status === 'completed';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">

        {/* ── Header ── */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Database size={20} className="text-indigo-600" />
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">PgVector Table Sync</h2>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition"><X size={20} /></button>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 px-6 py-5 space-y-5">

          {/* Source info */}
          <div className="bg-indigo-50 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-indigo-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Database size={14} />
            <span>Source: <strong>{database}</strong>{sourceTable && <> · <strong>{sourceTable}</strong></>}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Embedding model (read-only) */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Embedding Model</label>
            <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 rounded text-sm text-gray-600 font-mono">{EMBEDDING_MODEL} · 768 dims</div>
          </div>

          {/* Sync mode */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Sync Mode</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {SYNC_MODES.map(opt => (
                <button key={opt.value} onClick={() => setSyncMode(opt.value)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded border text-sm font-medium transition ${syncMode === opt.value ? mc[opt.color].on : mc[opt.color].off}`}>
                  <opt.icon size={13} /> {opt.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {syncDef && <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1.5 pl-0.5">{syncDef.desc}</p>}
            {syncMode === 'incremental' && (
              <div className="mt-2 text-xs bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 rounded p-2 text-indigo-700 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-0.5">
                <span>✓ Auto-detects primary key</span>
                <span>✓ Skips unchanged rows</span>
                <span>✓ Re-embeds changed rows only</span>
                <span>✓ Removes deleted rows</span>
              </div>
            )}
            {syncMode === 'recreate' && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">⚠ Drops and recreates the vector table — all existing vectors will be lost.</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Column selection */}
          {columns.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
                  Text Columns to Embed <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  <span className="normal-case font-normal text-gray-400 ml-1">— concatenated then vectorized</span>
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto border border-gray-200 rounded p-2">
                  {columns.map(col => (
                    <label key={col} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 rounded px-1.5 py-1">
                      <input type="checkbox" checked={textColumns.includes(col)}
                        onChange={() => toggle(col, textColumns, setTextColumns)} className="accent-indigo-600" />
                      <span className="font-mono truncate">{col}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {textColumns.length > 0 && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-indigo-600 mt-1">Embedding: {textColumns.join(' + ')}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
                  Metadata Columns
                  <span className="normal-case font-normal text-gray-400 ml-1">— stored in <code className="bg-gray-100 px-1 rounded">_metadata</code> JSONB for RAG context</span>
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 max-h-28 overflow-y-auto border border-gray-200 rounded p-2">
                  {columns.filter(c => !textColumns.includes(c)).map(col => (
                    <label key={col} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 rounded px-1.5 py-1">
                      <input type="checkbox" checked={metadataColumns.includes(col)}
                        onChange={() => toggle(col, metadataColumns, setMetadataColumns)} className="accent-purple-600" />
                      <span className="font-mono truncate">{col}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {metadataColumns.length > 0 && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-purple-600 mt-1">Metadata: {metadataColumns.join(', ')}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Target table + vector column + batch */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Target Table</label>
              <input type="text" value={targetTable} onChange={e => setTargetTable(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
                placeholder="my_table_vectors" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Vector Column</label>
              <input type="text" value={vectorColumn} onChange={e => setVectorColumn(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
                placeholder="embedding" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Batch Size</label>
              <input type="number" value={batchSize} min={1} max={500}
                onChange={e => setBatchSize(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── RAG Config (collapsible) ── */}
          <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
            <button
              onClick={() => setRagOpen(o => !o)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 transition"
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Search size={14} className="text-purple-600" />
                RAG Config — Chunking Strategy
              </span>
              {ragOpen ? <ChevronUp size={15} /> : <ChevronDown size={15} />}
            </button>

            {ragOpen && (
              <div className="px-4 py-4 space-y-4">
                {/* Chunk strategy */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Chunk Strategy</label>
                  <div className="flex gap-3">
                    {[
                      { value: 'full_row', label: 'Full Row', desc: '1 vector per source row' },
                      { value: 'fixed',    label: 'Fixed Size', desc: 'Split into overlapping chunks' },
                    ].map(opt => (
                      <button key={opt.value} onClick={() => setChunkStrategy(opt.value)}
                        className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-start px-3 py-2 rounded border text-sm transition ${
                          chunkStrategy === opt.value
                            ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white border-purple-600'
                            : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:border-purple-400'
                        }`}>
                        <span className="font-medium">{opt.label}</span>
                        <span className={`text-xs mt-0.5 ${chunkStrategy === opt.value ? 'text-purple-100' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>{opt.desc}</span>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {chunkStrategy === 'fixed' && (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">
                        Chunk Size <span className="normal-case font-normal text-gray-400">(characters)</span>
                      </label>
                      <input type="number" value={chunkSize} min={50} max={8000}
                        onChange={e => setChunkSize(Number(e.target.value))}
                        className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-400" />
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">~{Math.round(chunkSize / 4)} tokens · recommended: 300–600</p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">
                        Overlap <span className="normal-case font-normal text-gray-400">(characters)</span>
                      </label>
                      <input type="number" value={chunkOverlap} min={0} max={500}
                        onChange={e => setChunkOverlap(Number(e.target.value))}
                        className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-400" />
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Shared context between chunks · recommended: 10–15%</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {chunkStrategy === 'fixed' && (
                  <div className="bg-purple-50 border border-purple-100 rounded p-3 text-xs text-purple-700 space-y-1">
                    <p>✓ Each chunk gets its own vector row in <code className="bg-purple-100 px-1 rounded">_chunk_text</code></p>
                    <p>✓ <code className="bg-purple-100 px-1 rounded">_chunk_index</code> tracks position within source row</p>
                    <p>✓ Incremental sync re-chunks only changed source rows (no wasted embedding calls)</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Run mode */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Run Mode</label>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              {[{ value: 'now', label: 'Run Now', icon: Zap }, { value: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule (Cron)', icon: Clock }].map(opt => (
                <button key={opt.value} onClick={() => setRunMode(opt.value)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded border text-sm font-medium transition ${
                    runMode === opt.value ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600' : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:border-indigo-400'
                  }`}>
                  <opt.icon size={14} /> {opt.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {runMode === 'schedule' && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-end gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Cron Expression (UTC)</label>
                  <input type="text" value={scheduleCron} onChange={e => setScheduleCron(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-44 border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
                    placeholder="0 2 * * *" />
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 pb-2">e.g. <code>0 2 * * *</code> = daily 2 am UTC</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ── Job status panel ── */}
          {jobStatus && (
            <div className={`border rounded-lg p-4 ${statusBg[jobStatus.status] || 'border-gray-200 bg-gray-50'}`}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <StatusIcon status={jobStatus.status} />
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold capitalize">{jobStatus.status}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono ml-auto">job: {jobStatus.id}</span>
              </div>

              {jobStatus.status === 'running' && jobStatus.total_rows > 0 && (
                <div className="mb-3">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">
                    <span>{jobStatus.processed_rows} / {jobStatus.total_rows} source rows</span>
                    <span>{jobStatus.progress_pct}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-1.5">
                    <div className="bg-blue-600 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${jobStatus.progress_pct}%` }} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {(jobStatus.status === 'running' || jobStatus.status === 'completed') && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center text-xs mb-2">
                  {[
                    { label: 'Inserted', value: jobStatus.inserted_rows ?? 0, color: 'text-green-700 bg-green-100' },
                    { label: 'Updated',  value: jobStatus.updated_rows  ?? 0, color: 'text-blue-700 bg-blue-100'   },
                    { label: 'Deleted',  value: jobStatus.deleted_rows  ?? 0, color: 'text-red-700 bg-red-100'     },
                    { label: 'Skipped',  value: jobStatus.skipped_rows  ?? 0, color: 'text-gray-600 bg-gray-100'   },
                  ].map(s => (
                    <div key={s.label} className={`rounded px-2 py-1.5 ${s.color}`}>
                      <div className="font-bold text-sm">{s.value}</div>
                      <div>{s.label}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              {jobStatus.status === 'completed' && (
                <p className="text-xs text-green-700">
                  ✓ <strong>{jobStatus.target_table}</strong> ready.
                  Sync: <strong>{jobStatus.sync_mode}</strong> ·
                  Chunks: <strong>{jobStatus.chunk_strategy}</strong> ·
                  HNSW cosine index built.
                </p>
              )}
              {jobStatus.status === 'failed' && (
                <p className="text-xs text-red-700 font-mono break-words mt-1">{jobStatus.error_message}</p>
              )}
              {jobStatus.status === 'scheduled' && (
                <p className="text-xs text-purple-700 mt-1">
                  Scheduler job created · sync_mode: <strong>{jobStatus.sync_mode}</strong> · chunks: <strong>{jobStatus.chunk_strategy}</strong>
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── Test RAG Search (shown after job completes) ── */}
          {jobDone && (
            <div className="border border-purple-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
              <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-purple-50 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-purple-800">
                <Search size={14} /> Test RAG Search
              </div>
              <div className="px-4 py-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
                    placeholder="Type a question to test similarity search…"
                    className="flex-1 border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-400"
                  />
                  <select value={searchTopK} onChange={e => setSearchTopK(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none">
                    {[1,3,5,10].map(k => <option key={k} value={k}>Top {k}</option>)}
                  </select>
                  <button onClick={handleSearch} disabled={searching}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded text-sm font-medium hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition">
                    {searching ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Search size={14} />}
                    Search
                  </button>
                </div>

                {searchResults && (
                  <div className="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                    {searchResults.results.length === 0 && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center py-4">No results found.</p>
                    )}
                    {searchResults.results.map((r, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="border border-gray-200 rounded p-3 bg-white text-xs">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                          <span className="font-medium text-gray-700">Result {i + 1}</span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            {r.chunk_index > 0 && (
                              <span className="text-gray-400">chunk #{r.chunk_index}</span>
                            )}
                            <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold ${
                              r.similarity >= 0.8 ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' :
                              r.similarity >= 0.6 ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700' :
                              'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
                            }`}>
                              {(r.similarity * 100).toFixed(1)}% match
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-gray-700 leading-relaxed mb-2 line-clamp-4">{r.chunk_text}</p>
                        {r.metadata && Object.keys(r.metadata).length > 0 && (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                            {Object.entries(r.metadata).map(([k, v]) => (
                              <span key={k} className="bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono">
                                {k}: {String(v ?? '')}
                              </span>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Footer ── */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200">
          {!jobId ? (
            <>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 transition">Cancel</button>
              <button onClick={handleSubmit}
                disabled={submitting || !textColumns.length || !targetTable.trim()}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition">
                {submitting ? <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" /> : <Zap size={15} />}
                {submitting ? 'Starting…' : runMode === 'schedule' ? 'Schedule Job' : 'Start Sync'}
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 text-sm bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded hover:bg-gray-200 transition">Close</button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}





src/components/MigrationTool.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { GitCompare, ArrowRight, Play, RotateCcw, Trash2, Eye, Copy, RefreshCw, Download, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './MigrationTool.css';

const STATUS_MAP = {
  pending:     { label: 'Pending',     cls: 'amber' },
  executed:    { label: 'Executed',    cls: 'green' },
  failed:      { label: 'Failed',      cls: 'red' },
  rolled_back: { label: 'Rolled Back', cls: 'purple' },
};

const MigrationTool = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('compare'); // 'compare' | 'history'
  const [databases, setDatabases] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [migrations, setMigrations] = useState([]);
  const [histLoading, setHistLoading] = useState(false);

  // ── Compare state ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [sourceDb, setSourceDb] = useState('');
  const [targetDb, setTargetDb] = useState('');
  const [sourceType, setSourceType] = useState('cloudsql');
  const [targetType, setTargetType] = useState('cloudsql');
  const [diffResult, setDiffResult] = useState(null);
  const [comparing, setComparing] = useState(false);

  // ── Script state ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState(null); // { alter_script, rollback_script, id }
  const [scriptTab, setScriptTab] = useState('alter');
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);

  // ── Detail view ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [detailMig, setDetailMig] = useState(null);
  const [detailScriptTab, setDetailScriptTab] = useState('alter');

  const loadDatabases = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases('cloudsql');
      const dbs = (res.data?.databases || []).map(d => typeof d === 'string' ? d : d.name || d.database_name || String(d));
      setDatabases(dbs);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setHistLoading(true);
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.migrateHistory();
      setMigrations(res.data?.migrations || []);
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load migration history');
    } finally {
      setHistLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadDatabases(); }, [loadDatabases]);
  useEffect(() => { if (activeTab === 'history') loadHistory(); }, [activeTab, loadHistory]);

  // ── Compare schemas ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCompare = async () => {
    if (!sourceDb || !targetDb) { toast.error('Select both source and target databases'); return; }
    if (sourceDb === targetDb && sourceType === targetType) { toast.error('Source and target must be different'); return; }
    setComparing(true);
    setDiffResult(null);
    setScripts(null);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.migrateDiff({ source_db: sourceDb, target_db: targetDb, source_db_type: sourceType, target_db_type: targetType });
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setDiffResult(res.data);
        toast.success(res.data.diff?.summary || 'Diff complete');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Diff failed');
    } finally {
      setComparing(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Generate scripts ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    if (!diffResult?.diff) return;
    setGenerating(true);
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.migrateGenerate({
        name: `${sourceDb} → ${targetDb}`,
        source_db: sourceDb,
        target_db: targetDb,
        source_db_type: sourceType,
        target_db_type: targetType,
        diff: diffResult.diff,
      });
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setScripts(res.data);
        toast.success('Migration scripts generated & saved');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to generate scripts');
    } finally {
      setGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Execute / Rollback ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleExecute = async (migId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('⚠️ Execute this migration on the target database? This will modify the schema. Are you sure?')) return;
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.executeMigration({ id: migId });
      if (res.data?.success) {
        toast.success('Migration executed successfully!');
        loadHistory();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Execution failed');
    }
  };

  const handleRollback = async (migId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('⚠️ Roll back this migration? This will attempt to undo the schema changes.')) return;
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.rollbackMigration({ id: migId });
      if (res.data?.success) {
        toast.success('Rollback completed');
        loadHistory();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Rollback failed');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteMig = async (migId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this migration record?')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteMigration(migId);
      toast.success('Deleted');
      loadHistory();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const handleViewDetail = async (migId) => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getMigration(migId);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setDetailMig(res.data.migration);
        setDetailScriptTab('alter');
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load migration');
    }
  };

  const copyText = (text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => toast.success('Copied!')).catch(() => toast.error('Copy failed'));
  };

  const downloadScript = (text, filename) => {
    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/sql' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = filename; a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="migration-tool">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mt-header">
        <h2>Database Migration Tool</h2>
        <p>Compare schemas, generate ALTER scripts, and safely plan migrations with rollback support</p>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="mt-toolbar">
        <div className="mt-tabs">
          <button className={`mt-tab ${activeTab === 'compare' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setActiveTab('compare'); setDetailMig(null); }}>
            Schema Diff
          </button>
          <button className={`mt-tab ${activeTab === 'history' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setActiveTab('history'); setDetailMig(null); }}>
            History
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div className="mt-body">
        {/* ── COMPARE VIEW ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {activeTab === 'compare' && (
          <div>
            <div className="mt-compare">
              <h3>Compare Database Schemas</h3>
              <div className="mt-compare-grid">
                <div>
                  <div className="mt-field">
                    <label>Source Database</label>
                    <select value={sourceDb} onChange={e => setSourceDb(e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="">-- Select Source --</option>
                      {databases.map(d => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-field" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                    <label>Type</label>
                    <select value={sourceType} onChange={e => setSourceType(e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                      <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                      <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-compare-arrow">→</div>
                <div>
                  <div className="mt-field">
                    <label>Target Database</label>
                    <select value={targetDb} onChange={e => setTargetDb(e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="">-- Select Target --</option>
                      {databases.map(d => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-field" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                    <label>Type</label>
                    <select value={targetType} onChange={e => setTargetType(e.target.value)}>
                      <option value="cloudsql">CloudSQL</option>
                      <option value="bigquery">BigQuery</option>
                      <option value="mssql">MSSQL</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-primary" onClick={handleCompare} disabled={comparing}>
                <GitCompare size={15} /> {comparing ? 'Comparing...' : 'Compare Schemas'}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Diff Results */}
            {diffResult && (
              <div className="mt-diff">
                <h3>Schema Differences</h3>
                <div className="mt-diff-summary">
                  <GitCompare size={18} />
                  {diffResult.diff?.summary} | Source: {diffResult.source_table_count} tables | Target: {diffResult.target_table_count} tables
                </div>

                {diffResult.diff?.tables_to_add?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Tables to Create <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.tables_to_add.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.tables_to_add.map((t, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item add">
                        + CREATE TABLE {t.table} ({Object.keys(t.columns).length} columns)
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {diffResult.diff?.tables_to_drop?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Tables to Drop <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.tables_to_drop.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.tables_to_drop.map((t, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item drop">- DROP TABLE {t}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {diffResult.diff?.columns_to_add?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Columns to Add <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.columns_to_add.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.columns_to_add.map((c, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item add">+ {c.table}.{c.column} ({c.type})</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {diffResult.diff?.columns_to_drop?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Columns to Drop <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.columns_to_drop.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.columns_to_drop.map((c, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item drop">- {c.table}.{c.column}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {diffResult.diff?.columns_to_alter?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Columns to Alter <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.columns_to_alter.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.columns_to_alter.map((c, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item alter">
                        ~ {c.table}.{c.column}: {c.from_type} → {c.to_type}
                        {c.from_nullable !== c.to_nullable && ` | nullable: ${c.from_nullable} → ${c.to_nullable}`}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {diffResult.diff?.indexes_to_add?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Indexes to Add <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.indexes_to_add.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.indexes_to_add.map((idx, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item add">+ {idx.name}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {diffResult.diff?.indexes_to_drop?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-diff-section">
                    <h4>Indexes to Drop <span className="count">{diffResult.diff.indexes_to_drop.length}</span></h4>
                    {diffResult.diff.indexes_to_drop.map((idx, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="mt-diff-item drop">- {idx.name}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Generate Scripts Button */}
                <div style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
                  <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-success" onClick={handleGenerate} disabled={generating || diffResult.diff?.summary === 'Schemas are identical'}>
                    <Play size={15} /> {generating ? 'Generating...' : 'Generate Migration Scripts'}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Script Preview */}
                {scripts && (
                  <div className="mt-script-preview">
                    <div className="mt-script-tabs">
                      <button className={`mt-script-tab ${scriptTab === 'alter' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setScriptTab('alter')}>
                        ALTER Script
                      </button>
                      <button className={`mt-script-tab ${scriptTab === 'rollback' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setScriptTab('rollback')}>
                        Rollback Script
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <pre className="mt-script-code">
                      {scriptTab === 'alter' ? scripts.alter_script : scripts.rollback_script}
                    </pre>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
                      <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-ghost mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => copyText(scriptTab === 'alter' ? scripts.alter_script : scripts.rollback_script)}>
                        <Copy size={13} /> Copy
                      </button>
                      <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-ghost mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => downloadScript(
                        scriptTab === 'alter' ? scripts.alter_script : scripts.rollback_script,
                        scriptTab === 'alter' ? 'migration.sql' : 'rollback.sql'
                      )}>
                        <Download size={13} /> Download .sql
                      </button>
                      {scriptTab === 'alter' && scripts.id && (
                        <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-warning mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleExecute(scripts.id)} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                          <AlertTriangle size={13} /> Execute on Target
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── HISTORY VIEW ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {activeTab === 'history' && !detailMig && (
          histLoading ? (
            <div className="mt-empty"><p>Loading...</p></div>
          ) : migrations.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="mt-empty">
              <GitCompare size={48} />
              <p>No migration history. Run a schema diff to get started.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-history-grid">
              {migrations.map(m => {
                const st = STATUS_MAP[m.status] || STATUS_MAP.pending;
                return (
                  <div key={m.id} className="mt-h-card">
                    <div className="mt-h-card-head">
                      <h4>{m.name}</h4>
                      <span className={`mt-badge ${st.cls}`}>{st.label}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-h-card-meta">
                      <span className="mt-badge blue">{m.source_db}</span>
                      <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>→</span>
                      <span className="mt-badge blue">{m.target_db}</span>
                      <span className="mt-badge gray">{new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-h-card-actions">
                      <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-ghost mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleViewDetail(m.id)}>
                        <Eye size={13} /> View
                      </button>
                      {m.status === 'pending' && (
                        <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-warning mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleExecute(m.id)}>
                          <Play size={13} /> Execute
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {m.status === 'executed' && (
                        <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-danger mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleRollback(m.id)}>
                          <RotateCcw size={13} /> Rollback
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-danger mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleDeleteMig(m.id)} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                        <Trash2 size={13} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )
        )}

        {/* ── DETAIL VIEW ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {activeTab === 'history' && detailMig && (
          <div>
            <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-ghost mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => setDetailMig(null)} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              ← Back to History
            </button>
            <div className="mt-compare" style={{ maxWidth: 900 }}>
              <h3>{detailMig.name}</h3>
              <div className="mt-h-card-meta" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <span className={`mt-badge ${(STATUS_MAP[detailMig.status] || STATUS_MAP.pending).cls}`}>
                  {(STATUS_MAP[detailMig.status] || STATUS_MAP.pending).label}
                </span>
                <span className="mt-badge blue">{detailMig.source_db}</span>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>→</span>
                <span className="mt-badge blue">{detailMig.target_db}</span>
                <span className="mt-badge gray">{new Date(detailMig.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                {detailMig.executed_at && <span className="mt-badge green">Executed: {new Date(detailMig.executed_at).toLocaleString()}</span>}
              </div>

              {/* Scripts */}
              <div className="mt-script-preview">
                <div className="mt-script-tabs">
                  <button className={`mt-script-tab ${detailScriptTab === 'alter' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setDetailScriptTab('alter')}>
                    ALTER Script
                  </button>
                  <button className={`mt-script-tab ${detailScriptTab === 'rollback' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setDetailScriptTab('rollback')}>
                    Rollback Script
                  </button>
                  {detailMig.execution_log && (
                    <button className={`mt-script-tab ${detailScriptTab === 'log' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setDetailScriptTab('log')}>
                      Execution Log
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <pre className="mt-script-code">
                  {detailScriptTab === 'alter' ? detailMig.alter_script
                    : detailScriptTab === 'rollback' ? detailMig.rollback_script
                    : detailMig.execution_log}
                </pre>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
                  <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-ghost mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => copyText(
                    detailScriptTab === 'alter' ? detailMig.alter_script : detailScriptTab === 'rollback' ? detailMig.rollback_script : detailMig.execution_log
                  )}>
                    <Copy size={13} /> Copy
                  </button>
                  {detailScriptTab !== 'log' && (
                    <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-ghost mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => downloadScript(
                      detailScriptTab === 'alter' ? detailMig.alter_script : detailMig.rollback_script,
                      detailScriptTab === 'alter' ? 'migration.sql' : 'rollback.sql'
                    )}>
                      <Download size={13} /> Download .sql
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {detailMig.status === 'pending' && (
                    <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-warning mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleExecute(detailMig.id)} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                      <AlertTriangle size={13} /> Execute on Target
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {detailMig.status === 'executed' && (
                    <button className="mt-btn mt-btn-danger mt-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleRollback(detailMig.id)} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                      <RotateCcw size={13} /> Rollback
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MigrationTool;

src/components/LoginPage.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Database, ArrowRight, Shield } from 'lucide-react';

export default function LoginPage({ onLogin }) {
  const [vzid, setVzid] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = vzid.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!id) {
      setError('Please enter your VZID');
      return;
    }
    if (id.length < 3) {
      setError('VZID must be at least 3 characters');
      return;
    }
    onLogin(id);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      minHeight: '100vh',
      background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f 0%, #2563eb 50%, #1e40af 100%)',
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
      fontFamily: '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif',
    }}>
      {/* Floating particles decoration */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, overflow: 'hidden', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
        {[...Array(6)].map((_, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            width: 200 + i * 60,
            height: 200 + i * 60,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
            top: `${10 + i * 12}%`,
            left: `${5 + i * 15}%`,
          }} />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={{
        background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)',
        borderRadius: 20,
        boxShadow: '0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
        width: 420,
        maxWidth: '92vw',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        position: 'relative',
      }}>
        {/* Top accent bar */}
        <div style={{
          background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8)',
          height: 6,
        }} />

        <div style={{ padding: '40px 36px 36px' }}>
          {/* Logo / Branding */}
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 32 }}>
            <div style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              width: 64,
              height: 64,
              borderRadius: 16,
              background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8)',
              marginBottom: 16,
            }}>
              <Database size={32} color="#fff" />
            </div>
            <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, color: '#1f2937' }}>
              SQL Editor
            </h1>
            <p style={{ margin: '6px 0 0', fontSize: 14, color: '#6b7280' }}>
              CloudSQL Console &amp; API Builder
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Welcome message */}
          <div style={{
            background: '#eff6ff',
            borderRadius: 12,
            padding: '14px 16px',
            marginBottom: 24,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 10,
          }}>
            <Shield size={18} color="#2563eb" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13, color: '#1e40af', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
              Welcome! Please enter your VZID to continue.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Login form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <label style={{
              display: 'block',
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: '#374151',
              marginBottom: 6,
            }}>
              VZID
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={vzid}
              onChange={(e) => { setVzid(e.target.value); setError(''); }}
              placeholder="e.g. anatan8"
              autoFocus
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                padding: '12px 14px',
                fontSize: 15,
                border: `2px solid ${error ? '#ef4444' : '#d1d5db'}`,
                borderRadius: 10,
                outline: 'none',
                transition: 'border-color 0.2s',
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
              }}
              onFocus={(e) => { if (!error) e.target.style.borderColor = '#2563eb'; }}
              onBlur={(e) => { if (!error) e.target.style.borderColor = '#d1d5db'; }}
            />
            {error && (
              <p style={{ margin: '6px 0 0', fontSize: 12, color: '#ef4444' }}>{error}</p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                marginTop: 20,
                padding: '12px',
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: '#fff',
                background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8)',
                border: 'none',
                borderRadius: 10,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                gap: 8,
                transition: 'opacity 0.2s',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => e.target.style.opacity = '0.9'}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => e.target.style.opacity = '1'}
            >
              Continue to SQL Editor
              <ArrowRight size={18} />
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div style={{
          padding: '12px 36px',
          background: '#f9fafb',
          borderTop: '1px solid #e5e7eb',
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 11, color: '#9ca3af' }}>
            Secured internal tool &bull; Your VZID is used for audit and access control
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Save, Play, History, Sparkles, Plus, Trash2, Check,
  ChevronDown, ChevronUp, X, AlertTriangle,
  Database, Table2, LayoutTemplate, GitBranch, Globe, RefreshCw,
  FolderOpen, ChevronRight, Layers, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
