    setChatLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await chatbotService.sendChatMessage(
        inputValue,
        selectedQueryText || (queryHistory[0]?.query || null),
        selectedDatabase,
        selectedTable,
        'chat'
      );

      if (response.success) {
        addChatMessage({
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: 'assistant',
          content: response.message,
          suggestedQuery: response.suggested_query,
          action: response.action,
          timestamp: new Date(),
        });
        scrollToBottom();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to get response from chatbot');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Error communicating with chatbot: ' + error.message);
      addChatMessage({
        id: Date.now() + 1,
        role: 'assistant',
        content: `Error: ${error.message}`,
        timestamp: new Date(),
      });
    } finally {
      setChatLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleActionButton = async (action, queryText = null) => {
    const query = queryText || selectedQueryText || (queryHistory[0]?.query || null);

    if (!query) {
      toast.error('Please select a query first or write in the input');
      return;
    }

    addChatMessage({
      id: Date.now(),
      role: 'user',
      content: `${action.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + action.slice(1)} this query`,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    });

    setChatLoading(true);

    try {
      let response;
      switch (action) {
        case 'fix':
          response = await chatbotService.fixQuery(query, selectedDatabase);
          break;
        case 'enhance':
          response = await chatbotService.enhanceQuery(query, selectedDatabase);
          break;
        case 'suggest':
          response = await chatbotService.getSuggestions(query, selectedDatabase);
          break;
        case 'explain':
          response = await chatbotService.explainQuery(query, selectedDatabase);
          break;
        default:
          response = await chatbotService.sendChatMessage(
            action,
            query,
            selectedDatabase,
            selectedTable,
            action
          );
      }

      if (response.success) {
        addChatMessage({
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: 'assistant',
          content: response.message,
          suggestedQuery: response.suggested_query,
          action: action,
          timestamp: new Date(),
        });
        scrollToBottom();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to process request');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(`Error: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
      setChatLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyToClipboard = (text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      toast.success('Copied to clipboard!');
    });
  };

  const pasteAndRun = (query) => {
    const textarea = document.querySelector('.query-editor textarea') ||
                     document.querySelector('[data-testid="query-input"]');
    if (textarea) {
      textarea.value = query;
      textarea.focus();
      const event = new Event('change', { bubbles: true });
      textarea.dispatchEvent(event);
      toast.success('Query pasted! Click Play to run.');
    } else {
      handleCopyToClipboard(query);
      toast.success('Query copied (textarea not found)');
    }
  };

  const toggleMsgView = (msgId, field, value) => {
    setCopilotMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msgId ? { ...m, [field]: value !== undefined ? value : !m[field] } : m));
  };

  // ── Chart Renderer ──
  const renderChart = (msg, isExpanded = false) => {
    const cfg = msg.chart_config;
    if (!cfg || !msg.execution?.data) return null;
    const rawData = msg.execution.data;
    const xCol = cfg.x_column;
    const yCol = cfg.y_column;
    const chartHeight = isExpanded ? 350 : 220;

    // Prepare chart data — parse numeric y values
    const chartData = rawData.slice(0, 50).map(row => ({
      x: row[xCol] != null ? String(row[xCol]) : '',
      y: parseFloat(row[yCol]) || 0,
      name: row[xCol] != null ? String(row[xCol]) : '',
      value: parseFloat(row[yCol]) || 0,
    }));

    if (cfg.type === 'bar') {
      return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={chartHeight}>
          <BarChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 5, right: 10, left: -10, bottom: 5 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
            <XAxis dataKey="x" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} interval={chartData.length > 10 ? Math.floor(chartData.length / 8) : 0} />
            <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
            <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
            <Bar dataKey="y" name={yCol} fill="#3b82f6" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
          </BarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      );
    }

    if (cfg.type === 'line') {
      return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={chartHeight}>
          <LineChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 5, right: 10, left: -10, bottom: 5 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
            <XAxis dataKey="x" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} interval={chartData.length > 10 ? Math.floor(chartData.length / 8) : 0} />
            <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
            <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
            <Line type="monotone" dataKey="y" name={yCol} stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth={2} dot={{ r: 3 }} />
          </LineChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      );
    }

    if (cfg.type === 'pie') {
      return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={chartHeight}>
          <PieChart>
            <Pie
              data={chartData.slice(0, 12)}
              dataKey="value"
              nameKey="name"
              cx="50%"
              cy="50%"
              outerRadius={isExpanded ? 120 : 80}
              label={({ name, percent }) => `${String(name).slice(0, 12)} ${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
              labelLine={true}
              fontSize={10}
            >
              {chartData.slice(0, 12).map((_, idx) => (
                <Cell key={idx} fill={CHART_COLORS[idx % CHART_COLORS.length]} />
              ))}
            </Pie>
            <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
          </PieChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      );
    }

    return null;
  };

  // Custom renderers for ReactMarkdown inside the chat
  const markdownComponents = {
    code({ node, inline, className, children, ...props }) {
      const codeText = String(children).replace(/\n$/, '');
      if (inline) {
        return (
          <code className="chatbot-inline-code" {...props}>
            {children}
          </code>
        );
      }
      return (
        <div className="chatbot-code-block">
          <div className="chatbot-code-header">
            <span className="chatbot-code-lang">{(className || '').replace('language-', '') || 'code'}</span>
            <button
              className="chatbot-code-copy"
              onClick={() => handleCopyToClipboard(codeText)}
              title="Copy code"
            >
              <Copy size={12} /> Copy
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre><code className={className} {...props}>{children}</code></pre>
        </div>
      );
    },
    p({ children }) {
      return <p className="chatbot-md-p">{children}</p>;
    },
    h1({ children }) { return <h3 className="chatbot-md-heading">{children}</h3>; },
    h2({ children }) { return <h3 className="chatbot-md-heading">{children}</h3>; },
    h3({ children }) { return <h4 className="chatbot-md-heading chatbot-md-h4">{children}</h4>; },
    ul({ children }) { return <ul className="chatbot-md-list">{children}</ul>; },
    ol({ children }) { return <ol className="chatbot-md-list chatbot-md-ol">{children}</ol>; },
    li({ children }) { return <li className="chatbot-md-li">{children}</li>; },
    blockquote({ children }) { return <blockquote className="chatbot-md-blockquote">{children}</blockquote>; },
    strong({ children }) { return <strong className="chatbot-md-strong">{children}</strong>; },
    a({ href, children }) { return <a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="chatbot-md-link">{children}</a>; },
    table({ children }) { return <div className="chatbot-md-table-wrap"><table className="chatbot-md-table">{children}</table></div>; },
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Floating Button */}
      {!chatbotOpen && (
        <button
          onClick={toggleChatbot}
          className="floating-chatbot-btn"
          title="SQL AI Assistant"
        >
          <Sparkles size={24} />
          <span className="pulse"></span>
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Chatbot Window */}
      {chatbotOpen && (
        <div className="floating-chatbot-window">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="chatbot-header">
            <div className="chatbot-title">
              <Sparkles size={20} />
              <span>AI Assistant</span>
            </div>
            <button onClick={toggleChatbot} className="close-btn" title="Close">
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="chatbot-tabs">
            <button
              className={`chatbot-tab ${activeTab === 'copilot' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('copilot')}
            >
              <Sparkles size={14} />
              SQL Copilot
            </button>
            <button
              className={`chatbot-tab ${activeTab === 'chat' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('chat')}
            >
              <MessageCircle size={14} />
              Chat
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* ════════════ SQL Copilot Tab ════════════ */}
          {activeTab === 'copilot' && (
            <div className="copilot-panel">
              {/* DB Info / Catalog Status */}
              <div className="copilot-db-bar">
                <div className="copilot-db-info">
                  <Database size={14} />
                  <span>{selectedDatabase || 'No database selected'}</span>
                  {catalogInfo && <span className="copilot-catalog-badge">{catalogInfo.tables} tables</span>}
                </div>
                <div className="copilot-db-actions">
                  {/* Action Mode Toggle */}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActionMode(!actionMode)}
                    className={`copilot-action-mode-btn ${actionMode ? 'active' : ''}`}
                    title={actionMode ? 'Action Mode ON — can UPDATE/INSERT data' : 'Action Mode OFF — read-only queries'}
                  >
                    <ShieldAlert size={13} />
                    <span>{actionMode ? 'Action' : 'Read'}</span>
                  </button>
                  {copilotMessages.length > 0 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCopilotMessages([])}
                      className="copilot-new-chat-btn"
                      title="New conversation"
                    >
                      + New
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={loadCopilotHistory}
                    className="copilot-icon-btn"
                    title="Query history"
                  >
                    <History size={14} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleRefreshCatalog}
                    disabled={catalogRefreshing || !selectedDatabase}
                    className="copilot-icon-btn"
                    title="Refresh schema catalog"
                  >
                    {catalogRefreshing ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw size={14} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* History Dropdown */}
              {showHistory && (
                <div className="copilot-history-dropdown">
                  <div className="copilot-history-header">
                    <span>Recent Questions</span>
                    <button onClick={() => setShowHistory(false)}><X size={14} /></button>
                  </div>
                  {copilotHistory.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="copilot-history-empty">No history yet</div>
                  ) : (
                    copilotHistory.map((h, i) => (
                      <button
                        key={h.id || i}
                        className="copilot-history-item"
                        onClick={() => reuseHistoryQuestion(h.nl_question)}
                      >
                        <span className="copilot-history-q">{h.nl_question}</span>
                        <span className="copilot-history-time">{new Date(h.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                      </button>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Messages Area */}
              <div className="copilot-messages">
                {copilotMessages.length === 0 && !showHistory && (
                  <div className="copilot-empty">
                    <Sparkles size={36} className="copilot-empty-icon" />
                    <h3>AI SQL Copilot</h3>
                    <p>Ask a question in plain English and I'll generate the SQL query for you.</p>
                    {!catalogReady && selectedDatabase && (
                      <button
                        onClick={handleRefreshCatalog}
                        disabled={catalogRefreshing}
                        className="copilot-refresh-btn"
                      >
                        {catalogRefreshing ? <><Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> Indexing...</> : <><RefreshCw size={14} /> Index Database Schema</>}
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {!selectedDatabase && (
                      <p className="copilot-hint">Select a database from the sidebar to get started.</p>
                    )}
                    <div className="copilot-examples">
                      <p className="copilot-examples-label">
                        {suggestedQuestions.length > 0 ? (
                          <><Lightbulb size={12} style={{ display: 'inline', verticalAlign: -2 }} /> AI-Suggested for this database:</>
                        ) : 'Try asking:'}
                      </p>
                      {(suggestedQuestions.length > 0 ? suggestedQuestions : [
                        'Show me the top 10 rows from the largest table',
                        'How many records were created this month?',
                        'What are the unique values in the status column?',
                        'Compare totals between last month and this month',
                        'Find duplicate entries by name or email',
                        'Which columns have the most null values?',
                      ]).map((ex, i) => (
                        <button key={i} className="copilot-example-btn" onClick={() => { setCopilotInput(ex); }}>
                          "{ex}"
                        </button>
                      ))}
                      {suggestedQuestions.length === 0 && catalogReady && (
                        <button
                          className="copilot-suggest-btn"
                          onClick={loadSuggestedQuestions}
                          disabled={suggestLoading}
                        >
                          {suggestLoading ? <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Lightbulb size={12} />}
                          Get AI Suggestions
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {copilotMessages.map((msg) => (
                  <div key={msg.id} className={`copilot-msg ${msg.role}`}>
                    {msg.role === 'user' ? (
                      <div className="copilot-user-msg">{msg.content}</div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="copilot-assistant-msg">
                        {msg.error && !msg.sql && (
                          <div className="copilot-error">{msg.error}</div>
                        )}
                        {msg.sql && (
                          <>
                            {msg.tables_used?.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="copilot-tables-used">
                                <span>Tables: </span>
                                {msg.tables_used.map((t, i) => (
                                  <span key={i} className="copilot-table-badge">{t}</span>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            )}

                            {/* SQL Block with expand */}
                            <div className="copilot-sql-block">
                              <div className="copilot-sql-header">
                                <span>{msg.dialect || 'SQL'}</span>
                                <div className="copilot-sql-actions">
                                  <button onClick={() => handleCopySQL(msg.sql)} title="Copy SQL">
                                    <Copy size={13} /> Copy
                                  </button>
                                  <button onClick={() => handlePasteSQL(msg.sql, msg.question)} title="Send to editor">
                                    <Play size={13} /> Use
                                  </button>
                                  <button onClick={() => toggleMsgView(msg.id, 'sqlExpanded')} title={msg.sqlExpanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}>
                                    {msg.sqlExpanded ? <Minimize2 size={13} /> : <Maximize2 size={13} />}
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <pre className={`copilot-sql-code ${msg.sqlExpanded ? 'expanded' : ''}`}><code>{msg.sql}</code></pre>
                            </div>

                            {/* Execution status */}
                            {msg.execution?.success && !msg.actionMode && (
                              <div className="copilot-exec-result">
                                <span className="copilot-exec-badge">Executed — {msg.execution.row_count} rows</span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {msg.execution?.success === false && msg.execution?.error && (
                              <div className="copilot-error" style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 11 }}>Execution error: {msg.execution.error}</div>
                            )}

                            {/* ── Action Mode UI ── */}
                            {msg.actionMode && msg.isMutation && (
                              <div className="copilot-action-section">
                                {/* Blocked destructive operation */}
                                {msg.actionStatus === 'blocked' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-blocked">
                                    <AlertTriangle size={15} />
                                    <span>Destructive operations (DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE) are not allowed in Action Mode.</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Before Data Preview */}
                                {msg.beforeData && msg.beforeData.data?.length > 0 && msg.actionStatus !== 'blocked' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-preview">
                                    <div className="copilot-action-label">
                                      <span className="copilot-action-label-before">Current Data (Before)</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="copilot-data-table-wrap" style={{ maxHeight: 180 }}>
                                      <table className="copilot-data-table">
                                        <thead>
                                          <tr>
                                            {(msg.beforeData.columns || Object.keys(msg.beforeData.data[0])).map((col, ci) => (
                                              <th key={ci}>{col}</th>
                                            ))}
                                          </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody>
                                          {msg.beforeData.data.slice(0, 20).map((row, ri) => (
                                            <tr key={ri}>
                                              {(msg.beforeData.columns || Object.keys(row)).map((col, ci) => (
                                                <td key={ci}>{row[col] != null ? String(row[col]).slice(0, 60) : <span className="copilot-null">NULL</span>}</td>
                                              ))}
                                            </tr>
                                          ))}
                                        </tbody>
                                      </table>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {msg.beforeData && msg.beforeData.data?.length === 0 && msg.actionStatus === 'pending' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-no-preview">No existing rows match the query conditions.</div>
                                )}

                                {/* Confirm / Reject Buttons */}
                                {msg.actionStatus === 'pending' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-buttons">
                                    <button className="copilot-action-confirm" onClick={() => handleActionConfirm(msg)}>
                                      <Check size={14} /> Confirm & Execute
                                    </button>
                                    <button className="copilot-action-reject" onClick={() => handleActionReject(msg)}>
                                      <X size={14} /> Cancel
                                    </button>
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Executing spinner */}
                                {msg.actionStatus === 'executing' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-executing">
                                    <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" />
                                    <span>Executing...</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Confirmed — show result */}
                                {msg.actionStatus === 'confirmed' && msg.execution && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-done">
                                    <div className="copilot-action-success">
                                      <Check size={15} />
                                      <span>Executed successfully — {msg.execution.rows_affected || 0} row(s) affected</span>
                                    </div>

                                    {/* After Data */}
                                    {msg.afterData && msg.afterData.data?.length > 0 && (
                                      <div className="copilot-action-preview">
                                        <div className="copilot-action-label">
                                          <span className="copilot-action-label-after">Updated Data (After)</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="copilot-data-table-wrap" style={{ maxHeight: 180 }}>
                                          <table className="copilot-data-table">
                                            <thead>
                                              <tr>
                                                {(msg.afterData.columns || Object.keys(msg.afterData.data[0])).map((col, ci) => (
                                                  <th key={ci}>{col}</th>
                                                ))}
                                              </tr>
                                            </thead>
                                            <tbody>
                                              {msg.afterData.data.slice(0, 20).map((row, ri) => (
                                                <tr key={ri}>
                                                  {(msg.afterData.columns || Object.keys(row)).map((col, ci) => (
                                                    <td key={ci}>{row[col] != null ? String(row[col]).slice(0, 60) : <span className="copilot-null">NULL</span>}</td>
                                                  ))}
                                                </tr>
                                              ))}
                                            </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Error */}
                                {msg.actionStatus === 'error' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-blocked">
                                    <AlertTriangle size={15} />
                                    <span>Execution failed: {msg.error}</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Rejected */}
                                {msg.actionStatus === 'rejected' && (
                                  <div className="copilot-action-rejected">
                                    <span>Action cancelled by user.</span>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}

                            {/* AI Summary */}
                            {msg.summary && (
                              <div className="copilot-summary">
                                <Sparkles size={13} className="copilot-summary-icon" />
                                <span>{msg.summary}</span>
                              </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Results Section: View Switcher (Table / Chart) + Expand */}
                            {msg.execution?.success && msg.execution?.data?.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="copilot-results-section">
                                <div className="copilot-results-toolbar">
                                  <div className="copilot-view-switcher">
                                    <button
                                      className={`copilot-view-tab ${msg.resultView === 'table' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                                      onClick={() => toggleMsgView(msg.id, 'resultView', 'table')}
                                    >
                                      <Table2 size={12} /> Table
                                    </button>
                                    {msg.chart_config && (
                                      <button
                                        className={`copilot-view-tab ${msg.resultView === 'chart' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                                        onClick={() => toggleMsgView(msg.id, 'resultView', 'chart')}
                                      >
                                        <BarChart3 size={12} /> Chart
                                      </button>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                  <button
                                    className="copilot-expand-btn"
                                    onClick={() => setExpandedMsg(expandedMsg === msg.id ? null : msg.id)}
                                    title={expandedMsg === msg.id ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}
                                  >
                                    {expandedMsg === msg.id ? <Minimize2 size={13} /> : <Maximize2 size={13} />}
                                  </button>
                                </div>

                                {/* Table View */}
                                {msg.resultView === 'table' && (
                                  <div className={`copilot-data-table-wrap ${expandedMsg === msg.id ? 'expanded' : ''}`}>
                                    <table className="copilot-data-table">
                                      <thead>
                                        <tr>
                                          {(msg.execution.columns || Object.keys(msg.execution.data[0])).map((col, ci) => (
                                            <th key={ci}>{col}</th>
                                          ))}
                                        </tr>
                                      </thead>
                                      <tbody>
                                        {msg.execution.data.slice(0, expandedMsg === msg.id ? 100 : 20).map((row, ri) => (
                                          <tr key={ri}>
                                            {(msg.execution.columns || Object.keys(row)).map((col, ci) => (
                                              <td key={ci} title={row[col] != null ? String(row[col]) : ''}>
                                                {row[col] != null ? String(row[col]).slice(0, 80) : <span className="copilot-null">NULL</span>}
                                              </td>
                                            ))}
                                          </tr>
                                        ))}
                                      </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    {msg.execution.data.length > (expandedMsg === msg.id ? 100 : 20) && (
                                      <div className="copilot-table-more">
                                        Showing {expandedMsg === msg.id ? 100 : 20} of {msg.execution.row_count} rows
                                      </div>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Chart View */}
                                {msg.resultView === 'chart' && msg.chart_config && (
                                  <div className={`copilot-chart-container ${expandedMsg === msg.id ? 'expanded' : ''}`}>
                                    <div className="copilot-chart-title">{msg.chart_config.title}</div>
                                    {renderChart(msg, expandedMsg === msg.id)}
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Feedback */}
                            <div className="copilot-feedback">
                              <span>Was this helpful?</span>
                              <button
                                className={`copilot-fb-btn ${msg.feedback === 'good' ? 'active-good' : ''}`}
                                onClick={() => handleCopilotFeedback(msg, 'good')}
                              >
                                <ThumbsUp size={14} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                className={`copilot-fb-btn ${msg.feedback === 'bad' ? 'active-bad' : ''}`}
                                onClick={() => handleCopilotFeedback(msg, 'bad')}
                              >
                                <ThumbsDown size={14} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                className={`copilot-fb-btn copilot-explain-btn ${msg.explanation ? 'active-good' : ''}`}
                                onClick={() => handleExplainSQL(msg)}
                                disabled={explainLoading === msg.id}
                                title="Explain this SQL"
                              >
                                {explainLoading === msg.id ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <BookOpen size={14} />}
                                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', marginLeft: 3 }}>Explain</span>
                              </button>
                            </div>

                            {/* SQL Explanation */}
                            {msg.explanation && (
                              <div className="copilot-explanation">
                                <div className="copilot-explanation-header">
                                  <BookOpen size={13} /> <span>SQL Explanation</span>
                                </div>
                                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]} components={markdownComponents}>
                                  {msg.explanation}
                                </ReactMarkdown>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}

                {copilotLoading && (
                  <div className="copilot-msg assistant">
                    <div className="copilot-assistant-msg">
                      <div className="copilot-generating">
                        <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />
                        <span>Generating SQL...</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div ref={copilotEndRef} />
              </div>

              {/* Copilot Input */}
              <div className="chatbot-input-area">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={copilotInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setCopilotInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && handleCopilotSend()}
                  placeholder={actionMode ? "Describe the action... e.g. 'Make priya an admin'" : "Ask in plain English... e.g. 'Show top 10 users'"}
                  className="chat-input"
                  disabled={copilotLoading}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleCopilotSend}
                  disabled={copilotLoading || !copilotInput.trim()}
                  className="send-btn"
                  title="Generate SQL"
                >
                  <Sparkles size={18} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ════════════ Chat Tab (existing) ════════════ */}
          {activeTab === 'chat' && (
            <>
              {/* Messages Area */}
              <div className="chatbot-messages">
            {chatMessages.length === 0 && (
              <div className="empty-state">
                <MessageCircle size={40} />
                <h3>SQL AI Assistant</h3>
                <p>Ask about SQL queries, get suggestions, and optimize your code.</p>
                <div className="quick-actions">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleActionButton('fix')}
                    className="quick-action-btn"
                  >
                    <Zap size={16} />
                    Fix Query
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleActionButton('enhance')}
                    className="quick-action-btn"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw size={16} />
                    Enhance
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {chatMessages.map((msg) => (
              <div
                key={msg.id}
                className={`chat-message ${msg.role}`}
              >
                <div className="message-content">
                  {msg.role === 'assistant' ? (
                    <div className="chatbot-markdown-body">
                      <ReactMarkdown
                        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
                        components={markdownComponents}
                      >
                        {msg.content}
                      </ReactMarkdown>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <p>{msg.content}</p>
                  )}

                  {/* Suggested Query Display */}
                  {msg.suggestedQuery && (
                    <div className="suggested-query">
                      <code>{msg.suggestedQuery}</code>
                      <div className="query-actions">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleCopyToClipboard(msg.suggestedQuery)}
                          title="Copy to clipboard"
                          className="query-action-btn"
                        >
                          <Copy size={14} />
                          Copy
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => pasteAndRun(msg.suggestedQuery)}
                          title="Paste and run"
                          className="query-action-btn"
                        >
                          <Play size={14} />
                          Run
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <small className="message-time">
                    {msg.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString()}
                  </small>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            {chatLoading && (
              <div className="chat-message assistant">
                <div className="message-content">
                  <div className="typing-indicator">
                    <span></span>
                    <span></span>
                    <span></span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          {chatMessages.length > 0 && (
            <div className="chatbot-actions">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleActionButton('fix')}
                disabled={chatLoading}
                title="Fix the query"
                className="action-btn"
              >
                <Zap size={16} />
                Fix
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleActionButton('enhance')}
                disabled={chatLoading}
                title="Enhance the query"
                className="action-btn"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={16} />
                Enhance
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleActionButton('suggest')}
                disabled={chatLoading}
                title="Get suggestions"
                className="action-btn"
              >
                <MessageCircle size={16} />
                Suggest
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleActionButton('explain')}
                disabled={chatLoading}
                title="Explain the query"
                className="action-btn"
              >
                <MessageCircle size={16} />
                Explain
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Input Area */}
          <div className="chatbot-input-area">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={inputValue}
              onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
              onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSendMessage()}
              placeholder="Ask about SQL, BigQuery, or paste a query..."
              className="chat-input"
              disabled={chatLoading}
            />
            <button
              onClick={handleSendMessage}
              disabled={chatLoading || !inputValue.trim()}
              className="send-btn"
              title="Send message"
            >
              <Send size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Info Text */}
          <div className="chatbot-info">
            <small>
              {selectedDatabase && `Database: ${selectedDatabase}`}
              {selectedDatabase && selectedTable && ' \u2022 '}
              {selectedTable && `Table: ${selectedTable}`}
            </small>
          </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

src/components/ExpressionBuilder.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, X } from 'lucide-react';

// ── Operator options ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const OPERATORS = [
  { value: '==',           label: '== (equals)' },
  { value: '!=',           label: '!= (not equals)' },
  { value: '>',            label: '> (greater than)' },
  { value: '<',            label: '< (less than)' },
  { value: '>=',           label: '>= (gte)' },
  { value: '<=',           label: '<= (lte)' },
  { value: 'is_empty',     label: 'is empty' },
  { value: 'is_not_empty', label: 'is not empty' },
  { value: 'contains',     label: 'contains' },
  { value: 'not_contains', label: 'does not contain' },
  { value: 'starts_with',  label: 'starts with' },
  { value: 'ends_with',    label: 'ends with' },
  { value: 'in',           label: 'in (list)' },
  { value: 'not_in',       label: 'not in (list)' },
];

const UNARY_OPERATORS = new Set(['is_empty', 'is_not_empty']);

// ── Single condition row ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function ConditionRow({ condition, onChange, onRemove, context = [], canRemove }) {
  const isUnary = UNARY_OPERATORS.has(condition.operator);

  function handleLeft(e) {
    onChange({ ...condition, left: e.target.value });
  }

  function handleOperator(e) {
    onChange({ ...condition, operator: e.target.value });
  }

  function handleRight(e) {
    onChange({ ...condition, right: e.target.value });
  }

  return (
    <div className="lfb-expr-row">
      {/* Left field */}
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, minWidth: 80 }}>
        <input
          className="lfb-input"
          placeholder="field or {{var}}"
          value={condition.left || ''}
          onChange={handleLeft}
          list={`expr-ctx-${condition.id}-left`}
          style={{ width: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
        />
        {context.length > 0 && (
          <datalist id={`expr-ctx-${condition.id}-left`}>
            {context.map((v) => (
              <option key={v} value={`{{${v}}}`} />
            ))}
          </datalist>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Operator */}
      <select
        className="lfb-select"
        value={condition.operator || '=='}
        onChange={handleOperator}
        style={{ flexShrink: 0, minWidth: 130 }}
      >
        {OPERATORS.map((op) => (
          <option key={op.value} value={op.value}>
            {op.label}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {/* Right field — hidden for unary operators */}
      {!isUnary && (
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, minWidth: 80 }}>
          <input
            className="lfb-input"
            placeholder="value or {{var}}"
            value={condition.right || ''}
            onChange={handleRight}
            list={`expr-ctx-${condition.id}-right`}
            style={{ width: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
          />
          {context.length > 0 && (
            <datalist id={`expr-ctx-${condition.id}-right`}>
              {context.map((v) => (
                <option key={v} value={`{{${v}}}`} />
              ))}
            </datalist>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Remove button */}
      {canRemove && (
        <button
          className="lfb-expr-remove-btn"
          onClick={onRemove}
          title="Remove condition"
          type="button"
        >
          <X size={12} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Generate a short unique id ────────────────────────────────────────
function uid() {
  return 'c' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6);
}

// ── Normalize incoming value to internal compound form ────────────────
function normalize(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return [{ id: uid(), left: '', operator: '==', right: '' }];
  }
  // Already compound array
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map((c) => ({ id: c.id || uid(), ...c }));
  }
  // Single expression object with connector arrays (legacy / recursive)
  if (value.conditions && Array.isArray(value.conditions)) {
    return value.conditions.map((c) => ({ id: c.id || uid(), ...c }));
  }
  // Plain single condition { left, operator, right }
  return [{ id: uid(), left: value.left || '', operator: value.operator || '==', right: value.right || '' }];
}

// ── Serialize back to a simple form the API expects ──────────────────
// If single condition → { left, operator, right }
// If multiple → { conditions: [...], connector: 'and'|'or' }
function serialize(conditions, connector) {
  if (conditions.length === 1) {
    const { id, ...rest } = conditions[0];
    return rest;
  }
  return {
    connector,
    conditions: conditions.map(({ id, ...rest }) => rest),
  };
}

// ── ExpressionBuilder ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props:
//   value      – expression object (single or compound)
//   onChange   – fn(serialized)
//   context    – array of variable name strings (for autocomplete)
export default function ExpressionBuilder({ value, onChange, context = [] }) {
  const [conditions, setConditions] = useState(() => normalize(value));
  const [connector, setConnector] = useState(
    value && value.connector ? value.connector : 'and'
  );

  function emit(newConditions, newConnector) {
    onChange(serialize(newConditions, newConnector));
  }

  function handleConditionChange(index, updated) {
    const next = conditions.map((c, i) => (i === index ? updated : c));
    setConditions(next);
    emit(next, connector);
  }

  function handleAddCondition() {
    const next = [...conditions, { id: uid(), left: '', operator: '==', right: '' }];
    setConditions(next);
    emit(next, connector);
  }

  function handleRemoveCondition(index) {
    if (conditions.length <= 1) return;
    const next = conditions.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    setConditions(next);
    emit(next, connector);
  }

  function handleConnectorChange(e) {
    const next = e.target.value;
    setConnector(next);
    emit(conditions, next);
  }

  return (
    <div className="lfb-expr-builder">
      {conditions.map((cond, index) => (
        <React.Fragment key={cond.id}>
          {index > 0 && (
            <div className="lfb-expr-connector">
              <select
                className="lfb-select"
                value={connector}
                onChange={handleConnectorChange}
                style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '2px 6px' }}
              >
                <option value="and">AND</option>
                <option value="or">OR</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          )}
          <ConditionRow
            condition={cond}
            onChange={(updated) => handleConditionChange(index, updated)}
            onRemove={() => handleRemoveCondition(index)}
            context={context}
            canRemove={conditions.length > 1}
          />
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
        <button
          className="lfb-expr-add-btn"
          type="button"
          onClick={handleAddCondition}
        >
          <Plus size={11} />
          Add condition
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}




src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx

import React from 'react';
import { AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

export const ErrorBoundary = ({ children, fallback }) => {
  const [hasError, setHasError] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleError = (event) => {
      setHasError(true);
      setError(event.error);
    };

    window.addEventListener('error', handleError);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('error', handleError);
  }, []);

  if (hasError) {
    return (
      fallback || (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen bg-red-50">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-8 max-w-md">
            <div className="flex items-center mb-4">
              <AlertCircle className="text-red-600 mr-3" size={24} />
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600">Something went wrong</h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-gray-700 mb-4">{error?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'}</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              className="w-full bg-red-600 text-white py-2 rounded hover:bg-red-700 transition"
            >
              Reload Page
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    );
  }

  return children;
};

export default ErrorBoundary;






src/components/EmbedManager.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Code2, Plus, Trash2, Copy, ExternalLink, RefreshCw, ToggleLeft, ToggleRight, Eye, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './EmbedManager.css';

const EmbedManager = () => {
  const [tokens, setTokens] = useState([]);
  const [dashboards, setDashboards] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [snippets, setSnippets] = useState({});   // token -> { iframe_code, js_code }
  const [activeSnippetTab, setActiveSnippetTab] = useState({}); // token -> 'iframe'|'js'
  const [expandedToken, setExpandedToken] = useState(null);

  // ── Create form state ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    dashboard_id: '',
    widget_id: '',
    title: '',
    allowed_domains: '*',
    expires_days: 0,
  });
  const [widgets, setWidgets] = useState([]);

  const loadTokens = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listEmbedTokens();
      setTokens(res.data?.tokens || []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load embed tokens');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadDashboards = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDashboards();
      setDashboards(res.data?.dashboards || []);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadTokens(); loadDashboards(); }, [loadTokens, loadDashboards]);

  // When dashboard changes, load its widgets
  const handleDashboardChange = async (dashId) => {
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, dashboard_id: dashId, widget_id: '' }));
    if (!dashId) { setWidgets([]); return; }
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getDashboard(dashId);
      setWidgets(res.data?.widgets || []);
    } catch {
      setWidgets([]);
    }
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!form.dashboard_id) { toast.error('Select a dashboard'); return; }
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.createEmbedToken(form);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        toast.success('Embed token created!');
        setShowCreate(false);
        setForm({ dashboard_id: '', widget_id: '', title: '', allowed_domains: '*', expires_days: 0 });
        loadTokens();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to create token');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (embedId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Revoke this embed token? Existing embeds will stop working.')) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteEmbedToken(embedId);
      toast.success('Token revoked');
      loadTokens();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const handleToggleActive = async (embed) => {
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.updateEmbedToken(embed.id, { is_active: !embed.is_active });
      toast.success(embed.is_active ? 'Disabled' : 'Enabled');
      loadTokens();
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to toggle');
    }
  };

  const loadSnippet = async (token) => {
    if (snippets[token]) {
      setExpandedToken(expandedToken === token ? null : token);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getEmbedSnippet(token);
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setSnippets(s => ({ ...s, [token]: res.data }));
        setActiveSnippetTab(t => ({ ...t, [token]: 'iframe' }));
        setExpandedToken(token);
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to load snippet');
    }
  };

  const copyText = (text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => toast.success('Copied!')).catch(() => toast.error('Copy failed'));
  };

  return (
    <div className="embed-manager">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="em-header">
        <h2>Embedded BI</h2>
        <p>Embed dashboard widgets into external apps & portals via iframe or JS snippet</p>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="em-toolbar">
        <button className="em-btn em-btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)}>
          <Plus size={15} /> New Embed Token
        </button>
        <button className="em-btn em-btn-ghost" onClick={loadTokens}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} /> Refresh
        </button>
        <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
          {tokens.length} token{tokens.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Body */}
      <div className="em-body">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="em-empty"><p>Loading...</p></div>
        ) : tokens.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="em-empty">
            <Code2 size={48} />
            <p>No embed tokens yet. Create one to start embedding dashboards.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="em-grid">
            {tokens.map(tok => (
              <div key={tok.id} className="em-card">
                <div className="em-card-head">
                  <h4>{tok.title || tok.dashboard_name || 'Untitled Embed'}</h4>
                  <button
                    className="em-btn em-btn-ghost em-btn-sm"
                    onClick={() => handleToggleActive(tok)}
                    title={tok.is_active ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                  >
                    {tok.is_active ? <ToggleRight size={18} color="#22c55e" /> : <ToggleLeft size={18} color="#94a3b8" />}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="em-card-meta">
                  <span className={`em-badge ${tok.is_active ? 'green' : 'red'}`}>
                    {tok.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
                  </span>
                  {tok.widget_id && <span className="em-badge blue">Widget: {tok.widget_id.slice(0, 10)}…</span>}
                  {tok.dashboard_name && <span className="em-badge gray">{tok.dashboard_name}</span>}
                  {tok.expires_at && (
                    <span className="em-badge gray">Expires: {new Date(tok.expires_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontFamily: 'monospace', wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
                  Token: {tok.token.slice(0, 20)}…
                </div>

                {/* Snippet section */}
                {expandedToken === tok.token && snippets[tok.token] && (
                  <div className="em-snippet">
                    <div className="em-snippet-tabs">
                      {['iframe', 'js'].map(tab => (
                        <button
                          key={tab}
                          className={`em-snippet-tab ${activeSnippetTab[tok.token] === tab ? 'active' : ''}`}
                          onClick={() => setActiveSnippetTab(t => ({ ...t, [tok.token]: tab }))}
                        >
                          {tab === 'iframe' ? 'iFrame' : 'JavaScript'}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <pre>
                      {activeSnippetTab[tok.token] === 'iframe'
                        ? snippets[tok.token].iframe_code
                        : snippets[tok.token].js_code}
                    </pre>
                    <button
                      className="copy-btn"
                      onClick={() => copyText(
                        activeSnippetTab[tok.token] === 'iframe'
                          ? snippets[tok.token].iframe_code
                          : snippets[tok.token].js_code
                      )}
                    >
                      <Copy size={12} /> Copy Code
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="em-card-actions">
                  <button className="em-btn em-btn-ghost em-btn-sm" onClick={() => loadSnippet(tok.token)}>
                    <Code2 size={13} /> {expandedToken === tok.token ? 'Hide Code' : 'Get Code'}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="em-btn em-btn-ghost em-btn-sm"
                    onClick={() => window.open(snippets[tok.token]?.render_url || `/api/embed/${tok.token}/render`, '_blank')}
                  >
                    <Eye size={13} /> Preview
                  </button>
                  <button className="em-btn em-btn-danger em-btn-sm" onClick={() => handleDelete(tok.id)} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                    <Trash2 size={13} /> Revoke
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── Create Modal ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showCreate && (
        <div className="em-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowCreate(false)}>
          <div className="em-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="em-modal-head">
              <h3>Create Embed Token</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="em-modal-body">
              <div className="em-field">
                <label>Title</label>
                <input value={form.title} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, title: e.target.value }))} placeholder="My embedded widget" />
              </div>
              <div className="em-field">
                <label>Dashboard *</label>
                <select value={form.dashboard_id} onChange={e => handleDashboardChange(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="">-- Select Dashboard --</option>
                  {dashboards.map(d => <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>{d.name}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              {widgets.length > 0 && (
                <div className="em-field">
                  <label>Widget (optional — leave blank for full dashboard)</label>
                  <select value={form.widget_id} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, widget_id: e.target.value }))}>
                    <option value="">Entire Dashboard</option>
                    {widgets.map(w => <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>{w.title || w.id}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="em-field">
                <label>Allowed Domains</label>
                <input value={form.allowed_domains} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, allowed_domains: e.target.value }))} placeholder="* (all) or comma-separated domains" />
              </div>
              <div className="em-field">
                <label>Expires in (days, 0 = never)</label>
                <input type="number" min="0" value={form.expires_days} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, expires_days: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 }))} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="em-modal-foot">
              <button className="em-btn em-btn-ghost" onClick={() => setShowCreate(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button className="em-btn em-btn-primary" onClick={handleCreate}>Create Token</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default EmbedManager;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   COMPONENTS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function CodeBlock({ code }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };
  return (
    <div className="doc-code-block">
      <button className="doc-code-copy" onClick={handleCopy} title="Copy code">
        {copied ? <Check size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}
      </button>
      <pre><code>{code}</code></pre>
    </div>
  );
}

function DataTable({ headers, rows }) {
  return (
    <div className="doc-table-wrap">
      <table className="doc-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>{headers.map((h, i) => <th key={i}>{h}</th>)}</tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row, ri) => (
            <tr key={ri}>{row.map((cell, ci) => <td key={ci}><code>{cell}</code></td>)}</tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function SubsectionCard({ sub }) {
  return (
    <div id={sub.id} className="doc-subsection">
      <h3 className="doc-subsection-title">{sub.title}</h3>
      <div className="doc-prose" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: markdownLite(sub.content) }} />

      {sub.highlights && (
        <ul className="doc-highlights">
          {sub.highlights.map((h, i) => (
            <li key={i}><Check size={14} className="doc-hl-icon" /><span>{h}</span></li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {sub.tip && (
        <div className="doc-callout doc-callout-tip">
          <Lightbulb size={16} />
          <span><strong>Tip:</strong> {sub.tip}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {sub.warning && (
        <div className="doc-callout doc-callout-warn">
          <AlertTriangle size={16} />
          <span><strong>Warning:</strong> {sub.warning}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {sub.code && <CodeBlock code={sub.code} />}

      {sub.table && <DataTable headers={sub.table.headers} rows={sub.table.rows} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Tiny markdown-like converter for bold and inline code */
function markdownLite(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>')
    .replace(/\n\n/g, '</p><p>')
    .replace(/\n- /g, '</p><li>')
    .replace(/^/, '<p>')
    .replace(/$/, '</p>')
    .replace(/<p><\/p>/g, '')
    .replace(/<\/p><li>/g, '<ul><li>')
    .replace(/<li>([^<]*?)(?=<li>|<\/p>|$)/g, '<li>$1</li>')
    .replace(/(<\/li>)(?!<li>)/g, '$1</ul>');
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN DOCUMENTATION COMPONENT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export default function Documentation() {
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState('getting-started');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [expandedNav, setExpandedNav] = useState({ 'getting-started': true });

  const currentSection = SECTIONS.find(s => s.id === activeSection) || SECTIONS[0];

  // Search filter
  const filteredSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return SECTIONS;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return SECTIONS.map(section => {
      const subs = section.subsections.filter(sub =>
        sub.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        sub.content.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (sub.code && sub.code.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (sub.highlights && sub.highlights.some(h => h.toLowerCase().includes(q))) ||
        (sub.tip && sub.tip.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
      if (subs.length > 0 || section.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
        return { ...section, subsections: subs.length > 0 ? subs : section.subsections };
      }
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const toggleNav = (id) => {
    setExpandedNav(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));
  };

  const handleSectionClick = (sectionId) => {
    setActiveSection(sectionId);
    setExpandedNav(prev => ({ ...prev, [sectionId]: true }));
  };

  const handleSubClick = (sectionId, subId) => {
    setActiveSection(sectionId);
    setExpandedNav(prev => ({ ...prev, [sectionId]: true }));
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById(subId)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 50);
  };

  return (
    <div className="doc-container">
      {/* ── Sidebar Navigation ──────────────────────────────────── */}
      <nav className="doc-nav">
        <div className="doc-nav-header">
          <HelpCircle size={20} />
          <h2>Documentation</h2>
        </div>

        <div className="doc-search-wrap">
          <Search size={15} className="doc-search-icon" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search docs..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="doc-search-input"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="doc-nav-sections">
          {filteredSections.map(section => {
            const Icon = section.icon;
            const isActive = activeSection === section.id;
            const isExpanded = expandedNav[section.id];
            return (
              <div key={section.id} className="doc-nav-group">
                <button
                  className={`doc-nav-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => { handleSectionClick(section.id); toggleNav(section.id); }}
                >
                  <Icon size={16} />
                  <span>{section.title}</span>
                  {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown size={14} className="doc-nav-chevron" /> : <ChevronRight size={14} className="doc-nav-chevron" />}
                </button>
                {isExpanded && (
                  <div className="doc-nav-subitems">
                    {section.subsections.map(sub => (
                      <button
                        key={sub.id}
                        className="doc-nav-subitem"
                        onClick={() => handleSubClick(section.id, sub.id)}
                      >
                        {sub.title}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* ── Main Content ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <main className="doc-main">
        <div className="doc-main-header">
          {React.createElement(currentSection.icon, { size: 28, className: 'doc-main-icon' })}
          <h1>{currentSection.title}</h1>
        </div>

        <div className="doc-main-content">
          {currentSection.subsections.map(sub => (
            <SubsectionCard key={sub.id} sub={sub} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
