src/components/ChatAPIBuilder.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Plus, Trash2, Edit3, Save, X, MessageSquare, Bot, Key, Copy,
  Loader2, Send, RefreshCw, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Sparkles,
  Lock, Unlock, Globe, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'https://sqleditorapi.verizon.com';

const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
  name: '',
  description: '',
  system_prompt: '',
  vector_database: '',
  vector_schema: 'public',
  vector_table: '',
  vector_column: 'embedding',
  top_k: 5,
  temperature: 0.7,
  max_tokens: 1024,
  max_history_turns: 10,
  auth_enabled: false,
  auth_username: '',
  auth_password: '',
};

// ─── Utility ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function copyText(text) {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => toast.success('Copied!'));
}

// ─── Sub-components ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SourceBadge({ sources = [] }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  if (!sources.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="mt-2">
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-purple-600 hover:text-purple-800 transition">
        {open ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />}
        {sources.length} source{sources.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} used
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1.5">
          {sources.map((s, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="bg-purple-50 border border-purple-100 rounded p-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between mb-1">
                <span className="text-purple-500 font-mono">source {i + 1}</span>
                <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold ${
                  s.similarity >= 0.8 ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' :
                  s.similarity >= 0.6 ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700' :
                  'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'}`}>
                  {(s.similarity * 100).toFixed(0)}% match
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-gray-600 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">{s.chunk_text}</p>
              {s.metadata && Object.keys(s.metadata).length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                  {Object.entries(s.metadata).map(([k, v]) => (
                    <span key={k} className="bg-white border border-purple-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono">
                      {k}: {String(v ?? '')}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ChatBubble({ msg }) {
  const isUser = msg.role === 'user';
  return (
    <div className={`flex ${isUser ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'} gap-2`}>
      {!isUser && (
        <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-1">
          <Bot size={14} className="text-white" />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={`max-w-[80%] ${isUser ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'} flex flex-col`}>
        <div className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed ${
          isUser
            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-sm'
            : 'bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-800 rounded-tl-sm shadow-sm'
        }`}>
          <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{msg.content}</p>
        </div>
        {!isUser && <SourceBadge sources={msg.sources || []} />}
        {msg.token_count > 0 && !isUser && (
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1 ml-1">{msg.token_count} tokens</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Playground tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PlaygroundTab({ api }) {
  const [sessions, setSessions]     = useState([]);
  const [activeSession, setActive]  = useState(null);
  const [messages, setMessages]     = useState([]);
  const [input, setInput]           = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending]       = useState(false);
  const [loadingHistory, setLoadH]  = useState(false);
  const bottomRef = useRef(null);

  const loadSessions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await sqlEditorAPI.listChatSessions(api.id);
      setSessions(r.data.sessions || []);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, [api.id]);

  useEffect(() => { loadSessions(); }, [loadSessions]);
  useEffect(() => { bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }, [messages]);

  const openSession = async (sessionId) => {
    setActive(sessionId); setLoadH(true); setMessages([]);
    try {
      const r = await sqlEditorAPI.getChatHistory(api.id, sessionId);
      setMessages(r.data.messages || []);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load history'); }
    finally { setLoadH(false); }
  };

  const newSession = async () => {
    try {
      const r = await sqlEditorAPI.createChatSession(api.id);
      const sid = r.data.session_id;
      await loadSessions();
      openSession(sid);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to create session'); }
  };

  const deleteSession = async (e, sid) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteChatSession(api.id, sid);
      if (activeSession === sid) { setActive(null); setMessages([]); }
      loadSessions();
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to delete session'); }
  };

  const sendMessage = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || !activeSession || sending) return;
    const text = input.trim();
    setInput('');
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'user', content: text, sources: [] }]);
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const r = await sqlEditorAPI.sendPlaygroundMessage(api.id, activeSession, text);
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
        role: 'assistant',
        content: r.data.response,
        sources: r.data.sources || [],
        token_count: r.data.token_count || 0,
      }]);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to send message');
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
        role: 'assistant', content: '⚠ Error getting response. Please try again.', sources: [],
      }]);
    } finally { setSending(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full gap-4">
      {/* Sessions list */}
      <div className="w-56 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-2">
        <button onClick={newSession}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition">
          <Plus size={14} /> New Conversation
        </button>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1">
          {sessions.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 text-center mt-4">No conversations yet</p>
          )}
          {sessions.map(s => (
            <button key={s.id} onClick={() => openSession(s.id)}
              className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm flex items-start justify-between gap-2 group transition ${
                activeSession === s.id ? 'bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200' : 'hover:bg-gray-100 border border-transparent'}`}>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="font-medium text-gray-800 truncate">{s.title}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{s.message_count} messages</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={e => deleteSession(e, s.id)}
                className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 transition mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0">
                <Trash2 size={13} />
              </button>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Chat area */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-gray-50">
        {!activeSession ? (
          <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
            <div className="text-center">
              <MessageSquare size={40} className="text-gray-300 mx-auto mb-3" />
              <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Select a conversation or start a new one</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 space-y-4">
              {loadingHistory && (
                <div className="flex justify-center py-8">
                  <Loader2 size={20} className="animate-spin text-indigo-400" />
                </div>
              )}
              {messages.map((m, i) => <ChatBubble key={i} msg={m} />)}
              {sending && (
                <div className="flex justify-start gap-2">
                  <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-1">
                    <Bot size={14} className="text-white" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-4 py-3 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="flex gap-1">
                      {[0,1,2].map(i => (
                        <div key={i} className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-indigo-400 rounded-full animate-bounce"
                          style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.15}s` }} />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              <div ref={bottomRef} />
            </div>
            <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-white border-t border-gray-200">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <textarea
                  value={input}
                  onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); } }}
                  placeholder="Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)"
                  rows={2}
                  className="flex-1 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
                />
                <button onClick={sendMessage} disabled={sending || !input.trim()}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition self-end">
                  <Send size={16} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Auth & API Docs tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AuthDocsTab({ api, config, setConfig }) {
  const endpoint = `${API_BASE}/api/chat/${api?.id}/chat`;
  const curlNoAuth = `curl -X POST "${endpoint}" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"message": "Hello, what can you help me with?", "session_id": "my-session-001"}'`;

  const curlAuth = `curl -X POST "${endpoint}" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n '${config.auth_username || 'user'}:PASSWORD' | base64)" \\
  -d '{"message": "Hello!", "session_id": "my-session-001"}'`;

  const pyExample = `import requests, base64

api_url = "${endpoint}"
session_id = "my-session-001"   # reuse same ID to continue conversation
${config.auth_enabled ? `credentials = base64.b64encode(b"${config.auth_username}:PASSWORD").decode()
headers = {"Authorization": f"Basic {credentials}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}` : 'headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}'}

resp = requests.post(api_url, json={"message": "What is this about?", "session_id": session_id}, headers=headers)
data = resp.json()
print(data["response"])
print("Session ID:", data["session_id"])   # pass this back in next message`;

  const jsExample = `const endpoint = "${endpoint}";
const sessionId = "my-session-001";   // keep same ID per user

async function chat(message) {
  const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",${config.auth_enabled ? `
      "Authorization": "Basic " + btoa("${config.auth_username}:PASSWORD"),` : ''}
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ message, session_id: sessionId }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.response;   // data also has: session_id, sources, token_count
}`;

  const Block = ({ code, lang }) => (
    <div className="relative">
      <button onClick={() => copyText(code)}
        className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 rounded hover:bg-gray-600 transition">
        <Copy size={12} />
      </button>
      <pre className="bg-gray-900 text-green-300 text-xs rounded-lg p-4 overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed">{code}</pre>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Auth settings */}
      <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Key size={15} className="text-amber-500" /> Basic Auth
          </h3>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={config.auth_enabled}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, auth_enabled: e.target.checked }))}
              className="accent-indigo-600" />
            {config.auth_enabled
              ? <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-green-600 font-medium"><Lock size={12} /> Enabled</span>
              : <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-500"><Unlock size={12} /> Disabled</span>}
          </label>
        </div>
        {config.auth_enabled && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 mb-1">Username</label>
              <input type="text" value={config.auth_username}
                onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, auth_username: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
                placeholder="apiuser" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 mb-1">Password</label>
              <input type="password" value={config.auth_password}
                onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, auth_password: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
                placeholder="Leave blank to keep existing" />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        {!config.auth_enabled && (
          <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <AlertCircle size={12} /> API is publicly accessible without credentials. Enable auth for production use.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Endpoint info */}
      {api?.id && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Globe size={14} className="text-indigo-500" /> Live API Endpoint
            </h3>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">POST</span>
              <code className="text-sm text-gray-800 font-mono">{endpoint}</code>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
              <button onClick={() => copyText(endpoint)}
                className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition"><Copy size={14} /></button>
              <a href={endpoint} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
                className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition"><ExternalLink size={14} /></a>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs text-blue-700 space-y-1">
            <p className="font-semibold">Request body:</p>
            <p><code className="bg-blue-100 px-1 rounded">message</code> string — the user's question (required)</p>
            <p><code className="bg-blue-100 px-1 rounded">session_id</code> string — conversation ID; omit to start new, reuse same ID to continue</p>
            <p className="font-semibold mt-2">Response:</p>
            <p><code className="bg-blue-100 px-1 rounded">response</code> — LLM answer &nbsp;·&nbsp;
               <code className="bg-blue-100 px-1 rounded">session_id</code> — pass back next turn &nbsp;·&nbsp;
               <code className="bg-blue-100 px-1 rounded">sources</code> — RAG chunks used</p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wide">cURL</p>
            <Block code={config.auth_enabled ? curlAuth : curlNoAuth} />

            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wide">Python</p>
            <Block code={pyExample} />

            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wide">JavaScript</p>
            <Block code={jsExample} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Config tab ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ConfigTab({ config, setConfig, apiId, onSave, saving }) {
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [promptDesc, setPromptDesc] = useState('');

  const generatePrompt = async () => {
    if (!promptDesc.trim()) { toast.error('Describe what your chatbot should do'); return; }
    if (!apiId) { toast.error('Save the Chat API first to generate a prompt'); return; }
    setGenerating(true);
    try {
      const r = await sqlEditorAPI.generateSystemPrompt(apiId, promptDesc);
      if (r.data?.success) {
        setConfig(c => ({ ...c, system_prompt: r.data.system_prompt }));
        toast.success('System prompt generated!');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Generation failed');
    } finally { setGenerating(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Name *</label>
          <input type="text" value={config.name}
            onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, name: e.target.value }))}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
            placeholder="My Support Bot" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Description</label>
          <input type="text" value={config.description}
            onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, description: e.target.value }))}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
            placeholder="Customer support assistant" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* System prompt */}
      <div>
        <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">System Prompt</label>
        <textarea value={config.system_prompt}
          onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, system_prompt: e.target.value }))}
          rows={5}
          className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400 resize-none font-mono"
          placeholder="You are a helpful assistant specializing in…" />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
          <input type="text" value={promptDesc}
            onChange={e => setPromptDesc(e.target.value)}
            className="flex-1 border border-gray-200 rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-400"
            placeholder="Describe your chatbot to auto-generate the system prompt…" />
          <button onClick={generatePrompt} disabled={generating}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded text-xs font-medium hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition">
            {generating ? <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles size={12} />}
            Generate with AI
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Vector table config */}
      <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">RAG Knowledge Base (optional)</h3>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">Database</label>
            <input type="text" value={config.vector_database}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, vector_database: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
              placeholder="mydb" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">Vector Table</label>
            <input type="text" value={config.vector_table}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, vector_table: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
              placeholder="products_vectors" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">Top-K Results</label>
            <input type="number" value={config.top_k} min={1} max={20}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, top_k: Number(e.target.value) }))}
              className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* LLM parameters */}
      <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">LLM Parameters</h3>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">
              Temperature <span className="text-gray-400 font-normal">({config.temperature})</span>
            </label>
            <input type="range" min={0} max={1} step={0.05} value={config.temperature}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, temperature: Number(e.target.value) }))}
              className="w-full accent-indigo-600" />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
              <span>Precise</span><span>Creative</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">Max Tokens</label>
            <select value={config.max_tokens}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, max_tokens: Number(e.target.value) }))}
              className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none">
              {[256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192].map(t => (
                <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs text-gray-600 mb-1">Max History Turns</label>
            <input type="number" value={config.max_history_turns} min={1} max={50}
              onChange={e => setConfig(c => ({ ...c, max_history_turns: Number(e.target.value) }))}
              className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400" />
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Conversation turns kept in context</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={onSave} disabled={saving || !config.name.trim()}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition">
        {saving ? <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" /> : <Save size={15} />}
        {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save Chat API'}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Main ChatAPIBuilder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function ChatAPIBuilder() {
  const [apis, setApis]           = useState([]);
  const [selectedApi, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [activeTab, setTab]       = useState('config');
  const [config, setConfig]       = useState({ ...DEFAULT_CONFIG });
  const [saving, setSaving]       = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading]     = useState(true);
  const [isNew, setIsNew]         = useState(false);

  const loadAPIs = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await sqlEditorAPI.listChatAPIs();
      setApis(r.data.apis || []);
    } catch { toast.error('Failed to load Chat APIs'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadAPIs(); }, [loadAPIs]);

  const selectAPI = (api) => {
    setSelected(api);
    setConfig({ ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...api, auth_password: '' });
    setTab('config');
    setIsNew(false);
  };

  const newAPI = () => {
    setSelected(null);
    setConfig({ ...DEFAULT_CONFIG });
    setTab('config');
    setIsNew(true);
  };

  const saveAPI = async () => {
    if (!config.name.trim()) { toast.error('Name is required'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (isNew) {
        const r = await sqlEditorAPI.createChatAPI(config);
        toast.success('Chat API created!');
        await loadAPIs();
        // Select the newly created API
        const newId = r.data.id;
        const all = (await sqlEditorAPI.listChatAPIs()).data.apis || [];
        const created = all.find(a => a.id === newId);
        if (created) selectAPI(created);
        setIsNew(false);
      } else {
        await sqlEditorAPI.updateChatAPI(selectedApi.id, config);
        toast.success('Saved!');
        await loadAPIs();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Save failed');
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const deleteAPI = async (api) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete "${api.name}"? This removes all conversations.`)) return;
    try {
      await sqlEditorAPI.deleteChatAPI(api.id);
      toast.success('Deleted');
      setSelected(null); setConfig({ ...DEFAULT_CONFIG }); setIsNew(false);
      loadAPIs();
    } catch { toast.error('Delete failed'); }
  };

  const TABS = [
    { id: 'config',   label: 'Config',      icon: Edit3 },
    { id: 'auth',     label: 'Auth & API',  icon: Key },
    { id: 'playground', label: 'Playground', icon: MessageSquare },
  ];

  const showEditor = isNew || !!selectedApi;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden">
      {/* ── Left panel: API list ── */}
      <div className="w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-gray-200 bg-white flex flex-col">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-100">
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <Bot size={18} className="text-indigo-600" /> Chat APIs
          </h2>
          <button onClick={newAPI}
            className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition">
            <Plus size={14} /> New Chat API
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1">
          {loading && <div className="flex justify-center py-8"><Loader2 size={20} className="animate-spin text-gray-400" /></div>}
          {!loading && apis.length === 0 && !isNew && (
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 text-center mt-6">No Chat APIs yet. Create one!</p>
          )}
          {isNew && (
            <div className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-indigo-700">New Chat API</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-400">Unsaved</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {apis.map(api => (
            <div key={api.id}
              onClick={() => selectAPI(api)}
              className={`px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg cursor-pointer group flex items-start justify-between gap-2 transition ${
                selectedApi?.id === api.id && !isNew
                  ? 'bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200'
                  : 'hover:bg-gray-50 border border-transparent'
              }`}>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-0.5">
                  {api.auth_enabled
                    ? <Lock size={11} className="text-amber-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                    : <Globe size={11} className="text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />}
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800 truncate">{api.name}</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 truncate">{api.description || (api.vector_table ? `RAG: ${api.vector_table}` : 'No RAG')}</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteAPI(api); }}
                className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 transition flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                <Trash2 size={13} />
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Right panel: editor / tabs ── */}
      {!showEditor ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="text-center">
            <Bot size={52} className="text-gray-200 mx-auto mb-4" />
            <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Select a Chat API or create a new one</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          {/* Tab bar */}
          <div className="border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-6 flex items-center gap-1 pt-3">
            {TABS.map(t => {
              const Icon = t.icon;
              const isPlayground = t.id === 'playground';
              const canPlayground = !isNew && selectedApi;
              return (
                <button key={t.id}
                  onClick={() => { if (isPlayground && !canPlayground) { toast('Save the API first to use the playground'); return; } setTab(t.id); }}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition ${
                    activeTab === t.id
                      ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-700'
                      : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                  } ${isPlayground && !canPlayground ? 'opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed' : ''}`}>
                  <Icon size={14} /> {t.label}
                  {isPlayground && !isNew && (
                    <span className="ml-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-green-100 text-green-700 text-xs rounded-full font-normal">Live</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Tab content */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">
            {activeTab === 'config' && (
              <ConfigTab config={config} setConfig={setConfig} apiId={selectedApi?.id} onSave={saveAPI} saving={saving} />
            )}
            {activeTab === 'auth' && (
              <AuthDocsTab api={selectedApi} config={config} setConfig={setConfig} />
            )}
            {activeTab === 'auth' && (
              <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                <button onClick={saveAPI} disabled={saving}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition">
                  {saving ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Save size={14} />}
                  Save Auth Settings
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {activeTab === 'playground' && selectedApi && (
              <div className="h-full" style={{ minHeight: '500px' }}>
                <PlaygroundTab api={selectedApi} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}




src/components/ChartView.jsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  BarChart, Bar, LineChart, Line, PieChart, Pie, Cell,
  AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip,
  Legend, ResponsiveContainer, ScatterChart, Scatter,
} from 'recharts';
import { BarChart3, TrendingUp, PieChart as PieIcon, Layers, Activity, X, Settings } from 'lucide-react';
import './ChartView.css';

const CHART_TYPES = [
  { value: 'bar', label: 'Bar', icon: BarChart3 },
  { value: 'line', label: 'Line', icon: TrendingUp },
  { value: 'area', label: 'Area', icon: Activity },
  { value: 'pie', label: 'Pie', icon: PieIcon },
  { value: 'scatter', label: 'Scatter', icon: Layers },
];

const COLORS = [
  '#3b82f6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#8b5cf6',
  '#ec4899', '#06b6d4', '#84cc16', '#f97316', '#6366f1',
  '#14b8a6', '#e11d48', '#a855f7', '#0ea5e9', '#22c55e',
];

export default function ChartView({ data, columns, onClose }) {
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState('bar');
  const [xAxis, setXAxis] = useState('');
  const [yAxes, setYAxes] = useState([]);
  const [showConfig, setShowConfig] = useState(true);

  // Auto-detect numeric and categorical columns
  const { numericCols, categoricalCols } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || data.length === 0 || !columns) return { numericCols: [], categoricalCols: [] };
    const numeric = [];
    const categorical = [];
    columns.forEach(col => {
      const sample = data.slice(0, 20).map(r => r[col]).filter(v => v !== null && v !== undefined);
      const allNumeric = sample.length > 0 && sample.every(v => !isNaN(Number(v)));
      if (allNumeric && sample.length > 0) numeric.push(col);
      else categorical.push(col);
    });
    return { numericCols: numeric, categoricalCols: categorical };
  }, [data, columns]);

  // Auto-select axes on first load
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!xAxis && columns?.length > 0) {
      setXAxis(categoricalCols[0] || columns[0]);
    }
    if (yAxes.length === 0 && numericCols.length > 0) {
      setYAxes([numericCols[0]]);
    }
  }, [columns, numericCols, categoricalCols]);

  // Prepare chart data — limit to 500 rows for performance
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || !xAxis) return [];
    return data.slice(0, 500).map(row => {
      const point = { [xAxis]: row[xAxis] };
      yAxes.forEach(y => { point[y] = Number(row[y]) || 0; });
      return point;
    });
  }, [data, xAxis, yAxes]);

  // Pie chart data aggregation
  const pieData = useMemo(() => {
    if (chartType !== 'pie' || !xAxis || yAxes.length === 0) return [];
    const agg = {};
    chartData.forEach(row => {
      const key = String(row[xAxis] ?? 'null');
      agg[key] = (agg[key] || 0) + (Number(row[yAxes[0]]) || 0);
    });
    return Object.entries(agg)
      .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
      .slice(0, 20);
  }, [chartData, chartType, xAxis, yAxes]);

  const toggleYAxis = (col) => {
    setYAxes(prev =>
      prev.includes(col) ? prev.filter(c => c !== col) : [...prev, col]
    );
  };

  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="chart-view-empty">
        <BarChart3 size={32} />
        <p>No data to chart</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="chart-view-container">
      <div className="chart-view-toolbar">
        <div className="chart-type-tabs">
          {CHART_TYPES.map(ct => (
            <button
              key={ct.value}
              className={`chart-type-btn ${chartType === ct.value ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setChartType(ct.value)}
              title={ct.label}
            >
              <ct.icon size={14} />
              <span>{ct.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="chart-toolbar-actions">
          <button
            className={`chart-config-toggle ${showConfig ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setShowConfig(!showConfig)}
            title="Toggle configuration"
          >
            <Settings size={14} />
          </button>
          {onClose && (
            <button className="chart-close-btn" onClick={onClose} title="Close chart">
              <X size={14} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="chart-view-body">
        {showConfig && (
          <div className="chart-config-panel">
            <div className="chart-config-section">
              <label className="chart-config-label">X-Axis (Category)</label>
              <select
                value={xAxis}
                onChange={e => setXAxis(e.target.value)}
                className="chart-config-select"
              >
                <option value="">Select column...</option>
                {columns.map(col => (
                  <option key={col} value={col}>{col}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="chart-config-section">
              <label className="chart-config-label">Y-Axis (Values)</label>
              <div className="chart-y-axis-list">
                {numericCols.length === 0 ? (
                  <span className="chart-config-hint">No numeric columns detected</span>
                ) : (
                  numericCols.map((col, i) => (
                    <label key={col} className="chart-y-axis-item">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={yAxes.includes(col)}
                        onChange={() => toggleYAxis(col)}
                      />
                      <span className="chart-y-dot" style={{ background: COLORS[i % COLORS.length] }} />
                      <span>{col}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {categoricalCols.length > 0 && numericCols.length === 0 && (
              <div className="chart-config-hint">
                Tip: Select any column as Y-axis even if non-numeric — will count as 0.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="chart-render-area">
          {chartData.length === 0 || yAxes.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="chart-no-data">
              <Settings size={24} />
              <p>Select X and Y axes to render chart</p>
            </div>
          ) : chartType === 'bar' ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 30, left: 0, bottom: 30 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
                <XAxis dataKey={xAxis} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} angle={-30} textAnchor="end" height={60} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8 }} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 12 }} />
                {yAxes.map((y, i) => (
                  <Bar key={y} dataKey={y} fill={COLORS[i % COLORS.length]} radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
                ))}
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : chartType === 'line' ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <LineChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 30, left: 0, bottom: 30 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
                <XAxis dataKey={xAxis} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} angle={-30} textAnchor="end" height={60} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8 }} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 12 }} />
                {yAxes.map((y, i) => (
                  <Line key={y} dataKey={y} stroke={COLORS[i % COLORS.length]} strokeWidth={2} dot={{ r: 3 }} />
                ))}
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : chartType === 'area' ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 30, left: 0, bottom: 30 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
                <XAxis dataKey={xAxis} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} angle={-30} textAnchor="end" height={60} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8 }} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 12 }} />
                {yAxes.map((y, i) => (
                  <Area key={y} dataKey={y} stroke={COLORS[i % COLORS.length]} fill={COLORS[i % COLORS.length]} fillOpacity={0.2} strokeWidth={2} />
                ))}
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : chartType === 'pie' ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={pieData}
                  cx="50%"
                  cy="50%"
                  outerRadius="70%"
                  innerRadius="30%"
                  dataKey="value"
                  nameKey="name"
                  label={({ name, percent }) => `${name} (${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`}
                  labelLine={{ stroke: '#94a3b8' }}
                >
                  {pieData.map((_, i) => (
                    <Cell key={i} fill={COLORS[i % COLORS.length]} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8 }} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 12 }} />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : chartType === 'scatter' ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <ScatterChart margin={{ top: 10, right: 30, left: 0, bottom: 30 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e2e8f0" />
                <XAxis dataKey={xAxis} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} name={xAxis} />
                <YAxis dataKey={yAxes[0]} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} name={yAxes[0]} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8 }} cursor={{ strokeDasharray: '3 3' }} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 12 }} />
                <Scatter name={`${xAxis} vs ${yAxes[0]}`} data={chartData} fill={COLORS[0]} />
              </ScatterChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/AuditDashboard.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  BarChart, Bar, LineChart, Line, PieChart, Pie, Cell,
  XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer,
} from 'recharts';
import {
  Shield, RefreshCw, Search, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Database,
  User, Clock, Activity, AlertTriangle, Filter, Download, X, Eye, Server,
  ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight, Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sqlEditorAPI } from '../services/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import './AuditDashboard.css';

const COLORS = ['#3b82f6', '#22c55e', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#06b6d4', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6', '#14b8a6'];
const ACTION_COLORS = {
  query: '#3b82f6',
  execute: '#22c55e',
  export: '#f59e0b',
  delete: '#ef4444',
  create: '#06b6d4',
  update: '#ec4899',
  login: '#8b5cf6',
};
const TOOLTIP_STYLE = { background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 8, color: '#1e293b' };
const GRID_STROKE = '#e2e8f0';
const AXIS_TICK = { fill: '#64748b', fontSize: 10 };
const AXIS_TICK_SM = { fill: '#64748b', fontSize: 9 };

export default function AuditDashboard() {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // Server-side pagination
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(50);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  // Server-side filters
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState(''); // debounced
  const [userFilter, setUserFilter] = useState('');
  const [actionFilter, setActionFilter] = useState('');
  const [dbFilter, setDbFilter] = useState('');
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState('');
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('created_at');
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState('desc');

  // Filter options from server
  const [filterOptions, setFilterOptions] = useState({ actions: [], databases: [], users: [] });

  // UI state
  const [selectedLog, setSelectedLog] = useState(null);

  // Debounce search input
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setSearchQuery(searchInput);
      setPage(1);
    }, 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchInput]);

  // Reset page when filters change
  useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [userFilter, actionFilter, dbFilter, dateFrom, dateTo, pageSize]);

  const loadAuditLogs = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const params = {
        page,
        page_size: pageSize,
        sort_by: sortField,
        sort_order: sortDir,
      };
      if (searchQuery) params.search = searchQuery;
      if (userFilter) params.user = userFilter;
      if (actionFilter) params.action = actionFilter;
      if (dbFilter) params.database_name = dbFilter;
      if (dateFrom) params.date_from = dateFrom;
      if (dateTo) params.date_to = dateTo;

      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getAuditLog(params);
      const body = res?.data ?? res;
      setLogs(body?.logs ?? []);
      setTotal(body?.total ?? 0);
      setTotalPages(body?.total_pages ?? 1);
      if (body?.filters) {
        setFilterOptions(body.filters);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const detail = err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.message || 'Unknown error';
      setError(detail);
      toast.error('Failed to load audit logs: ' + detail);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [page, pageSize, searchQuery, userFilter, actionFilter, dbFilter, dateFrom, dateTo, sortField, sortDir]);

  useEffect(() => { loadAuditLogs(); }, [loadAuditLogs]);

  // ── Helper: extract server_name from details JSON ──────────────────
  const getServerName = (log) => {
    if (!log.details) return '';
    try {
      const d = typeof log.details === 'string' ? JSON.parse(log.details) : log.details;
      return d.server_name || '';
    } catch { return ''; }
  };

  // ── Computed stats (from current page data) ────────────────────────
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const actionCounts = {};
    const hourCounts = {};
    const dayCounts = {};
    const userCounts = {};
    const dbCounts = {};

    logs.forEach(log => {
      const action = log.action || 'query';
      actionCounts[action] = (actionCounts[action] || 0) + 1;
      userCounts[log.user_id] = (userCounts[log.user_id] || 0) + 1;
      if (log.database_name) dbCounts[log.database_name] = (dbCounts[log.database_name] || 0) + 1;
      if (log.created_at) {
        const date = new Date(log.created_at);
        hourCounts[date.getHours()] = (hourCounts[date.getHours()] || 0) + 1;
        const dayKey = date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        dayCounts[dayKey] = (dayCounts[dayKey] || 0) + 1;
      }
    });

    const topUsers = Object.entries(userCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10)
      .map(([name, count]) => ({ name, count }));
    const actionData = Object.entries(actionCounts).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));
    const dbData = Object.entries(dbCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8)
      .map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));
    const hourlyData = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, h) => ({
      hour: `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:00`, queries: hourCounts[h] || 0,
    }));
    const dailyData = Object.entries(dayCounts).sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(-30)
      .map(([date, count]) => ({ date: date.slice(5), queries: count }));

    return {
      totalLogs: total,
      uniqueUsers: filterOptions.users?.length || new Set(logs.map(l => l.user_id)).size,
      uniqueDbs: filterOptions.databases?.length || new Set(logs.map(l => l.database_name).filter(Boolean)).size,
      actionData, topUsers, dbData, hourlyData, dailyData,
    };
  }, [logs, total, filterOptions]);

  const toggleSort = (field) => {
    if (sortField === field) setSortDir(d => d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    else { setSortField(field); setSortDir('desc'); }
  };

  const SortIcon = ({ field }) => (
    sortField === field
      ? (sortDir === 'asc' ? <ChevronUp size={12} /> : <ChevronDown size={12} />)
      : <ChevronDown size={12} style={{ opacity: 0.3 }} />
  );

  // ── Export logs as CSV ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const exportCSV = () => {
    const headers = ['ID', 'User', 'Action', 'Database', 'Table', 'Server', 'Query', 'DB Type', 'IP', 'Created At'];
    const rows = logs.map(l => [
      l.id, l.user_id, l.action, l.database_name, l.table_name,
      getServerName(l) || 'Default',
      `"${(l.query_text || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      l.db_type, l.ip_address, l.created_at,
    ]);
    const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = `audit_log_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
    a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast.success(`Exported ${logs.length} rows as CSV`);
  };

  // ── Clear all filters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchInput(''); setSearchQuery('');
    setUserFilter(''); setActionFilter(''); setDbFilter('');
    setDateFrom(''); setDateTo('');
    setPage(1);
  };
  const hasFilters = searchQuery || userFilter || actionFilter || dbFilter || dateFrom || dateTo;

  // ── Pagination helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const goToPage = (p) => setPage(Math.max(1, Math.min(p, totalPages)));
  const pageStart = (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const pageEnd = Math.min(page * pageSize, total);

  // Build visible page numbers
  const pageNumbers = useMemo(() => {
    const pages = [];
    const maxVisible = 7;
    if (totalPages <= maxVisible) {
      for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) pages.push(i);
    } else {
      pages.push(1);
      let start = Math.max(2, page - 2);
      let end = Math.min(totalPages - 1, page + 2);
      if (start > 2) pages.push('...');
      for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) pages.push(i);
      if (end < totalPages - 1) pages.push('...');
      pages.push(totalPages);
    }
    return pages;
  }, [page, totalPages]);

  return (
    <div className="audit-dashboard">
      {/* ── Header ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="audit-header">
        <div className="audit-title">
          <Shield size={20} />
          <h2>Audit Dashboard</h2>
          <span className="audit-badge">{total.toLocaleString()} total</span>
        </div>
        <div className="audit-controls">
          <div className="audit-search">
            <Search size={14} />
            <input
              placeholder="Search logs..."
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={e => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <button className="audit-btn" onClick={loadAuditLogs} disabled={loading}>
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? 'spin' : ''} /> Refresh
          </button>
          <button className="audit-btn" onClick={exportCSV}>
            <Download size={14} /> Export
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Filters Row ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="audit-filters-row">
        <div className="audit-filter-group">
          <label><Filter size={12} /> Filters</label>
          <select value={actionFilter} onChange={e => setActionFilter(e.target.value)} className="audit-select">
            <option value="">All Actions</option>
            {filterOptions.actions.map(a => <option key={a} value={a}>{a}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select value={dbFilter} onChange={e => setDbFilter(e.target.value)} className="audit-select">
            <option value="">All Databases</option>
            {filterOptions.databases.map(d => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select value={userFilter} onChange={e => setUserFilter(e.target.value)} className="audit-select">
            <option value="">All Users</option>
            {filterOptions.users.map(u => <option key={u} value={u}>{u}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="audit-filter-group">
          <label><Calendar size={12} /> Date Range</label>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={dateFrom}
            onChange={e => setDateFrom(e.target.value)}
            className="audit-input audit-date-input"
            placeholder="From"
          />
          <span className="audit-date-sep">to</span>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={dateTo}
            onChange={e => setDateTo(e.target.value)}
            className="audit-input audit-date-input"
            placeholder="To"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="audit-filter-group">
          <label>Per Page</label>
          <select value={pageSize} onChange={e => setPageSize(Number(e.target.value))} className="audit-select" style={{ width: 72 }}>
            <option value={25}>25</option>
            <option value={50}>50</option>
            <option value={100}>100</option>
            <option value={200}>200</option>
            <option value={500}>500</option>
          </select>
          {hasFilters && (
            <button className="audit-btn audit-btn-clear" onClick={clearFilters}>
              <X size={12} /> Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Error Banner ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {error && (
        <div style={{ padding: '10px 16px', background: '#fef2f2', border: '1px solid #fecaca', borderRadius: 8, color: '#dc2626', fontSize: '0.82rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
          <AlertTriangle size={16} />
          <span><strong>Error loading audit logs:</strong> {error}</span>
          <button onClick={loadAuditLogs} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', background: '#dc2626', color: '#fff', border: 'none', borderRadius: 4, padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Loading State ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {loading && logs.length === 0 && (
        <div style={{ padding: 20, textAlign: 'center', color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
          <RefreshCw size={18} className="spin" style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
          Loading audit logs...
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Stats Cards ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="audit-stats">
        <div className="audit-stat-card">
          <Activity size={18} />
          <div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.totalLogs.toLocaleString()}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">Total Events</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="audit-stat-card">
          <User size={18} />
          <div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.uniqueUsers}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">Unique Users</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="audit-stat-card">
          <Database size={18} />
          <div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.uniqueDbs}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">Databases</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="audit-stat-card">
          <AlertTriangle size={18} />
          <div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.actionData.find(a => a.name === 'delete')?.value || 0}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">Deletes</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Charts Row ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="audit-charts">
        {/* Daily Activity Timeline */}
        <div className="audit-chart-card" style={{ flex: 2 }}>
          <h3>Daily Activity (Current Page)</h3>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={160}>
            <LineChart data={stats.dailyData}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={GRID_STROKE} />
              <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={AXIS_TICK_SM} />
              <YAxis tick={AXIS_TICK} width={30} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={TOOLTIP_STYLE} />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="queries" stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
        {/* Action Distribution */}
        <div className="audit-chart-card">
          <h3>Actions</h3>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={160}>
            <PieChart>
              <Pie data={stats.actionData} cx="50%" cy="50%" outerRadius={55} dataKey="value"
                label={({ name, percent }) => `${name.slice(0, 10)} ${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}>
                {stats.actionData.map((entry, i) => (
                  <Cell key={i} fill={ACTION_COLORS[entry.name] || COLORS[i % COLORS.length]} />
                ))}
              </Pie>
              <Tooltip contentStyle={TOOLTIP_STYLE} />
            </PieChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
        {/* Hourly Activity */}
        <div className="audit-chart-card">
          <h3>Hourly</h3>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={160}>
            <BarChart data={stats.hourlyData}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={GRID_STROKE} />
              <XAxis dataKey="hour" tick={AXIS_TICK_SM} interval={3} />
              <YAxis tick={AXIS_TICK} width={25} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={TOOLTIP_STYLE} />
              <Bar dataKey="queries" fill="#3b82f6" radius={[2, 2, 0, 0]} />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
        {/* Top Users */}
        <div className="audit-chart-card">
          <h3>Top Users</h3>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={160}>
            <BarChart data={stats.topUsers} layout="vertical">
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke={GRID_STROKE} />
              <XAxis type="number" tick={AXIS_TICK} />
              <YAxis dataKey="name" type="category" tick={AXIS_TICK_SM} width={60} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={TOOLTIP_STYLE} />
              <Bar dataKey="count" fill="#22c55e" radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]} />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Log Table ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="audit-table-container">
        <div className="audit-table-header">
          <h3>
            Audit Log
            {total > 0 && (
              <span className="audit-table-count">
                {' '}({pageStart.toLocaleString()}–{pageEnd.toLocaleString()} of {total.toLocaleString()})
              </span>
            )}
          </h3>
          {loading && <RefreshCw size={14} className="spin" style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }} />}
        </div>
        <div className="audit-table-scroll">
          <table className="audit-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th onClick={() => toggleSort('created_at')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  Time <SortIcon field="created_at" />
                </th>
                <th onClick={() => toggleSort('user_id')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  User <SortIcon field="user_id" />
                </th>
                <th onClick={() => toggleSort('action')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  Action <SortIcon field="action" />
                </th>
                <th onClick={() => toggleSort('database_name')} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  Database <SortIcon field="database_name" />
                </th>
                <th>Server</th>
                <th>Table</th>
                <th>Query</th>
                <th>IP</th>
                <th></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {logs.map(log => (
                <tr key={log.id} className={`audit-row action-${log.action}`}>
                  <td className="audit-time">
                    {log.created_at ? new Date(log.created_at).toLocaleString() : '-'}
                  </td>
                  <td className="audit-user">{log.user_id}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className={`audit-action-badge action-${log.action}`}>
                      {log.action}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{log.database_name || '-'}</td>
                  <td>
                    {getServerName(log) ? (
                      <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#7c3aed', background: '#ede9fe', padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 12, fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        <Server size={10} />{getServerName(log)}
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Default</span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td>{log.table_name || '-'}</td>
                  <td className="audit-query">
                    {(log.query_text || '').slice(0, 80)}{(log.query_text || '').length > 80 ? '...' : ''}
                  </td>
                  <td className="audit-ip">{log.ip_address || '-'}</td>
                  <td>
                    <button className="audit-view-btn" onClick={() => setSelectedLog(log)} title="View details">
                      <Eye size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {logs.length === 0 && !loading && (
                <tr><td colSpan={9} style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 24, color: '#94a3b8' }}>No matching audit logs</td></tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* ── Pagination Controls ─────────────────────────────────── */}
        {totalPages > 1 && (
          <div className="audit-pagination">
            <div className="audit-page-info">
              Page {page} of {totalPages.toLocaleString()} ({total.toLocaleString()} total)
            </div>
            <div className="audit-page-buttons">
              <button className="audit-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(1)} disabled={page === 1} title="First page">
                <ChevronsLeft size={14} />
              </button>
              <button className="audit-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(page - 1)} disabled={page === 1} title="Previous page">
                <ChevronLeft size={14} />
              </button>
              {pageNumbers.map((p, i) =>
                p === '...' ? (
                  <span key={`ellipsis-${i}`} className="audit-page-ellipsis">…</span>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    key={p}
                    className={`audit-page-btn ${p === page ? 'active' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => goToPage(p)}
                  >
                    {p}
                  </button>
                )
              )}
              <button className="audit-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(page + 1)} disabled={page === totalPages} title="Next page">
                <ChevronRight size={14} />
              </button>
              <button className="audit-page-btn" onClick={() => goToPage(totalPages)} disabled={page === totalPages} title="Last page">
                <ChevronsRight size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── Detail Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {selectedLog && (
        <div className="audit-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setSelectedLog(null)}>
          <div className="audit-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="audit-modal-header">
              <h3><Shield size={16} /> Audit Detail #{selectedLog.id}</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedLog(null)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="audit-modal-body">
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>User</label><span>{selectedLog.user_id}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>Action</label>
                <span className={`audit-action-badge action-${selectedLog.action}`}>{selectedLog.action}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>Time</label>
                <span>{selectedLog.created_at ? new Date(selectedLog.created_at).toLocaleString() : '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>Database</label><span>{selectedLog.database_name || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>Table</label><span>{selectedLog.table_name || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>DB Type</label><span>{selectedLog.db_type || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>Server</label>
                <span>{getServerName(selectedLog) || 'Default'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="audit-detail-row">
                <label>IP Address</label><span>{selectedLog.ip_address || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              {selectedLog.query_text && (
                <div className="audit-detail-query">
                  <label>Query</label>
                  <pre>{selectedLog.query_text}</pre>
                </div>
              )}
              {selectedLog.details && (
                <div className="audit-detail-query">
                  <label>Details</label>
                  <pre>{selectedLog.details}</pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

src/components/APIBuilder.jsx

  { name: 'Filter rows', type: 'filter', config: { column: '', operator: 'eq', value: '' } },
  { name: 'Lowercase column', type: 'transform', config: { column: '', action: 'lowercase' } },
  { name: 'Uppercase column', type: 'transform', config: { column: '', action: 'uppercase' } },
  { name: 'Trim whitespace', type: 'transform', config: { column: '', action: 'trim' } },
  { name: 'Mask PII', type: 'transform', config: { column: '', action: 'mask' } },
  { name: 'Hash column', type: 'transform', config: { column: '', action: 'hash' } },
  { name: 'Aggregate', type: 'aggregate', config: { group_by: '', agg_column: '', agg_func: 'count' } },
];

// ── HTTP method constants ────────────────────────────────────────────
const HTTP_METHODS = ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE'];

// ── Helper: fetch databases list ─────────────────────────────────────
async function fetchDbList(dbType, serverId = null) {
  try {
    if (serverId) {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServerDatabases(serverId);
      return (res.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name);
    }
    const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listDatabases(dbType);
    return (res.data.databases || []).map((d) => d.name);
  } catch { return []; }
}

// ── Helper: fetch tables list ────────────────────────────────────────
async function fetchTableList(database, dbType, serverId = null) {
  if (!database) return [];
  try {
    if (serverId) {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listServerTables(serverId, database);
      return (res.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name);
    }
    const res = await sqlEditorAPI.listTables(database, dbType);
    return (res.data.tables || []).map((t) => t.table_name);
  } catch { return []; }
}

// ── Helper: fetch columns list ───────────────────────────────────────
async function fetchColumnList(database, tableName, dbType, serverId = null) {
  if (!database || !tableName) return [];
  try {
    if (serverId) {
      const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getServerTableSchema(serverId, database, tableName);
      return (res.data.columns || []).map((c) => c.column_name);
    }
    const res = await sqlEditorAPI.getTableSchema(database, tableName, dbType);
    return (res.data.columns || []).map((c) => c.column_name);
  } catch { return []; }
}


export default function APIBuilder({ prefillApi, onPrefillConsumed }) {
  const { databaseType, databases, tables, selectedDatabase, servers, selectedServer } = useQueryStore();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('crud');

  // ── Shared dropdown data caches ────────────────────────────────────
  const [dbListCS, setDbListCS] = useState([]);
  const [dbListBQ, setDbListBQ] = useState([]);
  const [dbListServer, setDbListServer] = useState({});  // { serverId: [db1, db2, ...] }
  const [dbListLoading, setDbListLoading] = useState(false);

  // Per-section table/column caches
  const [crudTableList, setCrudTableList] = useState([]);
  const [crudColumnList, setCrudColumnList] = useState([]);
  const [crudTablesLoading, setCrudTablesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [crudColumnsLoading, setCrudColumnsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Source/target for relationships

  const [srcColumnList, setSrcColumnList] = useState([]);
  const [tgtTableList, setTgtTableList] = useState([]);
  const [tgtColumnList, setTgtColumnList] = useState([]);
  const [srcTablesLoading, setSrcTablesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [tgtTablesLoading, setTgtTablesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [srcColumnsLoading, setSrcColumnsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [tgtColumnsLoading, setTgtColumnsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Builder tab
  const [builderTableList, setBuilderTableList] = useState([]);
  const [builderColumnList, setBuilderColumnList] = useState([]);
  const [builderTablesLoading, setBuilderTablesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [builderColumnsLoading, setBuilderColumnsLoading] = useState(false);

  // CRUD tab state
  const [crudDb, setCrudDb] = useState('');
  const [crudTable, setCrudTable] = useState('');
  const [crudResult, setCrudResult] = useState(null);
  const [crudLoading, setCrudLoading] = useState(false);
  const [crudParams, setCrudParams] = useState({ limit: 50, offset: 0, sort_by: '', sort_order: 'asc', filters: '', columns: '' });

  // Relationships state
  const [relationships, setRelationships] = useState([]);
  const [relForm, setRelForm] = useState({
    name: '', source_database: '', source_table: '', source_column: '',
    target_database: '', target_table: '', target_column: '',
    join_type: 'INNER', source_db_type: 'cloudsql', target_db_type: 'cloudsql',
  });
  const [relResult, setRelResult] = useState(null);

  // API Builder state — now with auth + encryption + caching fields
  const [customAPIs, setCustomAPIs] = useState([]);
  const [apiForm, setApiForm] = useState({
    name: '', description: '', database: '', db_type: 'cloudsql',
    server_id: null,
    base_table: '', schema_name: 'public', relationships: [],
    function_layers: [], select_columns: [], default_limit: 100,
    allowed_filters: [], allowed_sorts: [], enable_crud: true,
    auth_enabled: false, auth_username: '', auth_password: '',
    encryption_enabled: false, encryption_key: '',
    public_alias: '', base_filter: '', where_conditions: [],
    cache_ttl: 0,
  });
  const [editingApiId, setEditingApiId] = useState(null);

  // Tester state — enhanced with method, body, auth, encryption
  const [testApiId, setTestApiId] = useState('');
  const [testParams, setTestParams] = useState({ limit: 10, offset: 0, sort_by: '', sort_order: 'asc', filters: '' });
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState(null);
  const [testLoading, setTestLoading] = useState(false);
  const [apiDocs, setApiDocs] = useState(null);
  const [testMethod, setTestMethod] = useState('GET');
  const [testBody, setTestBody] = useState('');
  const [testFilters, setTestFilters] = useState([{ col: '', val: '' }]);
  const [useSearchMode, setUseSearchMode] = useState(false);
  const [joinLists, setJoinLists] = useState({});

  // ── Metrics state ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [metricsOpen, setMetricsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [metricsApiId, setMetricsApiId] = useState(null);
  const [metricsApiName, setMetricsApiName] = useState('');
  const [metricsSummary, setMetricsSummary] = useState(null);
  const [metricsHits, setMetricsHits] = useState([]);
  const [metricsLoading, setMetricsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [metricsDateFrom, setMetricsDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [metricsDateTo, setMetricsDateTo] = useState('');
  const [metricsHitsPage, setMetricsHitsPage] = useState(0);
  const [metricsHitsTotal, setMetricsHitsTotal] = useState(0);
  const [metricsTab, setMetricsTab] = useState('overview');  // overview | hits | callers  // { [idx]: { tables: [], columns: [], tLoading: false, cLoading: false } }
  const [testAuthUser, setTestAuthUser] = useState('');
  const [testAuthPass, setTestAuthPass] = useState('');
  const [testEncrypt, setTestEncrypt] = useState(false);
  const [testDecryptResponse, setTestDecryptResponse] = useState(false);
  const [generatingKey, setGeneratingKey] = useState(false);
  const [showAuthPass, setShowAuthPass] = useState(false);
  const [showTestPass, setShowTestPass] = useState(false);
  // Code Snippets
  const [snippetLang, setSnippetLang] = useState('curl'); // 'curl' | 'javascript' | 'python' | 'nodejs'
  // View mode & verify
  const [resultViewMode, setResultViewMode] = useState('table'); // 'table' | 'json'
  const [verifyResult, setVerifyResult] = useState(null);
  const [verifyLoading, setVerifyLoading] = useState(false);
  const [crudViewMode, setCrudViewMode] = useState('table');
  const [relViewMode, setRelViewMode] = useState('table');

  // ── Preview / Test-before-save state ───────────────────────────
  const [previewResult, setPreviewResult] = useState(null);
  const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState(false);
  const [previewViewMode, setPreviewViewMode] = useState('table');

  // ── Load databases on mount ────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRelationships();
    loadCustomAPIs();
    loadDbLists();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadDbLists(); }, [databaseType]);
  useEffect(() => { loadDbLists(); }, [servers.filter(s => s.connected).length, selectedServer?.id]);

  const loadDbLists = async () => {
    setDbListLoading(true);
    const [cs, bq] = await Promise.all([fetchDbList('cloudsql'), fetchDbList('bigquery')]);
    setDbListCS(cs);
    setDbListBQ(bq);
    // Also load databases from connected custom servers
    const customServers = servers.filter(s => !s.is_default && s.connected);
    const serverDbMap = {};
    await Promise.all(customServers.map(async (s) => {
      try {
        serverDbMap[s.id] = await fetchDbList(null, s.id);
      } catch { serverDbMap[s.id] = []; }
    }));
    setDbListServer(serverDbMap);
    setDbListLoading(false);
  };

  const getDbList = (dbType) => {
    if (dbType && dbType.startsWith('server:')) {
      const sId = dbType.replace('server:', '');
      return dbListServer[sId] || [];
    }
    return dbType === 'bigquery' ? dbListBQ : dbListCS;
  };

  // Helper to extract serverId from a db_type value like "server:abc123"
  const getServerIdFromDbType = (dbType) => {
    if (dbType && dbType.startsWith('server:')) return dbType.replace('server:', '');
    return null;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDatabase) {
      setCrudDb(selectedDatabase);
      setRelForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, source_database: selectedDatabase }));
      setApiForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, database: selectedDatabase }));
    }
  }, [selectedDatabase]);

  // ── Auto-load tables when database changes in each section ─────────
  // Determine active dbType for CRUD — use selectedServer if custom
  const crudDbType = (selectedServer && !selectedServer.is_default) ? `server:${selectedServer.id}` : databaseType;
  const crudServerId = getServerIdFromDbType(crudDbType);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (crudDb) {
      setCrudTablesLoading(true);
      fetchTableList(crudDb, databaseType, crudServerId).then((t) => { setCrudTableList(t); setCrudTablesLoading(false); });
    } else { setCrudTableList([]); }
    setCrudTable('');
    setCrudColumnList([]);
  }, [crudDb, databaseType, selectedServer?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (crudDb && crudTable) {
      setCrudColumnsLoading(true);
      fetchColumnList(crudDb, crudTable, databaseType, crudServerId).then((c) => { setCrudColumnList(c); setCrudColumnsLoading(false); });
    } else { setCrudColumnList([]); }
  }, [crudDb, crudTable, databaseType, selectedServer?.id]);

  // Source side - relationships
  useEffect(() => {
    if (relForm.source_database) {
      setSrcTablesLoading(true);
      fetchTableList(relForm.source_database, relForm.source_db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(relForm.source_db_type)).then((t) => { setSrcTableList(t); setSrcTablesLoading(false); });
    } else { setSrcTableList([]); }
  }, [relForm.source_database, relForm.source_db_type]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (relForm.source_database && relForm.source_table) {
      setSrcColumnsLoading(true);
      fetchColumnList(relForm.source_database, relForm.source_table, relForm.source_db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(relForm.source_db_type)).then((c) => { setSrcColumnList(c); setSrcColumnsLoading(false); });
    } else { setSrcColumnList([]); }
  }, [relForm.source_database, relForm.source_table, relForm.source_db_type]);

  // Target side - relationships
  useEffect(() => {
    if (relForm.target_database) {
      setTgtTablesLoading(true);
      fetchTableList(relForm.target_database, relForm.target_db_type, getServerIdFromDbType(relForm.target_db_type)).then((t) => { setTgtTableList(t); setTgtTablesLoading(false); });
    } else { setTgtTableList([]); }
  }, [relForm.target_database, relForm.target_db_type]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (relForm.target_database && relForm.target_table) {
      setTgtColumnsLoading(true);
